title: DeviceLogin::{Idle,InFlight} is a twin of sessions_op's mutating stage for the same request
trigger: Confirm a device-login QR; sessions_op.begin(id) and device_login=InFlight are set together and cleared in three arms (send error, answer, error answer) by hand
effect: Sessions buttons are gated by sessions_busy() = sessions_op.is_mutating() || device_login.in_flight(); the answer is matched by purpose (ConfirmDeviceLogin), not the RequestId, so the second stage adds nothing the first lacks and the two can drift
fix: Drop InFlight: the device link is a ListOp write with a result slot (Done(result)) keyed by the RequestId held in sessions_op

title: ToneUpload::Uploading holds a name and target but no RequestId; its answer is matched by purpose
trigger: Upload a notification tone; the answer or error is applied to settings.tone_upload when pending.purpose == UploadSavedNotificationSound
effect: One upload at a time is enforced by the Uploading check, but a late answer of any earlier UploadSavedNotificationSound request would settle the current upload (finish_tone_upload and apply_tone_upload_error never compare ids)
fix: Uploading { request: RequestId, name, target }, settled only when the answering id matches

title: Sticker batch progress is four fields kept in step by hand
trigger: manage_sticker_sets writes batch_total, batch_completed, batch_failed, batch_pending together; finish_sticker_batch_item (session_stickers.rs:41-49) edits pending and one of the counters; nothing clears them when the batch ends or the account goes
effect: A finished batch keeps total/completed/failed from the last run; a new run resets them field by field, and total can disagree with pending+completed+failed
fix: StickerBatch { Idle, Running { total, pending: Vec<i64>, completed, failed } } in one field

title: Stale marks for recent/favorite/trending stickers are bools beside Fetch lists that have an Outdated stage
trigger: updateRecentStickers/FavoriteStickers/TrendingStickerSets set recent_stale/favorites_stale/trending_stale (stickers/apply.rs:99-107); refresh_stale_panels clears them by hand after the send, and masks them with &= when the panel is closed
effect: StickerLists::{recent,favorites,trending} are Fetch<()> with Outdated, yet a second bool says the same thing; reaction_options_stale and gifs.stale are the same shape. The mark and the Fetch stage can disagree (a Fetch::Loading list with the flag set)
fix: Fetch::outdate() on lists.recent/favorites/trending (and a MessageReactionsState::Outdated), no separate bool

title: Sticker panel browse mode is reset field by field at several call sites
trigger: select_sticker_tab (231-233) clears set, selected_set_id and stickers; search_sticker_picker (289-296) clears selected_set_id, set, search_offset, search_has_more, searched, found_sets, found_stickers; search_sticker_category (sticker_categories.rs:56-59) repeats the search half; session_stickers.rs:227 and session_apply_ok.rs:335 clear selected_set_id again
effect: A new reset site that misses one field leaves a selected set, a search cursor or found list from the previous mode (a stale has_more with an empty list asks for a page of the wrong query)
fix: One StickerBrowse enum (Installed{selected,set} | Search{query,offset,has_more,sets,stickers} | Category{..}) replaced whole on a mode change

title: A failed send of the notification-exceptions fetch removes the entry, so the Notifications page render asks again
trigger: Close the client (send refused), open Settings > Notifications: maybe_fetch_notification_exceptions removes the Loading entry on a refused send; notifications_page (ui/settings_window/notifications.rs:46) calls it on every render
effect: Each redraw builds and sends the request again while sends are refused; no Failed stage ends the ask (Retry exists only for a TDLib error)
fix: On a refused send, leave the scope in Fetch::Failed (as for a TDLib error) so only Retry re-asks

title: A refused getActiveSessions send returns the list to Idle, and the calls section asks again from render
trigger: Refuse sends, show a settings page with call_device_prefs_section: needs_fetch = sessions.is_idle(); maybe_fetch_active_sessions cancels back to Idle on a refused send
effect: Every render of the section spawns a task that builds and sends the fetch again (no redraw is requested, so it is wasted work per frame rather than a loop)
fix: Fetch::fail on a refused send; the section asks only from Idle

title: A refused refetch of a privacy rule replaces the held rule with Failed
trigger: Open a Privacy page that already holds a rule (Ready), then fetch_privacy_rules again with sends refused: begin_privacy_load turns Ready into Loading, the send fails, insert(key, Failed) drops the rule detail
effect: The row shows 'could not load' with no value, though the last known rule was valid (Fetch::fail keeps stale data; PrivacyKeyState::Failed does not)
fix: Restore the previous state (or Failed carrying the held detail) when the send is refused

title: Attached-stickers lookup keeps its stage in four places: attached_request, attached_answer (Option<Option<i64>>), a sticker_set_view with set_id 0 as a sentinel, and the loading stage
trigger: fetch_attached_sticker_sets writes attached_answer=None, sticker_set_view=Some(loading(0)), attached_request=Some(id); open_attached_sticker_set finds 'its' box by view.set_id == 0 && stage == Loading
effect: The waiting box is recognised by a magic id rather than by the request; the view is written over whatever set box was held; the answer slot is a nested Option that nothing clears if the box closes before the answer (it is taken on the next open only)
fix: StickerSetViewStage::AttachedLookup { request } inside the view, answered by RequestId; no separate slots

title: activateStoryStealthMode says it is deduped while in flight but sends on every call
trigger: Press the stealth button twice quickly: no has_purpose check precedes session.request
effect: Two requests go out; the second answer's refusal (or success) replaces the first's stealth_refusal slot, so the box can show the wrong outcome
fix: has_purpose guard, or keep the RequestId in a stealth stage and refuse while it is out

title: addOffer has no in-flight guard, unlike approve and decline
trigger: Submit the same Edit Price/Add Offer twice before the first answer: send_suggested only dedupes Approve and Decline (busy)
effect: Two offer messages (each with a Stars/TON price) go to the channel's direct-messages chat
fix: Dedupe AddOffer per (chat, message) the way suggested_post_busy does for approve/decline, or hold the RequestId in the offer box

title: open_money_page returns on the first refused send and leaves the page open with nothing asked
trigger: Refuse sends, open Settings > Money: wallet.money is replaced with open:true, state_fetch send fails and returns; rates, explorer and history are never asked; ui/ton_wallet_money.rs:53 opens the box regardless of the Err
effect: The Money box opens with an empty history (Idle) and no Retry, because the Paged stage was never begun or failed
fix: Send all four reads, marking each Failed on a refused send (as fetch_wallet_history does), instead of returning at the first

title: baseline: FastShareFacts::sent (server has the message) is a bool next to other facts
trigger: a message still sending vs sent
effect: none today; a pure per-row fact computed each render, not a held stage
fix: read the message's SendState enum (Sent variant) instead of a bool copy

title: Seed::InFlight duplicates the presets Fetch and the request registry: three holders of one request's stage
trigger: open Settings > Data and Storage on an unseeded account
effect: Seed::InFlight (data_storage.seeded), settings.auto_download_presets (Fetch Loading) and requests.has_purpose(GetAutoDownloadSettingsPresets) are set in step by hand in fetch_auto_download_presets (connect/settings/storage.rs:70-85) and reset separately in state/domains/settings/error.rs:69-77; the answer is matched by purpose, not by the RequestId held in the stage
fix: one Fetch<Presets> holding the RequestId; Seed becomes Seeded/Unseeded (persisted bool) only

title: storage_limits_seeded stays InFlight when TDLib refuses a setOption
trigger: first Ready of an account with no chosen limits; setOption(storage option) answers an error
effect: state/domains/settings/error.rs:42-47 only fails data_storage_save for SetStorageOption and never returns storage_limits_seeded to Unseeded, so maybe_seed_storage_limits (connect/settings/storage.rs:228) returns early for the rest of the process although its doc says a refused option is sent again on the next Ready; cache limits are not applied until restart
fix: leave InFlight on the SetStorageOption error arm (key the stage to the four option RequestIds) or drop InFlight and use Seeded/Unseeded

title: Load<T> is Fetch<T> again, and its Loading holds no RequestId: ton/stars stats answers and errors are matched by peer
trigger: open a revenue page for peer A, close it, open A again (or change theme) while the first getChatRevenueStatistics/getStarRevenueStatistics is out
effect: state/domains/payments/earn.rs:85-120 and 486-516 apply any answer or error whose EarnPurpose peer equals page.peer, not the request the page waits for: a stale answer (old is_dark chart colors) or stale error (Failed + toast over a request still in flight) lands on the new page; PageLoad in the same page already keys by RequestId
fix: Fetch<T> with the RequestId in Loading (as PageLoad), compared in the answer and error arms

title: Withdraw::request duplicates the RequestId of WithdrawStep::PasswordSending and Checking has none of its own
trigger: Collect/Withdraw, wrong password, retry
effect: connect/earn.rs send_withdrawal writes withdraw.request, then submit_withdrawal_password writes step = PasswordSending(request) separately; takes_answer must compare both and a hand-set pair can drift (a step change that forgets request, or the reverse)
fix: each WithdrawStep variant that waits carries its own RequestId (Checking(RequestId), PasswordSending(RequestId)); drop Withdraw::request

title: SetupPage::confirm and SetupPage::saving are one stage (Idle/Confirming/Saving) kept in step by hand
trigger: Affiliate setup: Start/Update then confirm, or End then confirm
effect: end_starref_program clears confirm when the send leaves (connect/earn.rs:499-503) while save_starref_program keeps it open until the answer (comment: tdesktop keeps ConfirmUpdate); the two paths differ by hand and apply_earn_error clears saving only, so a failed End leaves no box and a failed Save leaves the box
fix: enum SetupStage { Editing, Confirming(SetupConfirm), Saving { kind, request } }

title: getStarAdAccountUrl failure is dropped silently and the url is a bare Option with no stage
trigger: open a channel or bot Stars page; the AdAccountUrl request fails or answers empty
effect: EarnPurpose::AdAccountUrl error arm is {}; page.ad_account_url stays None so the Buy Ads row never shows and nothing can say asked/failed/none; the answer is matched by peer only
fix: Fetch<Option<String>> keyed by RequestId on the page

title: Mini-app one-shot answers that land while the account is in the background are drained as news when it comes back
trigger: send web app data (or toggle a bot in the attachment menu) from account A, switch to B before the answer, switch back to A
effect: Session::forget_screen_outcomes (state/session_outcomes.rs) clears earn, payments and message outcomes but not web_apps.data_sent, attachment_menu_toggled, attachment_menu_bot, found, write_access, emoji_access, phone_share or custom_replies; poll_mini_app_session (ui/web_app_ui/spawn_mini_app_window.rs:221-345) then shows 'Sent to the bot' / 'added to menu' notes with no action behind them, and custom_replies (keyed by the app's req_id, not the window) are emitted into whatever mini app window is open
fix: clear the one-shot slots in forget_screen_outcomes (or move them into OnScreen); key custom_replies by the window/launch that sent them

title: claimed_owner is set before account_data::claim runs and kept when the owner file cannot be written
trigger: account signs in on a full or read-only disk (or the app root has no parent)
effect: claim_account_owner (connect/core/pumps.rs:48-71) writes Some(me) first, then logs owner_error and never retries in this process, so the folder has no owner file until a later start; its own doc says the next start then cannot tell whose the folder is (a Fresh sign-in with leftovers drops them)
fix: enum OwnerClaim { Unclaimed, Claimed(i64), Unsaved(i64) } that retries Unsaved on the next ingest, or set the marker only when owner_error is None

title: Trending emoji sets paging is four loose fields plus a Fetch, kept in step by hand
trigger: Emoji Sets box, Trending tab, scroll to the end, a page fails or the catalog refreshes
effect: trending_offset (written before the send in connect/emoji_sets.rs:552), trending_next_offset and trending_has_more (state apply), trending_total (state/domains/stickers/apply.rs:143) and lists.trending (Fetch<()>) describe one paged list; a failed page leaves trending_has_more true so every scroll event asks again, and offset 0 doubles as 'replace the list' in accept_trending_emoji_sets; the earn lists solved the same shape with PageLoad
fix: a PageLoad-style enum { Unasked, Loading{request, more}, Ready{next_offset, total}, Failed } for the trending list

title: keyword_emojis and animated_emoji(+_for) hold no request and no stage: answers are matched by purpose and stale ones are dropped only by take_purpose
trigger: type in the emoji panel search or the composer faster than TDLib answers
effect: dispatch_emoji_payload (emoji/mod.rs:448-451) and accept_animated_emoji (:489-499) write on purpose alone; they are right only because search_keyword_emojis / update_animated_emoji_suggestion drop the older pending entry first; query/animated_emoji_for are set before the send and a failed answer leaves 'asked' with no way to tell loading from none
fix: Fetch<(String, Vec<String>)> / Fetch<Option<StickerItem>> keyed by the RequestId, compared in the answer arm

title: EmojiPanel::open mirrors DialogKind::EmojiSets (open_box) and is written from three places
trigger: open Emoji Sets, switch account, demo path
effect: the box is open when open_box(DialogKind::EmojiSets) AND emoji.open agree: ui/emoji_sets.rs:46-55 sets both, close_emoji_sets clears only the session flag, connect/emoji_sets.rs:348 and :592/:611 also read or set it; a Farewell closer exists (settings_state.rs:152) but only because the flag lives in the Session
fix: one open state owned by the dialog host (OnScreen), with the driver asking it instead of reading a Session bool

title: ExportView {Shown, Hidden} is the old `hidden: bool` kept on ChatExport/AccountExport beside the export's own Progress stage
trigger: user presses Hide on the export box, then export settles
effect: result shows as a note; visibility is a second field next to the stage rather than part of it
fix: fold into the export's stage (e.g. Running{boxed: Shown|Hidden}, Settled{noted}) so Done clears it with the stage

title: A timed-out worker call leaves WorkerLink::handoff in Awaiting, holding the single request slot
trigger: account export: one TDLib call exceeds QUERY_TIMEOUT (300 s); export_chats swallows the Tdlib error and goes on to the next chat
effect: every later call waits behind the abandoned request (pump_export only takes a request when idle_or_cancelled) and can time out too, so the remaining chats are counted as failed
fix: on timeout the worker tells the link to abandon (Handoff::Abandoned) so the slot frees, or the timeout ends the export

title: A Tdlib error in the middle of a chat marks the whole chat failed after part of it was already written
trigger: a file call (getFile/downloadFile) times out or a name lookup errors in pass two, after earlier messages were pushed to result.json and flushed as HTML pages
effect: row says 'No messages' and failed_chats+1 while result.json holds a partial messages list and messages1..N html exist; summary and files disagree
fix: a per-chat outcome enum (Exported{messages}/Partial{messages,reason}/Failed) written to the row and summary; a file-call timeout becomes Skip::Unavailable instead of aborting the chat

title: AccountProgress (and Progress) carry per-stage fields beside the stage enum
trigger: export moves ChatsList -> Chats -> next chat
effect: found is meaningful only in ChatsList; chat_index/chat_count/chat_name/chat only in Chats; Progress.total stays from the previous chat while the next one is Collecting, done means read-count in Collecting and saved-count in Writing
fix: AccountStage::ChatsList{found} and AccountStage::Chats{index,count,name,chat}; Stage::Collecting{read} and Stage::Writing{done,total}

title: Non-test RefCell borrow()/borrow_mut() in LoadedFiles
trigger: none today: guards are short and nothing re-enters; Files::save and save_once call find then save
effect: would panic (BorrowMutError) if a future caller held a borrow across a call; panic-safety rule 6
fix: Cell-free cache owned by the worker (&mut) or try_borrow with fallback

title: TransferStage::Probing carries no RequestId; the probe's answer or error is matched by purpose (GiftExportProbe)
trigger: open Fragment (probe 1 out), then another gifts list opens (reset_for_owner drops the picker), open a new picker and Open Fragment (probe 2); probe 1's late error lands
effect: picker 2 leaves Probing early for the password box or security check, probe 2's answer is then ignored
fix: TransferStage::Probing(RequestId) compared in apply_gift_export_probe_error/answer like ExportSend::Out

title: GiftFlow answers are matched by PaymentsPurpose, not by the request the flow sent
trigger: start Upgrade or Resale on gift A (request out, flow stays open), pick gift B and open the same kind of flow; A's ok lands
effect: B's confirmation box closes without the user answering it
fix: GiftFlow variants carry Sending(RequestId) once sent and close only on that id (like TransferStage::Transferring)

title: GiftManageState::deleting is a second marker of the in-flight deleteGift beside hub.gifts_op, with no RequestId
trigger: delete a gift; its ok or error lands
effect: the answer takes whatever id is in the slot (matched by purpose); only gifts_op.is_mutating keeps a second delete from overwriting it
fix: ListOp::Mutating{request, target} carrying the gift id, or GiftFlow::Deleting{id, request}

title: SendGiftState::open: bool beside recipient/stage: closed-with-send-in-flight is a state kept by hand
trigger: open the send box, press Send, close the box before the answer
effect: recipient/gifts stay while open=false so the answer can still notice; stage resets happen in close_send_gift, open_send_gift_to and the answers separately
fix: SendGiftBox::{Closed, Open(dialog), Sending{request, dialog, shown: Shown|Hidden}}

title: AcquiredGifts and UpgradePreview answers are matched by purpose (gift_id), the Fetch in the map holds no RequestId
trigger: ask the bought gifts of auction X twice (retry after a failure); the first request's late answer or error lands after the second was sent
effect: a late error from the older request can mark a retried list Failed, or an older answer replaces newer data; reducer applies whatever arrives for that gift_id
fix: per-gift Fetch::Loading(RequestId) compared in apply_gift_market and apply_gift_market_error

title: A handler read that dies leaves the answer stale, so state() re-spawns a read on every draw
trigger: The settings page draws while the xdg-mime/registry read panics or the thread cannot spawn (settle(generation, None))
effect: settle puts the old answer back as Known(last) with its old `at` (or Empty with no answer); lookup() calls it stale again and start_refresh spawns another thread on each render, and each death wakes the watcher for another redraw
fix: Add a Stage::Failed{last, retry_after} (or stamp `at` on a failed settle) so a dead read is not re-sent from render

title: accept_result overwrites any non-Sending stage with Failed("") before checking it is Sending
trigger: accept_result called while stage is Loading, Quoted or Sent (callers guard with waits_for today, the type does not)
effect: The in-flight Loading request id, the quote or the Sent receipt is replaced by an empty failure with no note
fix: Match on &self.stage first and only replace it in the Sending arm

title: Launcher::Pending sticks forever when the badge worker thread cannot be spawned
trigger: spawn_guarded fails (thread limit) inside WORKER.call_once; the Once is spent and the result is ignored with `let _ =`
effect: request() sees Pending(asked)==unread and never hands the count over again; the Linux dock badge stays wrong until the count changes, and then Pending(new) sticks too
fix: Make a failed spawn answer Pending as Failed and reset the Once (or hold the worker in the stage)

title: Three layers track one fact (what the dock shows): LAST_SENT, INVALIDATED and Launcher
trigger: Any badge push
effect: LAST_SENT (UI dedupe) and Launcher::Delivered (worker dedupe) must be invalidated together by forget_pushed_badge by hand
fix: One BadgeStage owner (Idle/Pending/Delivered/Failed) used by both the platform push and the dedupe

title: GLYPHS_SAVED is set before the save runs and is never cleared
trigger: chat_list_drawn first call: swap(true) then the thread spawn fails, or the launch is locked (launch_lines SLOT still Empty) and the save writes nothing
effect: Glyph and line caches are never written this run; glyphs_pending() reports false though nothing was saved
fix: Enum Pending/Saving/Saved set by the saver on completion; Pending again on a failed spawn

title: Saved line layouts hold every account's chat names but are written to the last opened account's file
trigger: Open account A, switch to B (SLOT becomes Open(B)), quit: gpui_macos::line_cache::save writes the process-wide layouts, including A's chat names and previews, sealed with B's key; if A logged out (Forgotten) a later B open reopens the slot with A's text still in the cache
effect: A's chat names persist on disk under B's account folder after A's logout
fix: Clear the line cache on forget()/account switch, or key layouts per account

title: MEDIA_CACHE_SCOPE is process-wide, so scratch producers of a background account use the on-screen account's folder
trigger: Account A on screen starts a recording or webm decode on a worker; user switches to B (set_media_cache_scope(B)); the worker calls media_cache_base() later; also sweep_account_media_cache() on logout sweeps the scope at call time, not the account that logged out
effect: A's decrypted scratch lands in B's folder and is removed with B's, or B's logout misses A's; cross-account leak of decrypted media
fix: Pass the AccountKey (OfAccount) to media_cache_base callers instead of a global

title: A sweep that clears VERDICTS between a display check and its insert leaves a 60 s verdict for a removed file
trigger: sandboxed_display_path runs the uncached check, sweep_media_caches/sweep_account_media_cache clears the memo, the check then inserts a plain-file verdict with VERDICT_TTL_PLAIN
effect: The image path is accepted for up to 60 s after its file is gone
fix: Insert only if a sweep generation is unchanged

title: VenueBot::Resolving holds no request id; the answer is matched by purpose and the stage is reset by hand
trigger: open() resets Resolving/Missing/Failed to Unknown and set_venue_bot_username resets to Unknown while a searchPublicChat is out; the old answer (state/session_apply_chats.rs:73, media/error.rs:33 match LocationPickerPurpose::ResolveVenueBot only) then lands
effect: An answer for the old bot name sets Found(old bot) and venues come from the wrong bot until the next picker; a dropped lookup leaves Resolving (venue list Loading) until reopen
fix: VenueBot::Resolving{request: RequestId, username} matched on the answer, with its way out in the owner's transitions

title: A failed map tile is treated as known, so it is never requested again for that view
trigger: getMapThumbnailFile errors (TileState::Failed via file_answered(extra, None)); tile_to_request() only checks that the key exists in self.tiles
effect: The map stays blank at that view with no error or retry until the user pans or zooms to a different key
fix: Treat Failed as not loaded (drop it, with a backoff) or show a retry

title: A failed venue lookup is drawn as 'nothing found'
trigger: SearchVenues error or request_unsent: venues_failed sets AskStage::Failed and apply_venues(Vec::new())
effect: The list shows NothingFound with the query, no error and no Retry; only a new query or moving the pin asks again
fix: VenueList::Failed(reason) with a Retry

title: `moving` and `places_in_area` are bools kept in step with AddressStage::HiddenWhileMoving
trigger: move_started/move_ended flip moving, set places_in_area and rewrite address.stage by hand; address_resolved reads moving to pick HiddenWhileMoving or Shown
effect: Two sources for the pin being lifted
fix: Pin::{Resting, Moving} enum that owns the address stage

title: AwardMembers matches pages by a generation counter, not the RequestId; Loading carries neither
trigger: Failed page retried by begin_page() keeps the same generation, so a late answer of the failed send applies to the retry; begin_page does not check it is not already Loading
effect: A duplicate page for the same offset is applied twice (offset advances twice, members skipped)
fix: MembersStage::Loading{request: RequestId} matched in accept/fail

title: request_approval and subscription are two bools that exclude each other, beside locked_stars
trigger: toggle_approval clears subscription and toggle_subscription clears request_approval by hand; edit_link derives both from locked_stars
effect: Any new writer can set both true (approval and a fee together)
fix: enum LinkKind { Plain{approval}, Subscription{locked_stars} }

title: ResaleSearch::page and CraftSession::candidates_page count pages in step with PageLoad; the answer is matched by the request id, page only rides in the purpose
trigger: connect/gift_market.rs:115-121 resets page with next_offset and bumps it after a send; nothing reads it to match an answer
effect: A second page counter that can drift from load/next_offset
fix: Drop the counters; the offset and PageLoad::Loading{request} are enough

title: ResaleBuy keeps step, pay_in_grams, price_changed and phase as separate fields changed together
trigger: A PriceIncreased answer sets price_changed and only ever sets pay_in_grams true (apply_gift_market_purchase); ui/gift_resale_buy.rs:77 resets both
effect: A Stars price change after a Grams pick leaves pay_in_grams true while price() returns the Stars price
fix: BuyStage enum: View, Send, Confirm{currency/price}, Sending{request}

title: Premium winners/months and Stars option/winners are pairs kept consistent by settle_* functions
trigger: Options arrive after the form opens; settle_premium/settle_stars run from the driver
effect: A writer that skips settle leaves a pair no option offers (validate() then NoOption)
fix: PrizeChoice::{Premium{option}, Stars{option, winners}} picked from the offered list

title: LOCAL is an Option<Option<Arc<Snapshot>>>: three stages in two nested Options
trigger: Tests call isolate_thread(); install/current branch on is_some()/take() of the outer and inner Option
effect: Not-isolated, isolated-English and isolated-pack are told apart only by nesting
fix: enum ThreadStrings { Shared, Isolated(Option<Arc<Snapshot>>) }

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut in utc_offset_at
trigger: The offset lookup (OS call) re-enters utc_offset_at on the same thread
effect: BorrowMutError panic on the UI thread; none today since os_utc_offset_at does not call back
fix: Use try_borrow_mut and fall back to the lookup, or a Cell<(i64, i32)>

title: A device probe that times out is read as an empty list, so the picked device silently becomes the default
trigger: ffmpeg -sources/-list_devices takes over 3 s (capture_within -> None -> unwrap_or_default) while a non-default camera or microphone is picked
effect: Recording starts on the system default device, not the pick, and the UI thread waited up to 3 s per probe
fix: Return Result, show 'could not list devices' and keep the pick; run the probe off the UI thread

title: linux_audio_backend memoizes the first probe for the process, even when it timed out or ffmpeg was missing
trigger: First capture with ffmpeg missing or slow: stdout_within returns None, pick_audio_backend("") returns "pulse" and the LazyLock keeps it
effect: ALSA-only machines fail every later capture until restart
fix: Cache only a successful probe

title: Test uses a real 100 ms timeout and a `sleep 30` child
trigger: stderr_within_returns_output_and_gives_up_on_a_stuck_command
effect: Wall-clock wait in a test (AGENTS.md rule: no sleeps or timeouts)
fix: Inject a manual clock/fake child

title: Test polls with thread::sleep until the tombstone thread finishes
trigger: sweep_removes_dirs_at_once_and_tombstones_in_background
effect: Wall-clock wait in a test (AGENTS.md rule)
fix: Join the sweep thread or make the sweep injectable

title: Test sleeps 20 ms to let the consumer thread block
trigger: latest_slot_wakes_a_blocked_consumer
effect: Wall-clock wait in a test (AGENTS.md rule)
fix: Use a channel handshake instead of a sleep

title: The start-in-tray reveal watcher is a detached task whose `waited` counter lives in the closure
trigger: --start-minimized: the poll loop runs until tray_startup_reveal answers or the window dies
effect: The stage (waiting for the tray host, revealed, gave up) is not held by an owner and cannot be cancelled by a lock or settings change
fix: Hold the Task in the tray owner's stage (Registering{task}, Ready, GaveUp)

title: Shared Media viewer re-asks the older page from render after it failed (request loop)
trigger: Open the viewer from a Shared Media tab near the loaded start (index < 6, total > loaded); the older page fails (offline or flood). media_viewer_panel calls sync_shared_media_viewer on every chrome render, wants_older() stays true, and fetch_more_shared_media -> begin_fetch_more -> start_more accepts NextPage::Failed (more_askable matches Idle | Failed), so it re-sends
effect: A searchChatMessages request goes out on every redraw of the viewer (mouse move, controls fade, clock tick) while the page keeps failing; the doc on NextPage::Failed says nothing asks again on its own
fix: wants_older asks only when the tab status is NextPage::Idle (viewer reads the stage); Failed is retried only by an explicit Load more

title: Profile photo viewer re-sends the next page on every poll tick after a failed page
trigger: Open a profile photo gallery near the loaded end (index+48 >= len, total > len, has_more); the getUserProfilePhotos/searchChatPhotos page fails. session_profile_panels sets next_page back to PhotoPage::Idle, pump_profile_gallery (poll_drains) runs sync_profile_photo_viewer each cycle, wants_more_photos() is still true, fetch_more_photos sends again
effect: Request is re-sent every poll cycle for as long as the viewer is open and the server keeps failing; no error shown
fix: PhotoPage gets a Failed(error) stage (or Fetch<T>) that the viewer does not auto-retry; retry on explicit action

title: A not-found result for ffmpeg/ffprobe is cached for the whole process
trigger: Start Quill without ffmpeg, let warm_up run, then install ffmpeg (or fix PATH) and start a video message or camera recording
effect: candidates() cached an empty Vec in RESOLVED, resolve() returns the bare name and is_installed() stays false, so 'ffmpeg isn't installed' keeps showing until restart
fix: cache only non-empty results (or a Fetch-like Missing stage that is re-probed when the user retries)

title: u32 width*height*4 can overflow in flip_rgba and rotate_rgba_quarter_turns
trigger: Rotate or flip a decoded picture whose width*height*4 exceeds u32::MAX (about 32768x32768) in a debug build; release wraps and the length check then misfires
effect: panic (debug) or wrong length check
fix: use usize::checked_mul / u64 for the pixel count

title: Shared::info and Shared::at are two Options always written together
trigger: worker writes both in the same lock; at is None only before the first update, and position_us treats (info Some, at None) as not moved
effect: none today; a writer that sets one without the other extrapolates from the wrong time
fix: one Option<(NowPlaying, Instant)> like mod.rs LAST

title: BoundedStages keeps map and order queue in step by hand; a re-set key leaves a stale queue entry that evicts the live one
trigger: note() an effect message, then mark_watched() it: remove() takes it out of the map only, set() queues the key again, so the queue holds it twice. When the map passes MAX_HELD the stale first entry is popped and removes the live Watched entry; the order.retain shed keeps duplicates of live keys
effect: A message whose effect already played is forgotten early (about half the stated bound under churn) and a later history page notes it unread, so its effect plays again
fix: one insertion-ordered map (IndexMap or a generation counter per key) so the queue cannot hold a stale or duplicate key

title: Admin delete box fires the moderation plan and drops its error, then deletes the message anyway
trigger: In the admin delete box tick Ban or Report spam and confirm while the connection is down (or a send fails on step 2 of the plan); selection_mode.rs calls `let _ = live.driver.moderate_message(..)` and then confirm_delete
effect: The message is deleted but the report, delete-all or ban was never sent (or only the first steps were) with no error and the box closed; retrying repeats the steps already sent
fix: a Moderation stage per box holding the plan and the RequestId of the step out; the delete waits for it and an error gives the box back

title: EffectLookup::Loading does not hold its RequestId; the answer is matched by effect id
trigger: A getMessageEffect ask is dropped by a reconnect (forget_dropped re-opens it and it is asked again); the old ask then answers with an error
effect: The stale error turns the live Loading into Waiting, delaying the described effect by 5 s and doubling the failure count
fix: Loading { request: RequestId, failures } and fail/accept apply only when the answer's request matches

title: PiP geometry uses plain i32 arithmetic on a position read from disk
trigger: A damaged saved PipPosition (huge geometry or screen) reaches clamp_to_edges, transformed, constrained, finish_drag or place_on_screen, which add and subtract i32 without saturating (screen.right() - geometry.w, r.x += dx, original.w - size.w)
effect: debug builds panic on overflow; release wraps and places the window far off screen
fix: saturating_add/sub in these helpers, as right() and inset() already do

title: call_seconds total adds with unchecked `+=` on i64 from TDLib durations
trigger: networkStatistics with huge call durations summed per group
effect: wraps silently in release (negative call time) / overflow panic in debug; panic-safety rule 5
fix: saturating_add

title: NotificationOutcome carries `clicked: bool` and `action: Option` that must agree (clicked == action.is_some())
trigger: any construction of NotificationOutcome that sets one without the other
effect: none today (single constructor sets both); two fields kept in step by hand
fix: drop `clicked`, derive from action.is_some() or make the outcome Option<NotificationAction>

title: thread-local RefCell borrow_mut held across UnreadMemo::get, which walks every chat via tray::badge_count
trigger: any re-entrant call to total_unread from inside badge_count (none today)
effect: BorrowMutError panic if badge counting ever calls total_unread; rule 6 (non-test RefCell borrow_mut spanning another module)
fix: compute outside the borrow (take the memo out, compute, put back) or use a Mutex-free copy of the key

title: persist() spawns its writer with std::thread::Builder instead of spawn_guarded
trigger: a panic inside with_file/write_json_atomic on the quill-notify-volumes thread
effect: panic not caught/logged by the shared guard (rule 11); spawn failure silently dropped so the volume is not saved
fix: crate::thread_guard::spawn_guarded

title: PaidGuard::screen fails open when its mutex is poisoned: the request is returned unscreened (and set_state silently skips)
trigger: a panic while the guard's State mutex is held, then any paid-chat send
effect: a send to a chat that charges Stars goes out without the user's confirmation, or with stale prices; contradicts the module's 'nothing is ever sent with a price the user has not agreed to'
fix: lock_or_recover (state is plain maps) so the screen still runs

title: unchecked i64 multiplication price*messages (also HeldSend::total line 44, PaidConfirm::total in paid_messages.rs:334)
trigger: huge price from TDLib times album/forward count
effect: wraps silently in release: the total written to paid_message_star_count or shown in the confirm box is wrong (rule 5)
fix: saturating_mul

title: PaidMessages::trust and trust_file are two public fields that must change together: every trust.trust()/forget() needs a hand-called trust_changed()
trigger: a caller that mutates `trust` (public field) and forgets trust_changed(), e.g. ui/paid_messages_tests.rs does; remember_paid_trust calls both by hand
effect: the trusted price is changed in memory but never written; the next start asks again (or keeps a price the user revoked)
fix: make trust private and expose trust()/forget() methods on PaidMessages that set TrustFile::Dirty themselves

title: PaidSave::begin overwrites an in-flight Saving(request) for the same target; the send-failure arm then clear()s the target, dropping the older save too
trigger: Remove Fee / Direct Messages Save pressed twice for one target (second send fails), or two boxes for the same user
effect: the target reads idle while the first request is still out; its error line is lost (fail() finds no Saving(request)) so a refused save shows nothing
fix: begin returns Err/ignored when the target is already Saving, or keep the older request and clear only the new one

title: PendingPaid::stars is 'the total of taps': two fields kept in step by hand in add and rollback
trigger: any new edit path that changes taps without stars
effect: none today; toast and balance reservation would drift from the taps
fix: derive stars from taps.iter().sum()

title: unchecked i64 `entry.stars += stars`, `p.stars -= tap.stars` and `now_ms + ACCUMULATE_MS`
trigger: extreme star counts / clock
effect: wrap in release (rule 5); negative total would remove the entry
fix: saturating_add/sub

title: A commit that cannot be sent or is refused (and a refused Undo) drops the local PendingPaid, but TDLib still holds the pending Stars from addPendingPaidMessageReaction
trigger: tap a Star reaction, commit send fails or TDLib answers an error to commit or remove (src/connect/paid_reaction.rs:118, state/domains/payments/error.rs:136-155)
effect: UI says 'Stars not sent' / no Undo toast, but the next Star tap on that message makes TDLib commit the old total plus the new one: Stars spent that the user was told were released
fix: on commit_unsent/refused keep an explicit Stage::Stuck(total) (or send removePending... and track that request) instead of forgetting the entry

title: PasskeysState::error is one free-floating Option<String> holding the failure of three different stages (list fetch, removal, registration), set and cleared by hand beside PasskeyList::Failed, removing and add
trigger: a removal fails, then Create Passkey is pressed; or a registration fails, then the list refetches (accept_list clears it); ui/security/passkeys.rs:229 and :246 clear it by hand from the delete confirmation
effect: an error line from one operation shows under another or lingers until an unrelated list answer clears it; PasskeyList::Failed has no reason of its own so `error` and the variant can disagree
fix: put the reason in the stage that failed (Failed{reason}, Removal::Failed, PasskeyAdd::Failed) and drop the shared field

title: PasskeysState::removing (Option<Removal>) is a one-at-a-time stage kept beside PasskeysState::list and generation: finish_remove must set removing=None, list=Stale and generation+1 together
trigger: any new exit from a removal (ok, error, lost) that clears removing but not the list or generation
effect: none today; UI reads removing.is_some() as 'busy' (ui/security/passkeys.rs:291,456,547) separately from the list stage
fix: fold the removal into PasskeyList (Removing{passkey, request, basis}) so the list stage and the removal are one value

title: CreationAsker{Dialog,Closed} is a two-variant enum beside NewChatCreation::outcome (None = in flight): the 'owner closed' flag of the create, and open_when_created/make_invite_link are bools copied from the kind
trigger: close the dialog while a create is out, or a create that is lost (request swept, never answered)
effect: a Closed create whose request is lost and never answered keeps its `creations` row for the session (abandon_new_chat only removes answered rows); the real stage (InFlight/Answered/Abandoned) is spread over asker and outcome
fix: enum CreationStage { InFlight{owner: Dialog|Closed}, Created(ChatId), Refused{..} } so abandoning is a transition and a lost request removes the row

title: For a supergroup/channel the Type step is shown from NewChatStage::Creating{progress: Created} until the first Save; NewChatStage::Type{save: Editing} is only reached after a refusal, so one step has two stage values
trigger: create a channel, then press Skip/Esc or Save on the type step: set_new_chat_stage swaps Creating for Subscribers/Type and abandons the create at that moment
effect: the create request id stays held by the stage while the user edits the link; Type{Editing} and Creating{Created} mean the same thing
fix: move to NewChatStage::Type{chat, save: Editing} as soon as the create is answered, and drop the request id there

title: GateFetch::Asking carries a time but not the RequestId (or the Premium state) of its ask; the answer is matched by user id only and stamped with the viewer's Premium at answer time
trigger: ask canSendMessageToUser as a non-Premium viewer, buy (or lose) Premium while it is out (updateOption is_premium), or let the 30 s ASK_TIMEOUT re-ask while the first request is still out
effect: an answer computed for the old Premium state is recorded as Known under the new one (record_answer in state/session_privacy_data.rs:132), so the composer gate is wrong until the 5 min refresh or the next Premium change; a late first answer overwrites the second
fix: Asking{request: RequestId, at, viewer_premium, before}; apply the answer only when its request id is the one held, with the Premium it was asked under

title: price_steps does `current + 10` / `current + 100` and step_for_price does `(*step - price).abs()` on i64 values from the server or a saved price without saturating
trigger: a saved price near i64::MAX or i64::MIN (corrupt option or hand-edited data)
effect: wraps in release (wrong slider steps), overflow panic in debug; rule 5
fix: saturating_add / saturating_sub + unsigned_abs

title: unlock() ignores a failed save of the bad-try counter (`let _ = save_config`), and the counter lives only in passcode.json that every attempt re-reads
trigger: passcode.json cannot be written (read-only folder, full disk) and a wrong passcode is typed repeatedly
effect: bad_tries never advances, so the tdesktop 5-30 s flood schedule never applies: unlimited guesses at PBKDF2 speed; the same swallowed error resets bad_tries on success
fix: keep the counter in memory too (UnlockState) and fail the attempt with PasscodeError::Io when the write fails

title: PeerQrBox::chosen (bool latch: stop following the saved theme) lives beside served, save: SaveStage and save_serial; lose_rights, picked and save() each reset or read it by hand together with save/served
trigger: a pick, then Sync with can_save=false (lose_rights sets chosen=false and re-shows served but leaves save untouched), then a new pick
effect: none found today; chosen, save.failed and served must be kept consistent by hand in picked/lose_rights/save
fix: one enum Theme{Following, Picked{choice, save: SaveStage}} where serial lives in SaveStage::Out

title: FreeUi::Requesting{request} does not hold the serial that matches its answer: FreeState::serial is a separate counter compared in PeerQrBox::free_answer, and drop_pending resets the stage by hand from sync/free_answer
trigger: sync() drops a pending permanent request (drop_pending) and a new request of the same kind starts before the old answer arrives
effect: works today because the serial is bumped in request(); the stage and the serial must be changed together by hand
fix: FreeUi::Requesting{ticket: FreeTicket} so the stage holds what its answer must carry

title: ThemeGifts keeps requested_at, serial and offset beside GiftsStage, and they are only meaningful in First/Listed(Loading); start/fail/refuse/accept change them together by hand
trigger: any new transition that changes stage without updating requested_at (fail() reads it to compute Waiting{at})
effect: none today; a failed page could schedule its retry from a stale requested_at
fix: GiftsRest::Loading{serial, requested_at} (and First{serial, requested_at}) so they live and die with the stage

title: baseline: FieldResult::finished (with invalid) mirrors Validation{state, finished}: two bools restating a ValidationState
trigger: a validator that returns finished with an Invalid state
effect: none today (all validators pair them correctly); focus-advance reads `finished`, the error style reads `invalid`
fix: carry Validation (state + Finished enum) through FieldResult instead of two bools

title: baseline: Validation::finished is a bool beside Validation::state; 'finished' is only legal with Valid
trigger: Validation::new(ValidationState::Invalid, true) is representable
effect: none today; every constructor sets it correctly
fix: enum Validation{Invalid, Incomplete, Valid{finished: bool}} or Valid/ValidFull

title: Open flags stars_open, gifts_open (and GramsHub::open) sit beside the dialog host and the stage state; each closer resets a different subset by hand
trigger: Open Stars, pick a transaction, close; open Received gifts, close; compare what close_stars/close_gifts/close_grams reset (tx_selected, gift_view, selected, withdraw) versus what stays (gifts_owner, gifts, tx stage)
effect: No bug today; the box open state has two sources (flag and DialogKind host) and a new field must be added to each closer by hand
fix: Derive open from the dialog host (DialogKind) and keep only data in the hub, or one enum StarsScreen/GiftsScreen/GramsScreen {Closed, Open(state)} replaced whole on close

title: Received-gifts list is eight fields kept in step by hand (owner, rows, total, cursor, page stage, notice, view, op); open_received_gifts clears them field by field and close_gifts clears only gift_view
trigger: Open gifts of user A, close, open gifts of chat B: open_received_gifts clears gifts, total, offset, page, notice, view one by one; after close_gifts the old owner and rows stay in the hub and gifts_are_mine() still answers for A
effect: No wrong output found today; any new field added to the list is stale across owners until someone adds it to open_received_gifts
fix: One GiftsScreen { owner, list: Listing<..>, view: GiftView, op: ListOp } value replaced whole when the owner changes or the box closes

title: Stars history is filter, rows, cursor, page stage, selection and balance kept in step by hand; set_star_transactions_filter resets five of them one by one
trigger: Switch the Stars tab All -> Incoming while a page is loading: filter, transactions, tx_offset, tx_selected and tx are each written at the call site (connect/premium_hub.rs set_star_transactions_filter); close_stars resets only tx_selected
effect: No wrong output found today; a new per-filter field is stale after a tab switch unless added at that call site
fix: StarsHistory { filter, list: Listing<StarTx> (rows, cursor, stage), selected } replaced whole on a filter change

title: premium_state is an Option with no stage: its request is fire-and-forget, an error answer is not handled, and the answer is matched by purpose, not request id
trigger: Open the Premium dialog while getPremiumState fails (offline blip, flood wait) but getPremiumFeatures succeeds; maybe_fetch_premium only asks again from premium.can_ask(), which is false once features are Ready
effect: premium_state stays None for the whole session: the Subscribe button loses the monthly price and plans, is_subscribed falls back to my_is_premium; it is also never refreshed after the user subscribes
fix: premium_state: Fetch<PremiumStateInfo> (or inside the same Fetch as features) with the request id in Loading, retried like premium_stickers, invalidated when Premium status changes

title: promo_request is a one-shot slot cleared only by the window that shows the ad's chat; if no window shows that chat it stays
trigger: Report a sponsored message that needs Premium (reducer sets promo_request), close the chat or window before the next frame; open the same chat later
effect: The Premium preview opens unprompted when the chat is next shown, or never if the chat is never shown again
fix: Give PromoRequest an owner (window/chat) and drop it with the chat's ChatUi or after one frame; or open the preview directly from the reducer's event queue

title: Grams peer lookup is four sets plus a counter kept in step: asked_users/asked_chats and missing_users/missing_chats (missing is a subset of asked) and peers_checked
trigger: A history row names an unknown user: connect/grams.rs grams_tick inserts into asked_users on send, the error arm inserts into missing_users; restart() resets peers_checked but leaves the four sets
effect: No bug found; per-peer stage (Unasked, Asked, Missing) is spread over two sets, and peers_checked must be reset with the list by hand
fix: HashMap<PeerKey, PeerAsk { Asked(RequestId), Missing }> plus the checked cursor inside the list value

title: Grams peer answers are matched by purpose (PeerUser/PeerChat) and a user id smuggled in PendingRequest.chat_id (ChatId(user_id)), not by a RequestId held in a stage
trigger: A history row names an unknown user; grams_tick sends getUser with send_grams_for(PeerUser, Some(ChatId(user_id))); apply_grams_error reads pending.chat_id as the user id
effect: A user id travels as a ChatId; any code that treats chat_id of a pending request as a chat (e.g. owner cleanup by chat) would act on the wrong object; the ask is also marked asked at send, not tied to its request
fix: PeerAsk::Asked(RequestId) in the peer map; the reducer compares the answer's id, and the key is an owner key (UserId) not a ChatId

title: A failed Settings balance probe is never asked again in the session: probe Failed is treated as asked, and the answer is matched by purpose only
trigger: Open Settings while the connection is flaky so getTonTransactions(limit 1) errors; grams_tick only probes while probe.is_idle(); reopen Settings later
effect: A user with a Grams balance never gets the My Grams row until restart (documented as intended, but the skip reason is avoiding a loop, not that the failure is final)
fix: Fetch::Failed re-asks on the next Settings open (not from the tick), with the RequestId in Loading and the reducer matching it

title: Collect box is withdraw: Option<GramWithdraw> beside withdraw_outcome: Option<WithdrawOutcome> (a one-shot slot for the UI) and the open flag; the outcome is cleared only when the password dialog's sync runs
trigger: Submit the password; the answer sets withdraw=None and withdraw_outcome=Some(Url) in the reducer; the UI takes it in grams_withdraw.rs sync (grams_mut().withdraw_outcome.take()); close_grams sets withdraw=None but does not clear a pending outcome
effect: No bug found; if the outcome lands in a frame where the dialog sync does not run (Grams closed in between), it waits and opens Fragment later
fix: GramWithdraw::{Password, SecurityCheck, Done(url), TooSmall} in one value taken once by its owner, cleared by close_grams

title: GramWithdraw::Password carries request: Option<RequestId> and error: Option<ExportError>; Idle is request None, Sending is request Some, and the error can sit beside a request
trigger: Submit with a wrong password (error Some), then submit again: submit_gram_withdrawal writes a new Password{request: Some, error: None} by hand; sending() and can_submit() are derived from the Option
effect: No bug today; Option used as a started flag, the two Options must be reset together at each write site
fix: Password { stage: Idle{error} | Sending(RequestId) }

title: GiftValueStage::Ready { open: bool } is the box-open flag in disguise: whether the box shows is also decided by the dialog host (DialogKind::GiftValue), and drop_orphaned_gift_value resets the slot to None from window upkeep, outside the stage's own transitions
trigger: Tap learn more on gift A (Loading), close A's box before the answer; drop_orphaned_gift_value (window_upkeep) sets hub.gift_value=None when !is_open && info().is_none(); Loading, Failed and Ready{open:false} all look the same to it
effect: Open state lives in two places; the by-hand reset in upkeep can drop a Loading/Failed lookup that a second window or the resale box still wants
fix: Stage Open(Loading|Failed|Ready) vs Closed(Known(info)) as one enum owned by the box host, dropped by the box's own close

title: LimitStore keeps each kind's stage in two parallel Vecs: answered (pair) and asked (Asked(request)/Refused), kept in step by hand
trigger: ensure_premium_limit: should_ask() reads both; apply_premium_limit retains out of both; note_asked/forget_asked/fail_ask edit asked alone
effect: No bug found; Unasked/Asked/Refused/Answered is derived from two collections, and an entry can be answered and asked until apply_premium_limit removes the ask
fix: HashMap<PremiumLimitKind, LimitState { Asked(RequestId), Refused, Answered(LimitPair) }>

title: CameraStream's stage is two AtomicBools (done, stop) plus child: Mutex<Option<Child>>: running, ended by ffmpeg, stopping are not one value
trigger: Unplug the camera: the reader thread sets done; or drop the panel: Drop sets stop and takes the child; done is also set when the thread exits because of stop, so finished() reads true for both
effect: No bug found; finished() cannot tell ffmpeg ended from owner stopped, and the child is held until Drop even after done
fix: Atomic u8 stage Running/Ended/Stopping (or a channel carrying one enum) read by the panel

title: Ping stage is split: PingStatus::Checking has no request id, the id lives in SettingsState::proxy_ping_requests, and the rotation's Probing{id} waits on pings[id]==Checking
trigger: Rotation probes proxy 2 (pings[2]=Checking, proxy_ping_requests[2]=r); the proxy list is refetched and pings are retained by id, but proxy_ping_requests is not; an answer is matched through the second map, a lost answer leaves Checking and the rotation waiting
effect: Auto-switch can wait on a Checking entry whose request was dropped (no timeout in rotation_step for Probing); the two maps can disagree after a list refetch or an edit
fix: PingStatus::Checking(RequestId) in one map; Probing carries the same RequestId and rotation_step compares it, with a timeout via the manual clock

title: ProxyFetch and ProxyMutation are two enums for one list that must change together (a mutation's success drops a Loading fetch and sets Stale; busy() joins them); ProxyMutation is a two-variant Idle/InFlight enum beside the fetch stage
trigger: Add a proxy while the first getProxies is out: proxy_mutation_succeeded overwrites fetch with Stale by hand, dropping the Loading request; mutation failure leaves fetch alone
effect: No bug found; correctness depends on every reducer writing both enums in the right order (FailedStale/Stale exist to patch gaps)
fix: ListOp-style ProxyList { stage: Idle|Loading(id)|Stale|Failed, op: Option<RequestId> } with transitions in one impl

title: LinkCheck::Done(PingStatus) can hold PingStatus::Checking, so the finished stage can say still checking
trigger: Type-level only: settle_link_check writes Done(Available|Unavailable); nothing prevents Done(Checking)
effect: No bug found
fix: Done(Result<u32 ms, ()>) or two variants Available(ms)/Unavailable on LinkCheck

title: Pinned-row drag is PinStage::Dragging(PinDrag{reorder}) and PinReorder.stage Dragging/Dropped: held vs sliding is a second stage nested under the first (src/pin_reorder.rs:77)
trigger: Release a dragged pinned chat: pin.reorder.release() flips the inner stage to Dropped while PinStage stays Dragging until settle() runs; callers check reorder.dragging().is_none() to tell the two
effect: No bug found; the same fact is two values and callers must consult both
fix: PinStage::{Idle, Pressed, Dragging(PinDrag), Sliding(PinDrag)} with the inner stage removed

title: validate_at adds now + POLL_DEADLINE_MIN_SECS and now + close_max unchecked; close_max comes from TDLib's poll_open_period_max option
trigger: TDLib reports a very large poll_open_period_max (i64 near MAX) and a date > 0 deadline is validated: now + close_max overflows (debug panic, release wrap that accepts a past deadline)
effect: Panic in debug builds, wrong validation in release; unlikely with real server values
fix: saturating_add for both sums

title: PsaAbout reader and writer use std::thread::spawn, which panics when the OS cannot start a thread
trigger: Open a promoted chat (start_load) or show the box (save_unsaved) under thread exhaustion
effect: the app panics instead of skipping the load or save
fix: thread_guard::spawn_guarded as the other helpers do; Load/Save fall back on Err

title: Load::Reading has no way out if the read thread never leaves its flags in the slot
trigger: The read thread panics before it stores (or the slot mutex is poisoned): Load stays Reading, poll_load returns false for ever
effect: a chat opened meanwhile sits in Toast::Waiting and never gets its one-time box; every later chat waits too (is_loaded false)
fix: Load::Reading carries a RequestId/Task and a Failed arm that becomes Done(empty)

title: Toast::Waiting(chat) is only valid while load != Done, kept in step by hand across two fields (load, toast)
trigger: restore() runs (demo or test path) while a chat waits: load = Done, toast stays Waiting with nothing left to resolve it unless poll_load also runs
effect: the waiting chat gets no box; the state has no owner for the Waiting stage
fix: one stage enum: Loading{waiting: Option<ChatId>} | Loaded{toast}

title: SaveState goes back to InSync before the write result is known and merge_save drops its error
trigger: Disk full or read-only app folder when the box is shown: save_unsaved marks InSync, the thread's write fails
effect: the seen flag is lost and the one-time box shows again next run; never retried
fix: SaveState::{InSync, Unsaved, Writing(task)} with Unsaved restored when the write fails

title: Pull holds stage flags reached, committed and holding beside Stage::Pulling: Pulling -> Reached -> Committed are three bools set by hand in handle() and frame()
trigger: A pull passes the threshold (reached), is released (committed); reached is cleared in handle on reverse and peak is reset next to it by hand
effect: every reader re-derives the stage from three flags and peak/has_next that must change together
fix: Stage::Pulling{Stretching, Ready{peak}, Released{ready}} instead of flags in Pull

title: ExpandRun::{Settled, Running} is a two-variant enum beside expand: Tween, whose animating(now) already says whether a frame is owed
trigger: start_expand sets Running, frame() clears it from expand.animating; reset() clears it by hand
effect: the stage is the old expand-running bool in disguise next to the Tween that owns the answer
fix: drop ExpandRun and read Tween::animating, or hold the Tween in an Option that ends when done

title: dwell_due: Option<u64> is a timer stage kept beside Pull.reached/amount and cleared by hand in handle(), frame() and reset()
trigger: Pull crosses the threshold with the finger down: dwell_due set; release or retreat clears it in three places
effect: a missed clear leaves a due dwell that marks a later pull reached (frame re-checks amount, so it is guarded by hand)
fix: Pull stage Stretching{dwell_due: Option<u64>} so the timer lives and dies with the stage

title: Watch::Watching has no way out when the watcher thread dies without calling ended()
trigger: The zbus watcher thread panics (spawn_guarded catches it) or is killed: Watch stays Watching, start_if_due never returns true again
effect: the screen-reader value stays at its last stored (or false) value for the rest of the run and is never re-read
fix: Watch::Watching holds the thread's JoinHandle/completion guard, so a dropped thread moves it to Ended

title: GlobalSearchFilters spreads one tab over scope, media and chat_type; SearchTab::of/apply keep them in step by hand and other writers set scope alone
trigger: search_hashtag (connect/search/mod.rs:353) and global_tag_search set filters.scope directly while media/chat_type stay from the tab the user was on
effect: impossible combinations (scope=PublicPosts with media=Photos, scope=Apps with chat_type=Channels) are representable; SearchTab::of silently ignores the extra field
fix: store SearchTab (plus date/archived) as the one value and derive scope/media/chat_type from it

title: rename_account does load, edit and save without the update_registry lock
trigger: Rename an account while a background removal finishes (finish_pending_delete) or another thread writes accounts.json
effect: The rename saves a stale registry over the other writer's change: a finished removal's pending record or a just-removed account can come back, or the other edit is lost
fix: Route rename_account through update_registry like every other writer (the doc on update_registry says it is the one way to write the list)

title: UI-thread spelling menu blocks on the dictionary parse lock
trigger: Start Quill or change the spelling languages, then right-click a word in the composer before the warm-up thread has parsed a large dictionary
effect: checker.is_correct and checker.suggestions (ui/spellcheck_ui.rs:557,565) call Entry::dict, which waits on the Mutex<Load> held for the whole parse, so the window freezes for the parse time (seconds for the big European dictionaries); the module doc says the UI thread never blocks on the parse
fix: Make the UI-thread path try_lock the Load and treat a parse in progress as a new Load::Parsing stage that answers no verdict or no suggestions

title: Timed-out spelling jobs stay queued on the COM thread and the UI thread waits up to 750 ms per call
trigger: Windows: open the suggestion menu repeatedly while the COM thread loads a cold dictionary or is stuck
effect: Each suggestions call blocks the UI up to CALL_WAIT, and every abandoned job still runs later on an unbounded channel, so a backlog builds and later answers are late
fix: Drop a job whose answer channel is gone before running it, and carry a generation or cancel token in Job

title: single_instance tests wait with wall-clock recv_timeout
trigger: Run the single_instance tests (lines 749, 755, 785)
effect: AGENTS.md says tests use no timeouts or wall-clock waits; these tests use rx.recv_timeout(Duration::from_secs(5)) on real sockets, so a hang is a 5 s wait and a slow machine can flake
fix: Block on recv with the fake clock and heartbeat already in the file, or drive the owner through the Launched helper

title: baseline: AppearancePrefs::ignore_battery_saving
trigger: Listed in scripts/implicit-state-baseline.txt
effect: A user setting (tdesktop ignoreBatterySaving) that matches the stage word list; it is read beside power_saving and the battery state
fix: Move it to scripts/implicit-state-allow.txt with the reason (a user setting), or fold it with power_saving into one PowerSaving value

title: Wallpaper source is wallpaper_rgb plus telegram_wallpaper, kept in step by hand
trigger: Pick a preset color (ui/appearance/new_accent_picker.rs:93,107 clears telegram_wallpaper), then apply a Telegram wallpaper (ui/wallpaper_preview.rs:265 sets it and clears the color)
effect: Both fields can hold a value at once (rgb Some and telegram true); the reader filters wallpaper_rgb with !telegram_wallpaper (new_accent_picker.rs:80), and a site that forgets the pairing shows a stale color chip or wallpaper
fix: enum WallpaperSource { Theme, Color(u32), Telegram } serialized with the same keys

title: Skip 04-085 does not hold: theme, day_theme, night_theme, auto_night and follow_omarchy are written together
trigger: choose_app_theme (ui/app_theme/mod.rs:370-385) sets follow_omarchy=false, the day or night slot, theme (Light or Dark) and, when it would switch straight back, auto_night=Off in one closure; resolve_app_theme reads follow_omarchy before theme_for(night)
effect: The skip says they are separate settings, but one action must change four of them in step, and its reason leans on 'about 150 readers rest on them' (effort). A site that writes one without the others leaves night mode, the slot and the theme choice disagreeing
fix: A ThemeSource { Omarchy, Slots { night_mode: NightMode, day, night } } with the file keys kept by a serde adapter

title: tdesktop WorkMode held as show_tray_icon, show_taskbar_icon and minimize_to_tray bools
trigger: Toggle the tray or taskbar switch (ui/tray_settings.rs:70-100 writes both bools from work_mode::toggle_tray/toggle_taskbar), or set minimize_to_tray with the tray icon off
effect: The combination both-off must be refused by the toggle helpers, and run-in-background only means something with a tray icon; the pairing lives in pure helpers and the tray_setting_switches gate, not in the type
fix: enum WorkMode { TrayOnly, TaskbarOnly, Both } plus CloseBehavior { Quit, RunInBackground } with the file keys kept by a serde adapter

title: remember_media_grouping and group_media are one choice held as two bools
trigger: MediaPrefs::default_grouping returns group_media only when remember_media_grouping is on, else true
effect: group_media is stored and edited even while remembering is off and then ignored; the composer must write it only when remembering is on
fix: enum MediaGrouping { AlwaysGrouped, Remembered { grouped: bool } }

title: Download stage is a raw AtomicU8 with RUNNING/CANCELLING/FINISHED constants beside received and the UI's DictDownload
trigger: ui/spell_dictionaries.rs starts a download: DictDownload::Running holds the Progress, whose stage the worker and the UI poll loop read
effect: The stage is a number, not an enum, and is_cancelled turns false once FINISHED, so the UI cannot tell a cancelled finish from a completed one except by the DownloadError it awaits; the stage is mirrored by DictDownload and RowDownload
fix: A #[repr(u8)] enum DownloadStage with TryFrom<u8>, loaded through one accessor, or a channel carrying Cancelled/Finished

title: A download cancelled just before install still installs, and nothing refreshes the list
trigger: Switch a downloading dictionary off after the worker passed its last is_cancelled check (spell_download.rs:149) and before install returns
effect: cancel_dictionary_download drops the Running stage and its task, so the answer is never applied: the files are installed but refresh_installed_dictionaries and set_spell_languages never run, and the row reads 'Download size' for a dictionary that is on disk until the list is next refreshed
fix: Keep the Running stage in a Cancelling variant that still receives the worker's answer and refreshes the installed list, ignoring only the language switch

title: TwofaFlow::refetch mark is taken before the refetch is sent and lost when the send fails
trigger: Cancel a 2FA reset or finish a login-email step while the connection is closing or the chats path is inactive, so refresh_password_state returns Err
effect: The cached password state stays out of date (old pending reset date, old login email) until something else refetches it; the refetch mark is gone (mem::take then `let _ =`, connect/core/mod.rs:632)
fix: keep the mark until refresh_password_state is sent (or a PasswordFlight::InFlight request holds it); clear it on that request's answer

title: ReviewStage::Reviewing counts answers with `waiting: usize` and matches them by session id, not by the RequestId held in the stage
trigger: Press 'No, it's not me' with several unconfirmed sessions and lose one continuation (request dropped, account generation changes) without an error answer
effect: waiting never reaches 0: the alert stays busy and its buttons stay disabled until restart
fix: Reviewing { requests: Vec<(RequestId, UnconfirmedEntry)> } where each answer or error removes its own request and a lost request is an error

title: AccountNotices::unconfirmed, unconfirmed_count and unconfirmed_entries are three fields that must change together
trigger: updateUnconfirmedSession with count 0, a review that finishes, a getActiveSessions answer
effect: None today; each writer (apply_unconfirmed_session, resolve_unconfirmed_entries, finish_login_review) clears or fills them by hand, so a new writer can leave a count with no entries (alert with no buttons)
fix: one `Unconfirmed { first, count, entries: Fetch<Vec<UnconfirmedEntry>> }` value replaced whole

title: TwofaFlow keeps code_wait, notice and refetch as separate one-shot slots cleared by hand from the UI
trigger: A reset result lands while the two-step dialog is closed, or the dialog moves view without going through goto_twofa_view
effect: A stale notice line ('Two-step verification was disabled') shows on the next open; clear_twofa_flow and goto_twofa_view are the only clearers (ui/security/mod.rs:616-620)
fix: one TwofaFlow stage enum owned by the dialog (CodeWait/Notice as variants) cleared when the dialog closes

title: baseline: CallSummary::busy is a stored bool derived from the terminal update
trigger: An outgoing call declined before it connected
effect: None today; busy is computed once in from_terminal and copied through the summary clones
fix: derive it from end reason: CallSummary::end: CallEnd::{Ended, Declined, Failed} and compute busy() from it

title: ActiveGroupCall::screen_share_paused is a sub-stage of GroupScreenShare::Sharing kept in step by hand at five sites
trigger: Stop a screen share while paused, or fail startGroupCallScreenSharing, then share again
effect: None today because call_screen.rs:561/691, controls.rs:56 and screen_chooser.rs:596 each reset the bool; a missed reset shows the new share as paused
fix: GroupScreenShare::Sharing { paused: bool } (or Sharing/Paused variants) so Off and Starting cannot be paused

title: ActiveGroupCall::is_my_video_enabled and is_my_video_paused are two bools for one tri-state (off, on, paused)
trigger: Pause the camera, then turn it off
effect: None today; the pair can say paused while disabled
fix: enum MyVideo { Off, On, Paused }

title: ActiveGroupCall::rtmp_url and rtmp_stream_key are two Options written together by one answer
trigger: getVideoChatRtmpUrl answer, replaceVideoChatRtmpUrl answer
effect: None today; apply.rs:160-161 writes both, a future writer of one leaves a url without its key
fix: Option<RtmpInfo { url, key }> (the type rtmp_start already has)

title: ActiveCall::state, ready and transport (and CallProgress::HangingUp) are separate fields that must agree
trigger: discardCall fails after the call went to HangingUp: error.rs:61-66 sets call.state = hang_up.resume by hand while calls.progress is reset in another field
effect: None today; ready is Some only for a call created in state Ready (fresh) or set by accept_call_update, and HangingUp lives in both ActiveCall::state and CallProgress, so one can be left behind
fix: one ActiveCall stage enum (Ringing, Exchanging, Ready { ready, transport }, HangingUp(HangUp)) so progress is not a second copy

title: ChatSummary::last_preview, last_preview_style, last_preview_sender, last_preview_thumb and last_message are five fields set 'wherever last_preview is set'
trigger: updateChatLastMessage with an unreadable message, a deleted last message, a draft change, a new chat with last_message
effect: None today; a writer that sets last_preview and misses the style or thumb draws the new text with the old media icon or sender
fix: one LastPreview struct built by one constructor from the message and stored as Option<LastPreview>

title: LinkPreviewFetch::Asked holds no RequestId, so a request whose answer never comes leaves the chip on 'Getting link info'
trigger: Type a URL, then the getLinkPreview request is dropped (connection closes, generation change) without an error answer
effect: The composer chip says 'Getting link info' for that URL for the session; an Asked entry is never evicted or retried, answers are matched by URL text
fix: Asked(RequestId) and settle it on the answer or on a lost-request error; forget_failed also forgets a lost Asked

title: ComposerReplyFetch::Loading holds an attempt count but no RequestId; answers are matched by (chat, message) key
trigger: Reply bar fetch is re-asked (Failed then Loading) while the older request still answers
effect: The older answer fills the entry meant for the newer request, or a dropped request leaves Loading with no way out (composer_reply_fetch_wanted is false for Loading)
fix: Loading { request: RequestId, attempts } and answer only the held request

title: Inline query answers are matched by (chat, bot) and the Loading stage, not by the request that asked
trigger: Type @bot query1, then edit to query2 quickly: both getInlineQueryResults go out, the slot is Loading for query2, query1's answer arrives first
effect: The picker shows query1's results as the result of query2 (the code's own `ponytail` comment admits it); the slot's InlineQueryFetch::Loading holds no RequestId (session_apply_queries.rs:26)
fix: InlineQueryFetch::Loading(RequestId); apply only the answer whose id the slot holds

title: Login-URL answers are matched by purpose only: last_login_url_info and login_url_request are two Options not tied to a request
trigger: Press a login-URL button, press another one (or press twice) before the first getLoginUrlInfo answers
effect: The first answer lands as the answer of the second press; an error of either takes the other's login_url_request (error.rs:208) and degrades the wrong button to its fallback URL
fix: one LoginUrlStage { Idle, Asking { request: RequestId, ctx }, Answered(info) } and match answers by RequestId

title: SimilarBotsFetch::Loading has no RequestId; a failure removes the entry by bot id
trigger: Open a bot profile, close and reopen it so a second getBotSimilarBots goes out while the first is in flight, then the first fails
effect: The Loading entry of the second request is removed by the first's error and a stray answer can land on an entry that no longer waits
fix: SimilarBotsFetch::Loading(RequestId)

title: restore_optimistic ends in `_ => {}` and apply_error lists the same variants again; ChatPermissions, ChatPinOrder and ArchiveChatListSettings are handled in a second place
trigger: Add a new RequestRollback variant
effect: The compiler does not force a rollback arm, so a refused change can stay on screen
fix: One exhaustive match (move the three arms into restore_optimistic) and delete the wildcard

title: PendingBotMessage keeps `can_stop: bool` beside `stop: BotStopStage` and finish_pending_bot_stop sets both by hand
trigger: Stop a bot's streaming draft that has keep_on_stop
effect: No bug today; Stopped implies can_stop=false is written in one place (session_apply_messages.rs:585)
fix: Make BotStopStage carry can-stop (Running { can_stop }, Stopped) so one value changes

title: check_password_suggested mirrors the 'suggestedActionCheckPassword' entry of chat_list.suggestions
trigger: The server removes the suggested action while a hideSuggestedAction fails
effect: Two copies of one fact updated in apply_privacy_data_payload and apply_privacy_data_ok; HideSuggestedAction's error re-adds only the list copy
fix: Derive the bool from suggestions (has_action(CHECK)) and delete the field

title: apply_local_search_filter writes surface and generation by hand, bypassing begin_query/bump_generation
trigger: Screenshot demo or offline path types in global search with a debounced query pending
effect: The typed Debounce stays armed and confirm/top_view are not reset, because only SearchState's own transitions cancel them
fix: Call begin_query/begin_recents and then accept_* so the stage resets in its own transitions

title: Thread history answers and errors are matched by origin chat+message, not by the RequestId held in ThreadStatus::LoadingHistory
trigger: Open a thread; while its first page (LoadingHistory(r)) is in flight, an older/newer page of the same origin (or a re-sent page) lands or fails
effect: Any matching page flips LoadingHistory(r) to Ready, or any matching failure (incl. an older/newer page, or a getMessageThread re-resolve) flips it to Failed, while request r is still out; the thread shows empty/Failed then fills in or sticks
fix: Compare the answer's RequestId with LoadingHistory(r) (grep shows nothing but connect/threads.rs reads it); other pages go through the history's own older/newer stage

title: begin_thread replaces the ThreadView whole, so stale_pages of the old view is lost and in-flight pages of the old opening land in the new view of the same origin
trigger: Open comments of post P, close, reopen P before the first page answered
effect: The old opening's page (different window/anchor) is applied to the new view whose thread_id/root_ids are not resolved yet; rows or completion flags from the wrong window
fix: Give each ThreadView an opening token carried by its requests (like WindowViews::openings), match answers to it

title: leave_open_chat closes the thread only when thread.chat_id == prev, not when thread.origin_chat_id == prev
trigger: Open a channel post's comments (status SwitchingChat, thread.chat_id = discussion group, open chat still the channel), then move the channel to its own window
effect: The main window's thread survives with open = None and later runs switch_to_thread_chat, opening the discussion group in the main window the user just emptied
fix: Close the thread when either its chat or its origin is the chat left (one OwnedBy check)

title: begin_sponsored_hide resets sponsored_report to Idle by hand, dropping a report flow in flight (Asking or Picking)
trigger: Start reporting ad A (picker open or request out), then choose Hide ads on ad B
effect: The report picker/flow of A vanishes without Cancel or an answer; accept_sponsored_hidden was fixed to keep it (13-034) but this reset still overwrites it
fix: Only reset from the flow's own transitions: leave Asking/Picking alone as accept_sponsored_hidden does

title: baseline: RowForum::loaded
fix: Derive from a topics Fetch (Idle/Loading/Ready/Failed) instead of contains_key || forum_topics_failed

title: recent_inline_bots: Option is the 'fetched' flag, with no Failed or Loading stage
trigger: Type '@' in a composer while getRecentInlineBots fails
effect: None means both 'never asked' and 'failed'; the in-flight check is a scan of pending by purpose (connect/bots.rs maybe_fetch_recent_inline_bots); the error is not recorded, so each '@' re-asks
