fix: Fetch<Vec<i64>> with the request in Loading

title: send_as_options Fetch::Loading { request: None }: the stage never holds the request, and the answer inserts Ready by chat id
trigger: Open the send-as picker in a chat, close it and reopen (or an update races the answer)
effect: Answer (domains/messages/apply.rs:44) and error (error.rs:133) are matched by purpose + chat id, one-in-flight guarded only by a pending scan; a Retry answer of an older request is taken as current
fix: Store the RequestId in Loading and use Fetch::answered(request, ..) for the answer and error

title: needs_translation treats Failed as 'no translation needed', so an automatic pump never retries a failed message
trigger: Translate a chat automatically, one translateMessageText fails (error, 'lost', 'send')
effect: The row shows 'translation error' for good; only an edit of the message (forget_message_translations) or a manual send clears it
fix: Failed with a retry mark/backoff, or a retry action on the failed row

title: TranslateState::messages is never pruned with chat history or the chat leaving the kept set
trigger: Read many translated chats in one session
effect: Done translations (text and entities) of every message in every language stay for the life of the session, beyond the history they belong to
fix: Drop a chat's entries in history_prune / release_chat_history

title: Batch progress is four hand-kept fields (batch_total, batch_completed, batch_failed, batch_pending) plus the requests in flight
trigger: Batch install/archive several sets, switch account or lose a request without an answer
effect: batch_pending only shrinks on an answer or send failure; a dropped request leaves the batch counted as pending and the totals never settle
fix: One BatchStage { Idle, Running { pending: Vec<(set, RequestId)>, done, failed } }

title: archived/trending paging reads archived_offset/trending_offset written at send time, not the offset the answered request carried
trigger: Page archived or trending sets, a refetch (updateTrendingStickerSets) is sent while the earlier page is out
effect: accept_* decides replace-or-append from the offset of the latest send, so an answer can replace or append to the wrong page; single-flight (has_purpose) is the only guard
fix: Carry the offset in the request (RequestPurpose) or a Fetch Loading { request, offset }

title: date_jump_pending (Option tuple) and chat_search.jump (Loading{message_id}) must change together and are cleared by hand in five places
trigger: Start a date jump, then pick a search hit, or delete the message the jump waits for (miss_search_jump sets Missing but not date_jump_pending)
effect: The pending date jump outlives its jump; a later load-around of the same message id resolves with the old mode and retargets the view
fix: Put the mode in ChatSearchJump::Loading { message_id, then: DateJumpMode }

title: SavedPage { Idle, Asking(RequestId) } sits beside TopicHistory's own older-end stage for the same page
trigger: Page a Saved Messages sublist or tag filter and fail a page
effect: Failure sets page = Idle and history.fail_older() by hand in three places (fail_saved_tag_page, fail_saved_topic_page, awaiting_saved_tag_search); two values for one stage
fix: Take the request from the history's older-end stage (OlderEnd::Asking(RequestId)) and drop SavedPage

title: fail_story_report_send replaces the whole report flow, also one that belongs to another story
trigger: Report story A (Checking), switch to story B and a send of B fails
effect: A's flow is overwritten by B's Failed; A's answer is then dropped as unmatched
fix: Fail only when the current flow is for chat_id/story_id; otherwise ignore

title: An own reply sent while the thread window has unloaded newer replies replaces the window without marking in-flight older/newer pages stale
trigger: Open a comment thread at its first unread reply (has_newer), scroll so a newer or older page request is in flight, send a reply: ThreadView::note_live calls reset_window, but Session::thread_upsert only calls drop_thread_pages_past when the row was stored and after trim_live, never for the reset; the in-flight page then passes the stale_pages check in apply_thread_history
effect: The late page is merged into the reset window across a gap and overwrites next_from_message_id, so rows are missing or paging resumes from the wrong place until the user jumps to the latest
fix: Make note_live return whether it replaced the window and have thread_upsert call drop_thread_pages_past for both ends (as note_live_topic_message does); better, hold the page request in OlderEnd/NewerEnd::Loading{request} so reset_window drops it

title: Page-in-flight staleness is a blacklist of request ids kept in step by hand with every window move
trigger: Any code path that replaces or trims a window end must remember to add the in-flight ids to TopicHistory::stale_pages or history_pruning.gone_topic_pages; ThreadView::reset_window duplicates TopicHistory::reset_window and forgot (see thread note_live bug)
effect: None today beyond the thread note_live bug; the sets also keep ids of requests that never answer
fix: OlderEnd/NewerEnd gain Loading{request}; a window move replaces the stage, so an answer for another request is dropped by comparison

title: Any failure of a recent post's getMessage is stored as Missing for good
trigger: Open channel statistics with a flaky connection (or while the account logs out: a lost request settles as a 408 failure); GetStatsPost fails, error.rs calls post_missing; fetch_stats_post skips keys in posts
effect: The post row is hidden from Recent posts for the rest of the session and never refetched
fix: posts value becomes Fetch<StatsPostPreview> with Missing only for a real not-found error; a transient failure leaves Failed/Idle so the next open asks again

title: Statistics rows ask for their post or graph from render and ask again after every failed send
trigger: Open channel statistics while the sender refuses requests; request_post and request_graph run on each render, a failed send leaves no entry (graph_unsent removes it, no posts entry is made) so the next frame sends again
effect: A failing send is retried on every frame and nothing shows the failure
fix: A Failed stage that render does not re-ask, with an explicit Retry (as already done for Failed graphs)

title: MessageStatsFetch and StoryStatsFetch default to Loading with no RequestId
trigger: The page state is created in Loading before the request exists; the answer and the error are matched by (chat id, message id) or (chat id, story id), not by the request the stage waits for
effect: A second request for the same post (a Retry that races an older answer) can fill or fail the page from the wrong request
fix: Loading{request: RequestId} (or Fetch<T>) matched with waits_for

title: A failed first page of Stories or Gifts writes count 0 into the chat's media counts
trigger: Open a profile gallery on a bad connection, the Gifts or Stories page fails (or its send fails); fail_profile_tab sets chat_media_counts[key]=0, which hides the tab once it is not active, and the counts are never fetched again this session
effect: The tab disappears from the bar and cannot be retried until the app restarts, as if the profile had no gifts or stories
fix: Keep Failed in the tab stage and leave the count unknown (None) so the tab stays visible with Retry

title: Tab visibility reads media counts that are fetched once per chat per session and never refreshed
trigger: Open a chat's gallery while it has no files or links, receive some, reopen the gallery: visible_tabs still sees count 0 (fetch_chat_media_counts returns early when the entry exists; nothing invalidates it on new messages)
effect: The Files, Links or other tabs stay hidden although the chat now has such media
fix: Counts as Fetch with Outdated on gallery open, or refetch on every open

title: The ticked rows are kept when the active tab's list is replaced by a search or a calendar jump
trigger: Tick rows in Files, type a search text (begin_search) or jump to a date (begin_fetch_at_day): only select_tab, open_for_tab and close clear selection
effect: The header still counts N selected and Forward/Delete selected act on rows that are no longer in the list
fix: Selection lives in the tab's ready stage and is dropped whenever the items are replaced

title: A calendar jump on a searched tab sends the plain list but keeps the query
trigger: Type a query in Files, Music or Links, open the calendar and pick a day: jump_shared_media_to_day sends searchChatMessages with query "" while the tab keeps query, and later pages use shared_media_query
effect: The first page is unfiltered and older pages are filtered by the query, so the list mixes two result sets under the search box text
fix: begin_fetch_at_day clears the query (or the jump sends it); query and anchor are one 'what the list answers' value

title: The Playlist page and the gallery are two Options kept in step by hand
trigger: playlist_user is set by the UI over an open gallery (chat_id stays Some), cleared by close_playlist_ui, open_for_tab and close; renderers and the Esc stack test both with precedence
effect: None today
fix: enum View{Closed, Gallery(chat), Playlist{user, under: Option<chat>}}

title: Stories page answers carry no stamp and are matched by chat only
trigger: Open the gallery, let a Stories page start, close and reopen the same chat: a late page with generation None is accepted by accepts_profile for the new open; a late failure can mark the new Loading tab Failed
effect: The tab shows the old page or a failure until the new request answers
fix: Send the stamp with getChatPostedToChatPageStories as Gifts does

title: Dead duplicate SponsoredReport state machine beside the live SponsoredReportFlow
trigger: SponsoredReport (Idle, Chosen, Asking, Picking, Outcome) is used nowhere; messages.sponsored_report is SponsoredReportFlow. The unused Chosen stage has no sender and no way out
effect: Nothing today; a future caller picks the wrong enum
fix: Delete SponsoredReport (and SponsoredReportOutcome/Flight duplicates if unused)

title: The sticker batch is four fields kept in step by hand
trigger: batch_total, batch_completed, batch_failed and batch_pending are set together in connect/stickers.rs and moved by finish_sticker_batch_item; total = completed + failed + pending.len() is not enforced and there is no idle or done stage
effect: None today; progress of a finished batch lingers until the next batch
fix: enum Batch{Idle, Running{pending: Vec<i64>, done: usize, failed: usize}}

title: Refetch marks recent_stale, favorites_stale, trending_stale and GifPanel::stale are bools beside Fetch fields that already have Outdated
trigger: refresh_stale_panels and maybe_refresh_saved_animations read and clear them; the section 8 entries 03-032 and 09-032 say trending_stale and GifPanel::stale are gone but both are still here
effect: None today beyond the lost-mark bug
fix: Fetch::Outdated on lists.recent/favorites/trending and saved

title: The saved-GIF stale mark is cleared before the refetch is sent
trigger: updateSavedAnimations marks the panel stale; maybe_refresh_saved_animations sets stale=false right after saved_asked, the send fails; saved_failed counts the list as loaded
effect: The GIF list stays out of date and no refetch is asked until the panel is reopened
fix: Outdated stays on saved until the answer lands

title: The Attached Stickers lookup is attached_request and attached_answer plus a loading sticker_set_view
trigger: fetch_attached_sticker_sets resets the answer, sets request and a loading box; apply sets the answer and clears the request; open_attached_sticker_set takes the answer; error clears the request and fails the box
effect: None today
fix: enum Attached{Idle, Asking(RequestId), Answered(Option<i64>)}

title: GifSearch::request duplicates the request already held by fetch: Fetch::Loading
trigger: search_asked, search_sent, search_answered and search_failed_now set fetch and request separately; Fetch has sent() and waits_for()
effect: None today
fix: Drop request; use fetch.sent(request) and fetch.waits_for(request)

title: A GIF search's results, offsets and chat live outside its GifSearch stage and are reset by hand
trigger: search_gifs and the core upkeep clear search_results, search_next_offset and search_offset next to search_begun; search_begun and search_left do not
effect: None today; a caller that only calls search_begun shows the previous search's results
fix: Move results, next_offset and chat into GifSearch so a new search replaces them

title: A failed composer sticker suggestion leaves SuggestFor::Asked, so it is never asked again for that emoji
trigger: Type an emoji, the searchStickers (SuggestStickers) request errors; no error arm resets suggest_for, and update_sticker_suggestions returns early when the emoji equals the Asked emoji
effect: No sticker suggestions for that emoji until the trailing emoji changes; also the answer is accepted by purpose, not by request id
fix: Asked{emoji, request} with Failed; an error moves it to Failed and a retry on the next keystroke

title: StoryManageState keeps the same call as the slot request, in_flight and settled
trigger: start pushes to in_flight and sets the slot; settle updates both; forget_in_flight clears one; fail_locally clears only the slot
effect: None today
fix: Slot derived from the latest entry of one calls list

title: An opener thread that ends leaves its decoded clips Opening forever
trigger: A video sticker (WebM) is decoding on an opener thread and the decode closure panics (spawn_guarded catches it and the thread exits), or every opener thread has ended
effect: The sticker never gets a first frame; its UiClip stays Opening::Pending, and views waiting on the first frame keep animating (ticking) with no way out until the clip goes stale and is closed. WorkerEnd(.., None) only sets worker_gone and never fails clips in Stage::Opening, nor Stage::Waiting(Origin::Decoded) once no opener runs (workers_decode stays false)
fix: Track opener threads as WorkerLife too; when an opener ends, fail the clip it held (Stage::Opening for Decoded) and when none run, fail Waiting(Decoded) clips or flip workers_decode; drop worker_gone for the per-thread lives

title: Clip::delivered is a one-way 'first frame handed out' latch beside Stage
trigger: A clip draws its first frame, then Failed or re-opened
effect: The first-frame wake (worker::frame returns true) hangs on a bool flipped with mem::replace, outside the stage that decides when a clip is Ready
fix: Stage::Ready{info, delivered: Delivered} or a Drawing/Ready variant that carries the first-frame mark

title: searchWebApp answer is matched to the waiting flow by bot id, not by the RequestId
trigger: Click two t.me/<bot>/<app1> and t.me/<bot>/<app2> links of the same bot before the first searchWebApp answers
effect: The first answer (app1's FoundWebApp, skip_confirmation, request_write_access) is taken by the flow now waiting for app2 (take_search_for compares bot_id only), so app2 is launched or consented to with app1's terms; the second answer finds no flow and is dropped
fix: WebApps::found: Option<(RequestId, Result<..>)> and Searching { request: RequestId, awaited } matched on the request

title: WebApps::pending is a Vec that never holds more than one launch
trigger: Any open call: mark_web_app_pending clears the Vec before pushing
effect: The doc says 'a second launch keeps its own context' but the only writer clears first, so the collection hides a one-slot stage; readers loop over a list that cannot have two
fix: Option<WebAppPending> (or a keyed map if concurrent launches are meant)

title: Custom-method replies carry only the app's req_id and go to whichever mini app window is current
trigger: A mini app sends web_app_invoke_custom_method, is closed (or the window is replaced by another app) before TDLib answers
effect: poll_mini_app_session emits the reply into self.mini_apps.window with the old req_id; a different app that uses the same req_id gets another app's result; custom_requests entries whose answer never comes are never removed
fix: Key the in-flight entry by RequestId with the launch/window it was sent for, and drop the answer (and the entry) when that launch is gone

title: data_sent is an unkeyed one-shot slot taken by whichever poll runs next
trigger: Two keyboard-button mini apps send data close together, or the account is switched away before the answer and back later
effect: The second answer overwrites the first (one 'Sent to the bot' note for two sends, or a failure lost), and an answer that lands while another account is on screen shows its note when this account returns
fix: A per-request outcome keyed by RequestId, taken by the flow that sent it, and cleared in the account's Farewell

title: Reported is a two-variant enum that is a bool for 'rows were reported'
trigger: Open a history, then scroll: restart() sets Unreported, report() sets Reported, restart_reported() sets it directly
effect: The book's phase is a flag beside the per-message stages that abort() and the newest-row rule branch on; it is changed from three methods, not from stage transitions
fix: Fold into the stage: ViewBook as enum { Newest(stages), Reported(stages, on_screen) } so on_screen only exists once reported

title: FramePlan keeps base and last as two Options set together, last doubling as a started flag
trigger: Any WebM sticker decode: place() sets base on the first call and last on the first taken picture; tail() reads last.is_none() as 'nothing taken'
effect: base/last/emitted must change in step; a change to place() that sets one without the other skews every slot
fix: enum FramePlan { Empty, Running { base: i64, last: i64, emitted: usize } }

title: A failed load of the bundled sticker decoder is cached for the whole process
trigger: First video sticker is decoded while quillvideo is missing, still being installed or fails to load once
effect: Api::load's Err sits in the OnceLock forever: every WebM sticker then uses the ffmpeg fallback (or fails with 'Video stickers need the bundled decoder' without the ui feature) until restart, even after the library appears
fix: Cache only success (OnceLock<Api>) and retry the lookup after a failure, or hold Loaded/Unavailable{since} in a Mutex

title: StoryComposer::open bool beside an always-present Box<StoryComposer> and its stage
trigger: Open the story composer, press Post (stage Posting), close the composer, reopen it
effect: No bug today (close() replaces the whole value, and answers are matched by RequestId), but 'open' is an Option-as-flag: a closed composer still carries a live-looking stage, media and mode, and every reader must test open first (esc_stack, render, click-through)
fix: StoryUi::composer: Option<Box<StoryComposer>> (or a Composer { Closed, Open(StoryComposer) } enum) so closed has no stage

title: Composer link_url / reaction_emojis mirror TextareaState inputs synced by hand before posting; mode and as_chat_id are separate bare-id fields
trigger: Edit the link or emoji field then post/save; or open Edit/Repost with as_chat_id set from a previous poster
effect: Two copies of the same text (struct string and input entity) must be copied in step; ComposerMode::Repost/Edit(i64,i32) and as_chat_id: Option<i64> are bare chat ids that must agree with each other and the account
fix: read the text from the inputs at send time only (drop the mirrors); fold as_chat_id into ComposerMode with OfAccount/ChatId owner keys

title: CloseFriendsStage::Loading/Failed carry no RequestId and shadow CloseFriendsList::Loading/Failed in the session
trigger: Open the close-friends editor, let getCloseFriends fail, press Retry; or open it while another load is in flight
effect: No bug today, but the load stage lives twice (viewer panel stage and Session::stories::close_friends). The panel stage leaves Loading only when the UI tick reads failed_without_list() or a list from the session, instead of by the answer to its own request; with no live driver (demo) Loading has no way out but Cancel
fix: derive the panel's Loading/Failed from CloseFriendsList (single owner), keeping only Editing/Saving{request} in the panel stage

title: StoryPageOp keyed by bare Option<i64> chat id and a free-text label; finished ops linger until a caller settles them by hand
trigger: Run an album mutation, leave the page without the owner calling settle_story_page_op/leave_story_page; or have more than 64 ops in flight
effect: Succeeded/Failed ops stay in the list until settle_finished/forget_chat is called from outside their own transitions; loading() matches reads by label string; begin() past the cap with no finished op grows the Vec without bound
fix: op identity = RequestId + typed StoryPageOpKind (not a label string), owner ChatId; finished ops expire in their own transition (Succeeded/Failed with a deadline) instead of caller-driven settle

title: One-shot notes and balance_low queues are drained from render (status_toast_visible) with no lock or owner check
trigger: Approve/decline/offer fails (or BALANCE_TOO_LOW) while the app is locked or the account is not the live one, then unlock or switch back
effect: The error toast (and the top-up box from ask_after_balance_error) appears late or while locked; the Vec has no cap if nothing drains it; the draining is a state mutation inside a render path
fix: push the failure into the window/account notice queue at the error arm (owner-scoped, refused_while_locked), no Vec the render drains

title: ParsedGroupCallParticipant still stores video_enabled/screen_sharing_enabled beside video_info/screen_sharing_video_info (section 8 06-043 says they derive)
trigger: Any code that builds a participant (screen_chooser_demo.rs:187 sets video_enabled: !me with video_info: None) or edits one field
effect: Readers (group_call_tiles.rs:109-147, group_call_members.rs:262) read the bool while the engine subscribes from the Option; the two can disagree and a tile is drawn with no endpoint or the reverse
fix: Drop the two bools and make them methods: video_info.is_some() and screen_sharing_video_info.is_some()

title: ParsedCall::ready is Some only while state is CallState::Ready, kept in step at parse time (section 8 06-042 moved the session's CallState to Ready(ReadyParams) but the wire type did not)
trigger: Build or edit a ParsedCall by hand (tests, a future producer): state Ready with ready None, or ready Some with state Pending
effect: session_calls.rs:39-43,116 copies call.ready into the active call independent of call.state; a mismatch gives a Ready call with no key or a key on a pending call
fix: CallState::Ready(ReadyParams) on the envelope type; delete ParsedCall::ready

title: baseline: ParsedGroupCall::loaded_all_participants (TDLib's own report; the ActiveGroupCall twin is in the allow list, this one is not)
trigger: none today; copied into the tracked call at session_calls.rs:610
effect: none; baseline debt stays on the register
fix: Add ParsedGroupCall::loaded_all_participants to implicit-state-allow.txt with the same reason as ActiveGroupCall, then drop it from the baseline

title: AccentRead::Failed is final: a read that found no accent (portal says no preference, or gdbus not ready at startup) is never retried
trigger: Linux: start Quill while the desktop has no accent or the session bus is not up yet, then set an accent in system settings and open Appearance
effect: The 'use system accent' option stays hidden/unavailable until restart; refresh() returns at the Idle check so the new accent is never read
fix: Failed{last, retry_after} (or back to Idle after the failed read) so a later refresh() from a settings open or window focus can read again

title: System proxy follow runs for the on-screen account only; background accounts using system proxy mode never get their hidden entry planned or re-read, and WANTED is one process-wide flag set by whichever account ticks
trigger: Two accounts, background one in 'Use system proxy settings' mode; the OS proxy changes or the network returns while the other account is on screen
effect: The background account keeps a stale or missing system proxy entry in TDLib (connecting direct or through the old proxy) until it is switched to; connect/ticks.rs:79-95 returns before reread_system_proxy/system_proxy_tick for TickScope::Background
fix: Move reread_system_proxy and system_proxy_tick above the Background early return and make WANTED a count/set of accounts (or a per-driver flag the reader consults)

title: PasswordState::pending_email_pattern (Option) and pending_email_code_length (i32) are one nullable TDLib object split in two fields that only mean something together
trigger: getPasswordState answer with recovery_email_address_code_info null: pattern None and length 0; readers (connect/auth.rs:403,419,445, ui/security/twofa_status_body.rs:73) test only the Option, so the length can be read while the pattern is None
effect: no bug today; a reader that uses the length without checking the pattern would show a code box of length 0
fix: one Option<PendingRecoveryEmail { pattern, code_length }> (or a RecoveryEmail enum None/Pending{..}) built in parse_password_state

title: scopeNotificationSettings payload carries a made-up scope (hard-coded PrivateChats) that the reducer must ignore
trigger: any getScopeNotificationSettings answer for Groups or Channels: the parsed payload says scope: PrivateChats; state/domains/settings/apply.rs:319 matches it with `..` and takes the scope from PendingRequest::scope
effect: no wrong write today; any new reader of SettingsPayload::ScopeNotificationSettings::scope would apply a group's defaults to private chats
fix: drop the scope field from the variant (the answer is id-less, the stage holds the scope), or carry the request's scope in the payload after correlation

title: KeyboardButtonType::RequestPoll keeps force_regular and force_quiz as two bools; both true is representable and resolved by precedence in QuizLock::from_button
trigger: A bot keyboard with both flags set (malformed or future payload) is parsed as-is; the consumer picks quiz over regular
effect: None today; the contradictory pair is carried to the UI and silently resolved there
fix: enum PollRequest { Any, RegularOnly, QuizOnly } built once in the parser

title: Thumbnail kind is a bool (thumb_still) beside Option<FileId> thumb_file_id; the pair must agree (still vs MP4 preview clip), and thumb_still defaults to true when there is no thumbnail
trigger: Any animation/video/GIF with an MPEG-4 thumbnail; a producer that sets thumb_file_id without thumb_still (or the reverse) draws a clip as an image
effect: None today; AnimationItem derives still_thumb/preview_clip from the pair, AnimationContent and VideoContent carry the same pair with no such accessor
fix: enum Thumb { None, Still(FileId), Clip(FileId) } with width/height inside the variants

title: InlineQueryResultsButton is a stringly sum type: kind String ('start_bot'/'web_app'/'unknown') with parameter and url valid only for one kind, kept in step by hand
trigger: A consumer reads url for a start_bot button or parameter for a web_app button, or matches on a misspelled kind string
effect: None today; the empty-string convention is the only guard (the same shape holds for InlineQueryResultSummary::kind)
fix: enum InlineQueryResultsButtonKind { StartBot { parameter }, WebApp { url }, Unknown } and an enum for the result kind

title: DiceContent says whether the roll is known three ways: value<=0, landing None, and initial None; result_line/label read value while animation()/DicePhase reads landing
trigger: A messageDice with value > 0 but final_state absent or its stickers missing (slot machine missing one of five stickers parses to None)
effect: The label/accessibility line shows the rolled number while the bubble keeps looping the rolling animation; or the reverse when value is 0 but final_state is present
fix: enum DiceState { Rolling { initial }, Landed { value, landing: Option<DiceStickers> } } so the value and the animation are one stage

title: PaymentReceiptData keeps `is_stars: bool` beside fields that only apply to one receipt kind
trigger: Open a Stars receipt: currency, total_amount, credentials_title and tip_amount are empty/zero placeholders and star_count is the real value; a regular receipt leaves star_count 0. Every reader (src/ui/payments/build_payment_dialog.rs:164) must branch on the bool to pick the right fields.
effect: No bug today; a reader that forgets the bool shows an empty price or 0 stars.
fix: enum PaymentReceiptKind { Regular { currency, total_amount, credentials_title, tip_amount }, Stars { star_count } } (the TDLib paymentReceiptType* split)

title: messageGift star total adds two TDLib int64 values unchecked (base + upgrade)
trigger: A messageGift whose gift.star_count plus prepaid_upgrade_star_count exceeds i64::MAX (malformed or hostile payload)
effect: Debug build panics on overflow; release wraps to a negative star price shown in the service line
fix: base.saturating_add(upgrade) (panic-safety rule 5)

title: StoryContentView::Video::file_id uses FileId(0) as 'no clip' while thumb_file_id uses Option
trigger: storyContentVideo whose video file fails to parse
effect: No bug today: story_viewer.rs:459-469 and session paths re-check file_id.0 != 0 by hand; a new reader that forgets the check would request download of file 0
fix: file_id: Option<FileId> like thumb_file_id

title: baseline: ChecklistSend::others_can_mark_tasks_as_done
trigger: Compose a checklist and send
effect: Nothing wrong today: it is a send option, not a stage
fix: Move to scripts/implicit-state-allow.txt with a reason (a send option), or an enum of who may mark tasks

title: LaunchChats keeps one stage as a raw AtomicU8 with u8 consts plus a separate owner AtomicI64 with a NO_OWNER sentinel
trigger: Launch: claim(client) then Ready/answer envelopes move stage; wait() also stores IN by hand after a Skipped or Capped wait
effect: No bug today (launch only); the owner is never cleared and the stage is moved from observe, set_in and wait in three places
fix: One enum Launch { Starting, Claimed{client}, Asked{client}, In } behind one Mutex, transitions in one method

title: TdHub run stage is two AtomicBools plus an Option<JoinHandle>; a replacement hub resets `stopped` by hand
trigger: Receive thread panics 16 times, shared() starts a replacement via Handover which stores stopped=false on the old hub's flag; shutdown/stop_within take the handle
effect: Stage (Running, Stopped unexpectedly, Stopping, Joined) is implied by shutdown, stopped and thread.is_some(); start() clears stopped from outside the hub's own transitions
fix: enum HubStage { Running, Died, Stopping, Joined } owned by the hub; Handover moves clients, not a flag

title: RequestLogGate state is a (count, Option<i32>) tuple whose two parts must change together
trigger: hide() by first call stores the read level in .1; show() by last call takes it; a read that fails leaves .1 None while count is 1
effect: Count and saved level are kept in step by hand; Some/None of the level also means 'read failed' vs 'not hidden'
fix: enum Gate { Shown, Hidden{calls:usize, saved:Option<i32>} }

title: Per-account accent palettes are never dropped when an account is removed or logged out, and the 'active account' is a process-wide global
trigger: Log in, receive updateAccentColors, remove the account; PALETTES keeps its entry for the process lifetime (set_palette is only ever written in apply.rs:256)
effect: Stale palette kept after account removal; a re-added account with the same key paints with the old table until its first update. Harmless in practice
fix: Hold the palette in the account's own state (OnScreen/Session) and read it from there, or clear on Farewell

title: expiration_date and backdrop colors are narrowed with `as i32` from i64 (wraps silently)
trigger: TDLib sends an out-of-range int53 for emoji status expiration_date or backdrop colour
effect: Wrapped value, a wrong or negative expiry; no panic
fix: Use i32::try_from(..).unwrap_or(0) or the sat_i32 helper

title: Story album id narrowed with `as i32` (wraps silently)
trigger: storyAlbum id outside i32
effect: Two albums can collide on id; no panic
fix: i32::try_from(..).ok()? so the album is skipped instead

title: Scheduled send date narrowed with `date as i32` (wraps past 2038) in message_send_options and edit_message_scheduling_state
trigger: A SendAtDate whose i64 unix timestamp exceeds i32::MAX reaches message_send_options (line 196) or edit_message_scheduling_state (line 875); the cast wraps to a negative/past send_date. Not reachable if the schedule picker caps dates (Telegram allows about one year), which was not confirmed.
effect: The message is scheduled for a wrong time or TDLib rejects it, instead of the picked date.
fix: i32::try_from(date) with an error path, or clamp where SendAtDate is built; panic-safety rule 5 (saturate received/user arithmetic)

title: baseline: TopPerson::saved_messages
trigger: Search strip lists Saved Messages tile
effect: Tile for the Saved Messages chat is built (bool fact in the baseline; no bug today)
fix: TopPersonKind { SavedMessages, Chat } or drop it and ask session.is_saved_messages(chat_id)

title: Tray/taskbar visibility is two bools plus a derived WorkMode; (false,false) is representable and fixed up by hand
trigger: Edit appearance_prefs.json to show_tray_icon=false and show_taskbar_icon=false, or toggle switches
effect: Load accepts both off; every reader maps it to WindowOnly by convention (from_switches, toggle_* force the other bit on). Nothing but toggle_* keeps the pair legal
fix: Store WorkMode (WindowAndTray|TrayOnly|WindowOnly) in AppearancePrefs and derive the two switch states

title: Wallet Fetch<()> stages (explorer, state_fetch, rates_fetch) never hold their RequestId; answers and errors are matched by purpose
trigger: Open Money (LoadState sent), server turns can_use_ton_wallet off then on (set_can_use(false) sets state_fetch Idle), open Money again: a second LoadState goes out; the first request's late error calls state_fetch.fail with no request check and fails the second one's Loading
effect: Fetch is Loading{request:None} for the whole flight (Fetch::sent is never called in connect/ton_wallet.rs); apply_ton_wallet_error and the explorer arms (groups/apply.rs, payments/error.rs) act on purpose alone, so an older request's answer or error lands on a newer fetch
fix: Call Fetch::sent(request) after each send and use answered/failed(request, ..) in the reducers

title: MoneyPage::open bool sits beside tab/history/nfts/detail; a closed page must be all-default, reset by hand in three places
trigger: Money page closed or wallet option turned off
effect: open=false is only meaningful when the rest equals MoneyPage::default(); close_money_page, set_can_use(false) and open_money_page each reassign the whole struct by hand, and the dialog predicate reads open separately from the lists
fix: Option<MoneyPage> (or MoneyState::{Closed, Open(MoneyPage)}) on TonWalletState

title: open_money_page returns early on a failed explorer/state/rates send, so history is never requested but the Money box still opens
trigger: LoadState, GetCurrencyExchangeRates or getApplicationConfig send fails (client closing, send error) while opening Money, or opening a transfer card
effect: open_money_page sets money.open=true then `?`-returns before fetch_wallet_history; open_money and open_transfer_details only note the error and still open_box(Money). History stays Idle: no spinner, no error, no Retry, empty page until the user closes and reopens
fix: Send the history page first (or collect the sends' errors) so each fetch is independent; failure of one must not skip the others

title: A failed first page of Money history has no Retry
trigger: History request answers with an error (network, wallet server) on Transactions tab
effect: Paged::Failed{shown:None} draws only the error line; Load more is drawn only when has_more() (needs a shown page) and set_money_tab refetches only Collectibles, so the Transactions list stays failed until the Money box is closed and opened again
fix: Draw a Retry button for Paged::Failed (calls fetch_wallet_history(false)/fetch_wallet_nfts(false))

title: ProfileAddress::None means both 'no wallet' and 'lookup failed', and Loading carries no request, so a failed lookup is never retried
trigger: Open a user's profile while getUserTonWalletAddresses fails; reopen the profile
effect: apply_ton_wallet_error inserts None; fetch_user_ton_wallet_address skips any user already in the map, so the address row never appears until restart or a can_use toggle. A late error after set_can_use(false) (which clears the map) re-inserts None and blocks the lookup when the wallet comes back. Loading/answers are matched by user id and purpose, not by RequestId
fix: ProfileAddress::{Loading{request}, Found, NoWallet, Failed} with Failed re-asked on the next open; drop the entry on can_use=false answers

title: set_can_use(false) drops the Money page but leaves an open wallet notice
trigger: Money page's Send/Receive/Backup notice is open (on_money_page surface), then the can_use_ton_wallet option turns off
effect: notice stays Some(surface) with the Money page gone; also explorer/rates_fetch/ton_usd_rate are not reset, so the off->on cycle is inconsistent with state_fetch which is
fix: Reset the whole wallet state (TonWalletState::default keeping explorer) in set_can_use(false), or clear notice with money

title: ToneUpload::Uploading holds no RequestId: the answer is matched by purpose and nothing ends it if the answer never comes
trigger: Start Upload Sound, connection or TDLib client drops the request without an answer
effect: finish_tone_upload and apply_tone_upload_error act on RequestPurpose::UploadSavedNotificationSound only (Added{target:None} exists for 'not Uploading'); upload_notification_tone refuses while Uploading, so uploads are blocked and the footer spinner stays until the account session is rebuilt. Also a new upload may overwrite an unconsumed Added/Failed outcome
fix: Uploading{request,..}; settle only the matching request; clear to Failed on session reset

title: ExportView Shown/Hidden is a two-variant enum beside the real stage (AccountProgress) and is set by hand from five sites
trigger: Open, Hide, close X, Cancel/Done, dialog .close closure
effect: The box's visibility lives on AccountExport.view and is written by set_account_export_view from open_account_export, on_close, the .close closure and the Hide button; poll_account_export_progress then reads it to decide clearing the settled export
fix: One stage owner for the box: DialogKind visibility derives from ExportBox, with Hidden implied by the box being closed

title: Folder picker answer applies to whatever draft is current, not the one that asked
trigger: Click Change, (non-modal portal) Cancel the box, reopen Export Telegram data, then pick a folder in the first dialog
effect: draft_mut() is the new draft; its folder changes to the old pick. The answer carries no key of the draft that asked
fix: Give each draft a token (or hold the picker task in the draft) and apply only to the draft that asked

title: Tray publisher's stopped flag is set only when its loop ends normally
trigger: The tray update worker panics (caught by spawn_guarded) or cannot be spawned
effect: done.store(true) comes after the loop inside the guarded closure, so a panic or spawn failure leaves stopped=false forever: poll() never restarts the item, and the unread badge/toggles freeze until the watcher closes or Quill restarts
fix: Set stopped from a drop guard in the worker closure, and set it when spawn_guarded fails

title: Tray::set_unread records last_shown before the icon is set, and ignores set_icon failure
trigger: Native set_icon/Icon::from_rgba fails once for a count
effect: last_shown already equals (unread,muted,dark), so the icon is not retried until the count changes; tooltip may then disagree with the icon
fix: Record last_shown only after set_icon returns Ok

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut on TRAY held across native tray calls
trigger: sync_tray runs (Tray::new / set_icon / state.poll) while any code in that call re-enters tray_available()/tray_registering() (they borrow() the same cell)
effect: BorrowError panic on the UI thread; no re-entry path found today, but the guard spans native calls (panic-safety rule 6)
fix: Take the Tray out of the cell for the call, or use try_borrow_mut with early return

title: TranslatePrefs::skip dedups only adjacent entries, so a duplicate language makes toggle_skip a no-op
trigger: translate_prefs.json skip_languages lists the same language twice non-adjacently (or two aliases that normalize to one code, e.g. zh and zh-CN)
effect: toggle_skip removes only the first match; the second stays, so the language cannot be removed from Do Not Translate
fix: Dedup with a seen-set in skip() and normalize on load

title: AgeCheck { NotStarted, Started } is the old age_verify_started bool; nothing clears it but the screen drop
trigger: Tap Verify my age (sets Started), finish or abandon the verification, later the server asks for age verification again, then turn on Show 18+ Content
effect: age_gate_blocks sees Started and skips the prompt although the server asks again; the flag lives for the whole screen. Section 8 07-021 skip says already OpenNotice + AgeCheck, which is the same flag as a two-variant enum
fix: Derive from the session's age_verification (the verification the bot was opened for, carried in the notice or session) or an AgeCheck::Started{asked_for: params id} that is dropped when session.sync.age_verification changes

title: submit_delete_account clears the inputs, resets the stage and drops the send error
trigger: Open Account box, type the 2FA password and a reason, arm Delete, press Alright delete while chats_path_active() is false or a TTL write is pending (delete_account returns Err(InvalidRequest))
effect: The password and reason are wiped, the confirm banner collapses to Open and no note is shown; the user believes the deletion started or has to retype everything
fix: Match the Result of driver.delete_account: only on Ok clear inputs and leave ConfirmDelete (AccountOp::Mutating(id) shows the progress); on Err keep ConfirmDelete and set an error note

title: submit_account_ttl and submit_default_auto_delete drop the driver's Err
trigger: Pick a self-destruct period or auto-delete preset while the chats path is not active or another account mutation is pending
effect: The radio snaps back (value is authoritative) with no note and no retry hint
fix: On Err set StatusNote::error (as submit_logout does) or disable the radios while not sendable

title: AccountsUiState keeps open, row_edit and error as three fields reset by hand at six sites
trigger: open_accounts, close_accounts, start_account_rename, save_account_name, the Rename cancel, the Remove arm and cancel buttons each clear a different subset of row_edit and error
effect: No bug today (open_accounts and close_accounts reset both), but a new site that forgets error shows a stale line over the next row action
fix: enum AccountsDialog { Closed, Open { row_edit: AccountRowEdit, error: Option<String> } } replaced whole on open and close; the DialogSpec predicate reads Open

title: wake_at is a 0-sentinel slot naming a timer whose Task is detach()ed
trigger: While the takeover phase changes with nothing animating, wake_takeover_at schedules a one-shot timer; takeover.wake_at (0 = none) records its time and the detached task resets it
effect: No stuck state today (a later render reschedules), but the stage and its timer are two things: the timer cannot be cancelled and a replaced earlier wake still fires and notifies
fix: enum Wake { None, At { at: u64, _task: Task<()> } } held in TakeoverUi; replacing it drops the older timer

title: Driver::Running { id, waiting } names an input command's task, which is detach()ed; the exit runs only if the window update succeeds
trigger: An agent sends an input command (ui_click) and a second one that queues in waiting; the main window is closed or its update_in fails before the first command's task reaches agent_command_finished
effect: Driver stays Running for the process: every later input command is pushed into waiting and never started or answered, so the agent's tool times out until Quill restarts
fix: Hold the command's Task inside Driver::Running so dropping the owner ends it, and have agent_command_finished (or a Drop guard) leave the stage and answer the waiting Pendings with window_closed

title: The consent and reset-token boxes are hidden with && enabled() instead of being closed when Agent access goes off
trigger: Open Reset token (reset_confirm) or the All other chats consent, turn Agent access off from another window or Revoke, then turn it on again
effect: The box reappears with the old scope or token-reset question on the next render, and Allow would widen grants the user asked for before the switch changed
fix: Clear both in set_agent_access / Revoke (one place), or make the box state part of the access-on stage; section 8 12-112 only covers that reset_confirm is the registry predicate, not this extra condition

title: The recent-actions chat is held three times: EventLogSearch::shows, EventLogPage::chat and GroupSettingsDialog::chat_id, reconciled by frame upkeep
trigger: Open Recent actions for chat A, go to chat B's log by any route (info panel, Group Settings of another window)
effect: No bug today: event_log_search_upkeep refills the box when shows != open chat and event_log_page_for replaces the page; but the box text is wrong for one frame and the refill is a per-frame reset from outside the transition
fix: One EventLogView { chat, search_input_text_for: chat, page } owned by the Recent actions page of GroupSettingsDialog, replaced whole when the chat changes

title: autoload mark is set before load_more_event_log sends; a failed send leaves the mark and the Loading older spinner
trigger: In Recent actions with has_more at the top of a short list, fetch_chat_event_log_more returns Err (connection down)
effect: A note flashes, the list shows Loading older forever and the mark equals the list length, so render never asks again; only a scroll event or reopening the page retries
fix: Set the mark only when the send returned Ok, or EventLogMore { Idle, Asked { len, request } } cleared by the error arm; show Retry on failure

title: event_log_ids RefCell borrow_mut is held across ListState reset/splice/remeasure calls
trigger: Recent actions list rebuilt while a scroll-handler defer or measure re-enters the app (event_log_list_view line 483, event_log_reset_list line 462)
effect: A re-entrant borrow would panic and end the process; today nothing re-enters event_log_ids, so no crash is known
fix: Take the ids out of the cell (std::mem::take), plan the sync, call the list, write the new ids back; or keep ids as plain field behind &mut self

title: RefCell borrow_mut().take() in the dialog content closure (one-shot body cell)
trigger: The kit calls the content closure again while it runs (re-entrancy), which no known path does
effect: Would panic on a nested borrow; today the guard is a temporary dropped in the same statement
fix: try_borrow_mut with an empty div fallback, or hand the element over without a RefCell

title: RefCell borrow_mut().take() in the Accounts dialog content closure (one-shot body cell)
trigger: Same as 07-5-011: re-entrant call of the content closure
effect: Would panic on a nested borrow; none known
fix: try_borrow_mut with an empty div fallback

title: RefCell borrow_mut().take() in dialog_with's content closure (shared by the request, consent and reset boxes)
trigger: Same as 07-5-011: re-entrant call of the content closure
effect: Would panic on a nested borrow; none known
fix: try_borrow_mut with an empty div fallback

title: BLOCKED thread-local RefCell borrow_mut (block_opened_by_agent, take_blocked_closing_layers) and the queue is not owner-scoped
trigger: An agent step opens a hard dialog in one window; the queue names it by dialog or layer name only, and the shell of another window or account takes it before the owner's frame
effect: A borrow in a re-entrant drain would panic; and a queued name can close a same-named box of another window or the next account after a switch
fix: Key entries by (ScreenEpoch, window) and use try_borrow_mut, or return the Vec from the step instead of a global

title: AiComposeOpen::view and ::editor must change together (editor is Some exactly in the StyleEditor and StyleIcon views)
trigger: Reset by hand in ai_compose_dismissed, remove_ai_style, ai_style_edit_upkeep and open_ai_style_editor; set_ai_compose_view(StyleEditor) is callable with editor None
effect: None today; a missed reset shows an empty editor view (ai_style_editor_view returns an empty div)
fix: AiComposeView::StyleEditor(StyleEditor) / StyleIcon(StyleEditor) carrying the editor, so leaving the view drops it

title: AiComposeUi::button_shown_at is a derived 'button was wanted last frame' flag kept in step by sync_ai_compose_button
trigger: Main window upkeep only (locked or hidden main window skips it); a chat window's button never blinks and reads BLINK; value follows the main window's composer while the button draws in any window
effect: Blink skipped or wrong window; no data loss
fix: Derive the blink start from the composer's own visibility transition per window (WindowSlot), or an enum ButtonFade{Hidden,Shown{at}} owned by the window that draws it

title: Closing the AI box leaves the language search text; it reappears when the box is reopened
trigger: Open box, Translate tab, tap the language, type a query, Cancel and close the box, open it again and open the language picker
effect: The picker opens filtered by the old query
fix: Clear language_search in close_ai_compose / open_ai_compose (or hold the query in AiComposeView::Languages)

title: ai_compose_dispatch returns without failing the box when there is no live connection, so the box stays Loading
trigger: Open the box (or change tab) while self.live is None (demo session, connection being replaced)
effect: Skeleton and spinner stay until the box is closed; the request token is never answered nor failed
fix: Treat live None like a send error: ai.fail(token, ..) and toast

title: open_ai_style_preview treats 'no live connection' as sent, so the preview stays LookingUp forever
trigger: Open an addstyle link while self.live is None
effect: Loading skeleton with no request out; only closing the box ends it
fix: is_none_or should be a send failure unless demo_session is the owner

title: remove_ai_style closes the editor and returns to the card when nothing was sent (no live)
trigger: Edit Style, Delete Style, confirm, while live is None
effect: Editor closes with no toast, the style is not deleted
fix: Only close the editor on Some(Ok(request)); toast on None

title: PreviewStage::LookingUp { token: 0 } is a placeholder stage written by mem::replace at three sites
trigger: show_again, add_ai_style_from_preview and remove_ai_style swap in a fake LookingUp stage before matching the old one back; an early return between would leave a lookup with token 0 that nothing answers
effect: None today; a transition written as take-and-put-back
fix: A by-value transition method on PreviewStage (fn into_adding(self, request) -> Self) so no placeholder is needed

title: Layer::prepaint and Layer::paint hold items.borrow() across layout, prepaint, paint and the build closures
trigger: A tile or mirror element built by the layer that registers or paints layered content in the same Layer (Layered::prepaint/paint borrow items; register uses borrow_mut) would hit a BorrowMutError panic; panic-safety rule 6
effect: Process abort on a re-entrant registration
fix: Clone the Rc'd content out of the borrow (or index with short borrows) before calling into GPUI

title: Slice frame stage is LayerState::painted (Cell<bool>) plus per-item seq==0 sentinel, inline and opacity Cells, reset by begin_frame/end_frame
trigger: begin_frame clears items and painted; plan() reads painted to decide replay vs fresh; items registered by a discarded prepaint keep seq 0
effect: None today; a frame is Prepainting / Painted(items) held as three loose pieces
fix: enum Frame { Prepainting(items), Painted(items) } with Item { painted: Option<Painted{seq,opacity,inline}> }

title: Non-test RefCell borrow/borrow_mut on frame.media_roots_frame (also taken in app_render/mod.rs:108)
trigger: media_display_roots reads borrow(), computes, then borrow_mut(); render does borrow_mut().take(); a re-entrant call from compute_media_display_roots while a guard lives would panic
effect: Process abort if the guards ever overlap (they are short today)
fix: Cell<Option<Rc<[PathBuf]>>> with take/set, no guard

title: TakeoverUi::wake_at names a pending timer (0 = none) while the task is a detached spawn_app in agent_takeover.rs
trigger: wake_takeover_at sets wake_at then spawns a detached timer; an earlier timer still fires after being superseded and clears nothing; it runs while locked or hidden
effect: One spare notify per superseded timer; no way to cancel on owner going away
fix: Option<(u64, Task)> held in the stage; dropping it cancels the wake

title: Story cover and privacy answers settle by request but act on the panel and story open now, not the ones that sent
trigger: Save a story cover (or privacy), open the Cover picker on another story or reopen it before the answer; Saved closes whichever Cover panel is open; Failed reports against open_cover_story()
effect: A fresh picker closes under the user, or the failure names the wrong story
fix: Hold the story key with the request (cover_request: Option<(RequestId, StoryKey)>) and close or report only when the panel is for that key

title: Main render runs file-fetching steps before the lock check, so a Premium preview left open keeps downloading while locked
trigger: Open a Premium feature preview, lock the app; sync_premium_preview_files (and inline_videos_frame_start, check_video_pip, sync_video_avatar, sync_userpic_videos) still run each frame before is_locked() returns locked_root
effect: Downloads and video work while locked; contradicts 'what runs while locked' (only notifications)
fix: Move the steps under a lock_waits() guard or after the locked early return

title: Toast wake-up is a detached spawn_screen task named by ToastQueue::wake; skipped after an account switch, so the toast outlives its deadline until something else redraws
trigger: Account A posts a toast (wake armed for deadline D, task detached). Switch to account B before D. At D the task's update is not run (spawn_screen: no updates once another account is on screen), so no notify happens; ToastQueue (app part of ConnectionUi) is shown on B and nothing redraws an idle B.
effect: The toast stays on screen past its time until the next unrelated redraw; ToastQueue::wake keeps naming a timer that never delivered
fix: hold the timer Task inside the queue's stage (Armed { deadline, task }) and spawn it as an app task (spawn_app), so it notifies whichever account is on screen and is dropped with the queue

title: AiAsk::Asked is matched by composer markup, and the AI answer slots carry no RequestId; the send's RequestId is dropped
trigger: Press Fix, then Rewrite on the same draft before the first answer lands (send_ai_compose does not refuse while AiAsk::Asked). Both asks store Asked{markup} and both answers match it.
effect: The first answer is applied as if it were the second ask's; the second answer then finds AiAsk::Idle and shows 'the draft changed, AI answer ignored' although nothing was typed. If both answers arrive within one frame the single Option slot (ai_composer_text / ai_composer_blocks) is overwritten and one is lost. A failed ask leaves Asked set for good, so a late answer for an old ask applies whenever the field holds the same markup again.
fix: AiAsk::Asked { request: RequestId, markup } (as SentText::Sent does), the answer carries its RequestId and applies only when it equals the held one; an error answer returns the stage to Idle

title: The custom accent picker is built once from accent_rgb and never follows the applied theme or accent
trigger: On Day pick a custom accent in the Custom select, then click the Night tile (or click a preset accent circle). appearance_accent_section draws the new theme's selected swatch, but ColorSelect still shows the old picker value (accent_picker has no writer after construction).
effect: Two values for one accent: the swatch row says one colour, the Custom field shows another theme's colour (or the stale old single accent_rgb)
fix: derive the picker value from theme_accent(applied theme) whenever the applied theme or accent changes (set_value in set_theme_accent / apply_appearance), or build it per applied theme

title: Wallpaper delete confirm holds a bare background id, is never re-checked with removable(), and has no closer
trigger: Click the x on wallpaper W (inline confirm opens), then open W's preview and Apply it (W is now in use) or leave Appearance and come back; the confirm is still there and Delete removes W. Leaving Settings does not clear DialogsUi::wallpaper_remove.
effect: The in-use wallpaper (or one the list no longer has) can be removed; a context-free 'Delete this wallpaper?' reappears when Appearance is reopened
fix: confirm stage owned by the Appearance page (cleared when the page closes) and validated against removable(background, in_use) at confirm time

title: conversation_rendered and conversation_shown are two Cell<bool> kept in step by hand (render sets, history_drawn takes both)
trigger: render_slice sets conversation_rendered, conversation_column sets conversation_shown, history_drawn() replaces both with false; readers (notify_tick, notify_conversations) read conversation_shown() between frames
effect: No bug today; the three real stages (absent / replayed from cache / rendered) are encoded in two flags whose combination and reset order matter, and a tick read between the reset and the next layout sees 'not shown'
fix: one Cell<ConversationFrame> enum { Absent, Replayed, Rendered }

title: 'Make Quill the default' re-reads the handler through three detached 1/3/8 s timers that no stage owns
trigger: Click the button (macOS/Windows button form); three cx.spawn timers are detached, each calling link_handler::read_now() and notify. Clicking again stacks three more; they also fire after Settings is closed or the app is locked.
effect: Wasted reads and redraws; the 'waiting for the system confirmation' stage exists only as timers
fix: a LinkHandlerCheck { Idle, Rechecking { task } } stage in PreferencesUi that owns one task which polls at 1/3/8 s and is dropped on a new click or when the page goes

title: Capture is reset to Idle by hand at five call sites instead of one transition
trigger: Cancel button (113), Reset (139), Escape (221), a refused chord (234) and a saved chord (253) each write Capture::Idle directly; only start_capture and KeybindingUi::end are methods
effect: No bug today; each site decides separately whether the row's refusal message goes too (Reset clears it, Cancel and Escape keep it), so the next site can miss one
fix: KeybindingUi::cancel() / finish() that move Waiting to Idle and own the refusal bookkeeping

title: The Omarchy watcher polls every 2 s for the life of the process once a theme is found, even when not following Omarchy, hidden or locked
trigger: Run on Omarchy with follow_omarchy off (or minimise to tray / lock); the Watching stage keeps the loop: timer, background stat, and on a change OmarchyState::read + apply_appearance + notify
effect: A background thread hop every 2 s and a redraw on every Omarchy theme switch while the user does not use the theme
fix: enter Watching only while appearance.follow_omarchy (or the chooser is open) and leave to Found otherwise, dropping the task

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut of frame.surfaces.toasts in the render path
trigger: status_toast_in runs per window frame; any future call from inside the borrow (follow/moving are pure today) or a re-entrant frame would panic. chat_window close uses try_borrow_mut for the same cell, so the two paths already assume overlap.
effect: Panic on the UI thread if the borrow ever overlaps
fix: try_borrow_mut with an early return (panic-safety rule 6) or a plain per-window slot owned by the WindowSlot

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut inside the theme editor dialog content closure, used as a one-shot take slot
trigger: The scrollable dialog content closure runs at render; a second call of the same closure gets the fallback empty div instead of the body
effect: Today the dialog is rebuilt every frame so each closure runs once; if the kit calls it again (resize, re-layout) the editor body disappears. A nested borrow would panic.
fix: build the body inside the closure (it only reads QuillApp state captured by value) or use try_borrow_mut

title: The Appearance page asks for the installed wallpapers from render, and a failed send returns the Fetch to Idle so the next frame asks again
trigger: Open Appearance while the connection cannot send (fetch_installed_backgrounds: InvalidRequest, or send_json fails and calls cancel()). ensure_wallpapers_loaded runs in every render of the page and the result is dropped with let _.
effect: A request attempt per render for as long as the page is open and the send keeps failing; no Failed stage records that the send did not leave
fix: Fetch::fail on a send error (shown with the page's Retry button), asked once per page open from the open transition instead of from render

title: Building::land_paused is a bool stage kept in step by hand with the old track's player pause state
trigger: Press Play on a voice note, press Pause while it is still loading, press Play again, seek during the load
effect: pause()/resume() flip building.land_paused and pause/play the old track player separately; nothing ties the two, and state() reads only land_paused while a build runs
fix: Building { landing: Landing::{Playing, Held} } with the old sound's pause derived from it

title: Simulation mode is three fields kept in step by hand: simulation, sim_clock, sim_stalled_since
trigger: Demo run with QUILL_DEMO_AUDIO_STALL: seek twice
effect: sim_stalled_since is stamped by the first hung seek (get_or_insert), only stop() clears it, so DeviceStalled sticks for the rest of the track even after later seeks
fix: Backend::{Device{track,building}, Simulated{clock, stalled_since}} one value chosen at start

title: state() ignores Standing::Stale, so a seek made on a track that ran out is undone by the tick as an end
trigger: Play a music file, hold the seek thumb on the bar until the track runs out, drag back and release
effect: seek(offset,false) parks the position with standing=Stale but state() still reads player.empty() as Ended; the next tick sees is_ended(), stops the track and starts the next one instead of seeking
fix: state() maps Stale (or Failed/Stale beside an empty player) to Paused; or seek on an ended track restarts the build

title: VIDEO_OUTPUT RefCell borrow is held across SharedOutput::outlet()/ready_or_wake(), which lock a mutex and may spawn a thread
trigger: Video soundtrack starts or a clip asks video_output_ready() while the output opens
effect: No reentrant borrow today (nothing in outlet() touches VIDEO_OUTPUT), but it breaks panic-safety rule 6 and a future call from there would panic on borrow_mut at line 180
fix: Clone the SharedOutput out of the cell, drop the guard, then call it

title: baseline: Tempo::done
trigger: Play any track to its end, then seek back
effect: done, inner_done and prev (None = first slice) are three flags of the stretcher's stage, and reset() clears each by hand
fix: Stretch::{Starting, Streaming, InputEnded, Done}

title: baseline: Tempo::inner_done
trigger: Play any track to its end, then seek back
effect: inner_done pairs with done and prev; step() reads them in three places and reset() clears them one by one
fix: Stretch::{Starting, Streaming, InputEnded, Done}

title: The active track's data is still spread over seven fields cleared by clear_playback_state (skip 08-039 gives no reason beyond 'still separate')
trigger: Play a voice note, then a music file, then stop
effect: ActiveTrack, track_length, seek_slider, scrub, seek_hover, player.chat, player.meta change together. stop_voice_playback() alone, with an audio track active, wipes that audio track's track_length and seek_slider (every caller today calls both stops in a row, so no visible bug yet)
fix: ActiveTrack::{Voice,Audio}(Track { id, chat, meta, length, slider }) so one take clears all

title: PhoneStep::Sending holds no RequestId; the answer is matched by requests.has_auth_submit() (any auth submit) and last_auth_error.is_some()
trigger: Submit a phone number, then see the answer arrive
effect: sync_phone_step decides accepted vs rejected from the purpose class and a shared error slot, not from the request that Sending sent
fix: Sending { phone, back, request: RequestId } resolved by that id's answer

title: The new-login-prevented box is an Option<Vec<String>> in AuthUi beside account_boxes.notice (OpenNotice) and terms_prompt, with a priority chain in account_notice()
trigger: Decline a new login on another device while a freeze notice is open
effect: One 'which account notice is open' stage is held by three owners; account_notice() picks by if-chain priority, and dismiss clears each by hand
fix: OpenNotice::LoginPrevented(places) variant, one slot

title: A second Enter while a sign-in submit is in flight shows 'Couldn't submit ...' although the first went out
trigger: Type a code, password, phone or recovery code and press Enter twice quickly (also Forgot password? twice, Resend recovery code)
effect: The Enter path ignores the busy state the buttons use; the driver refuses the second send (login_request has_purpose, or an emptied code/password field) and the handler sets StatusNote::error over the success note
fix: Skip the submit while has_auth_submit() (one guard in the submit_on_enter path)

title: cancel_password_recovery writes session.auth_state.password_recovery = Idle from the UI instead of a session transition
trigger: Forgot password, request code, press Back
effect: PasswordRecovery moves Idle/Requested/CodeSent in the reducer and driver but this one transition is a field write from the window layer
fix: Session::cancel_password_recovery() beside the other transitions

title: BackgroundRing keeps dismissed and notified as two bools for the prompt and OS-notification stages of one ring
trigger: Background account rings; close the prompt with Esc; click the OS notification
effect: dismissed/notified are set from the dialog close, the notification path and flush_background_call_picks separately; notified is set before the notification is spawned and never reset
fix: Ring { prompt: Shown|Dismissed, notice: Unsent|Sent }

title: Active::pressed_at is an Option<Instant> used as the 'middle button is down' flag for hold-or-toggle
trigger: Middle-press to anchor, release the button outside the window or after the window loses the mouse-up
effect: Option::take in autoscroll_release is the only exit from 'held'; a lost mouse-up leaves the mode in held state, so it keeps scrolling until a click or focus loss instead of toggling
fix: Active.button: Held{since} | Toggled

title: after_closing polls every 16 ms with no cap and no owner; a Wait that never resolves spins forever and keeps the account in deleting
trigger: Remove an account or log out from the lock screen while a start_connection preparation hangs (screen_preparing never returns to 0) or a preparation for that key never ends
effect: deletion_wait stays Wait on screen_preparing > 0 or prepare.running(key); the detached task loops forever, done never runs and deleting keeps the key
fix: Hold the waiter Task in the waited set with a deadline that turns into CloseWait::Never

title: icon_svg caches a failed read as None for the life of the process
trigger: A bot's icon file is unreadable or not yet an SVG when the attach menu first renders, then the file is replaced at the same path
effect: Cache entry Option::None is never retried or evicted, so the menu keeps the bot glyph until restart; the cache also never shrinks
fix: Cache only successes, or key by (path, mtime)

title: A background client that dies or fails is never started again until the user switches, connects or unlocks
trigger: A signed-in background account's TDLib client stops (bridge.stopped_unexpectedly, or a start fails with Failed); poll_background takes its live and pushes it to closing with restart=false
effect: That account stops notifying and counting unread until the next connect, switch, unlock or disk resume (the only callers of ensure_background_accounts); nothing re-runs the pass on a timer, so the retryable() path is unreachable while the user stays on one account
fix: push_closing(..., restart: matches!(status, Failed)) with a backoff clock, or an ensure pass scheduled by the poll when any client is retryable()

title: BoostPhase::Working carries no RequestId; boost answers are matched by purpose and chat id
trigger: Press Boost (BoostChat or slots read in flight), close the box, reopen it for the same chat and press Boost again; then the first request's error lands
effect: The error arm (state/domains/groups/error.rs) and the ChatBoostSlots arm find the new box by chat id and reset its Working phase to Main with the old error note, so the button re-enables while the second request is still out and a second boostChat can be sent
fix: BoostWork::{Slots(RequestId), Boosting{request: RequestId, reassign}} and compare pending.id in the apply and error arms

title: Opening the Create Bot box resets the create state even while an earlier createBot is in flight
trigger: Press Create, close the box with Esc while Creating (close_bot_create keeps the state on purpose), then open another tg://newbot link or managed-bot button before the answer
effect: open_bot_create calls reset_create_bot unconditionally: stage goes Creating -> Editing and generation is bumped, so the answer no longer matches submission.generation; the bot exists on the server but is never reported, its chat never opens and the keyboard-button share is never answered
fix: reset_create_bot only when !creating(), or keep Creating in the stage and have a new box adopt it

title: EditStage { Loading, Editing } mirrors the session's BotText load stage beside it
trigger: Open the bot edit box; the box's own Loading/Editing and edit.name/about BotText::{Loading,Ready,Failed} must agree
effect: No bug today: loaded is computed from both, and fill_bot_edit (frame upkeep of the hosting window only) moves the box stage when the session stage turns Ready; a box hosted by a window that never draws stays Loading
fix: One stage: the fields are filled from BotText::Ready where it is first read, or the box stage carries the RequestIds it waits for

title: Verify/remove verification is fire and forget: the answer is not matched, a failure is never shown
trigger: Pick a chat and press Verify (or Remove); TDLib refuses (bot not allowed, flood, chat gone)
effect: submit_bot_verify drops the RequestId, sets a silent 'Verifying...' note and returns the box to Pick; no stage waits for the answer, so the pick shows the old state with no error and no end to the note
fix: Step::Sending { request: RequestId, chat } closed by the answer (acks.expect like BoxSend) with the error on the box

title: SimilarBotsFetch is a hand-made Fetch: Loading holds no RequestId, Failed is an absent entry
trigger: Press the similar-bots button on a bot card; the request is lost or answered late
effect: Answers (Loaded) and refusals (remove) are matched by purpose plus the bot's user id, not by the request held in Loading, and absence means both Idle and Failed so a failure cannot show its reason in the panel
fix: HashMap<i64, Fetch<Vec<i64>>> with Loading(RequestId) and Failed(error)

title: Going Back or picking another chat while an Add-bot send is out drops the start payload
trigger: Add a bot as administrator from a link with a start parameter, press Add as admin, then press Back (not disabled while sending) before the promotion answers
effect: belongs_to turns false, pump_box_send runs forget_box_send and drops then_start: the promotion still happens but sendBotStartMessage with the link's parameter is never sent
fix: Disable Back while box_sending(), or keep the follow-up in the session with the request instead of the box

title: baseline: BarFacts::bot_start_pending
trigger: A bot chat with a start parameter or an empty loaded history
effect: No bug: derived from bot_start_params and the history each frame, but it is a stage-named bool and the Start button stays shown until the reducer drops the parameter or a message arrives
fix: BottomBar decided from an enum StartState { NotStartable, Offered, Starting(RequestId) }

title: Unblock and restart sends /start right behind the unblock request, before it is answered
trigger: A blocked bot shows Restart; press it: set_chat_user_blocked returns Ok(Some) and restart_now is true
effect: start_bot_from_bar runs at once while the chat is still blocked on the server; if the unblock then fails the /start is refused and the bot stays blocked with two notes; only a refused or deduped send was guarded
fix: Chain the start on the unblock's answer (stage Unblocking{then_start})

title: StreamReveal::Finishing matches by message id only and is never reset when the chat changes
trigger: A bot reply finishes (Finishing{message}) and the user leaves the chat before the reveal ends; later a message with the same id is drawn in another chat of the account
effect: history.stream_reveal lives in the per-account HistoryUi, not per chat; drawing() ignores the chat, so a colliding id paints the old text's cut (or a stale frozen height) until a draft or the final frame ends it
fix: Key Finishing by ChatMessage and reset to Idle in sync_chat_ui

title: Appearing keeps its width and height animations in step by hand
trigger: Each frame; text_changed from a new draft or the final message
effect: No bug found: width/target_width/start_width/width_duration, height/target_height/shown_height, sweeps (First/Later, a two-variant enum), finalizing and the one-shot fresh bool are updated together in check_line, start_width and text_changed
fix: enum Sweep { Idle, Width{tween,target,start}, Height{..} } per line, finalizing as part of the reveal stage

title: emoji_access_shown is only ever added to, and is added before the request is sent
trigger: Flip the Emoji Status switch on a bot profile; the send fails, or access is later revoked elsewhere
effect: The OfAccount set grows for the run and keeps the section visible for a bot that no longer has access (even when the first send failed); nothing clears it on closing the profile
fix: Per-profile stage (ProfileUi) that dies with the profile panel

title: The Linux battery probe loop is detached and keeps probing while the window is hidden or locked
trigger: Linux with no portal or daemon signal and Save Power on Low Battery on: hide or lock the app
effect: The loop spawns a probe (gdbus) every 30 s forever (POLL), with no owner or hidden/locked gate; only the switch-off and event-driven cases park it
fix: Hold the Task in an owner that drops it on hide/lock, or park while no window is visible

title: Chatbots draft Loading is filled by a detached 200 ms polling task, not by the answer
trigger: Open Chatbots; BotLink::Loading waits on getBusinessConnectedBot; business_bot_watch polls Session every 200 ms and copies the answer in; Retry spawns another loop
effect: Nothing wrong today; a second loop per Retry; the draft only fills while a poller lives, so an answer after the poller ended (pump treats not-loading+no-data as done) never reaches the draft
fix: Fill the draft from business_info_upkeep like the other screens (pure function of Fetch state), or hold the Task in BotLink::Loading{task}

title: Pump counts Idle as failed, ends the watcher, and leaves Loading with no Retry
trigger: Chatbots open with GetConnectedBot in flight while a SaveConnectedBot ok/error from a previous leave lands and sets connected_bot = Idle; the 200 ms pump sees not-loading+no data and stops; the real answer then arrives
effect: Screen shows Loading... with no error line and no Retry until the box is closed and reopened
fix: Pump should match Fetch::Failed only; Idle/Loading keep waiting (or drive from upkeep)

title: Save answers write Fetch::Idle over a connected_bot fetch that may be in flight; save_connected_bot also writes Ready over it
trigger: Leave Chatbots with a change (save sent, Ready(bot)); ok lands (Idle); re-enter (fetch R in flight); change and leave again (Ready(bot2) over Loading) then R answers with the older server value
effect: connected_bot shows the old bot (or Idle) after the second save until the next visit refetches
fix: Keep the Loading request id in the stage and only apply the answer whose id is current; a save answer should not rewrite Fetch

title: A failed time zone list shows Loading... with no Retry on the zone screen
trigger: Hours > time zone while getTimeZones failed
effect: The list says Loading... forever; the failure line shows under the box but only Back and re-enter (business_go) or a Save attempt asks again
fix: Draw Fetch::Failed with a Retry button like the links and chatbot screens

title: Saving indicator is a Vec of setting kinds, answered by kind not RequestId
trigger: Leave Greeting (save 1), reopen it, change, leave (save 2); answer 1 arrives
effect: apply_business_ok/error retain-out every entry of that kind, so Saving... goes while save 2 is still out, and a refusal of save 1 is shown as the current one
fix: Vec<(RequestId, kind)> or a per-kind SaveStage::Saving(RequestId) matched on the answer's id

title: Link box save stage lives in the Session and is reset by hand from the box's openers
trigger: open_business and open_business_link_edit call reset_link_save; business_link_save_upkeep resets after Saved; leaving the LinkEdit view mid-save leaves Saving/Saved in the Session
effect: No bug today (Saving carries a RequestId); the box's stage has an owner other than the box and three hand resets
fix: Put the save stage in LinkEditDraft (Saving(RequestId)/Saved) and let the answer be matched on it

title: Sticker panel opened for the start page is closed by hand from three places
trigger: business_go leaving StickerPick, close_business, route_business_start_page_sticker each call close_start_page_stickers; select_sticker_tab(Installed) changes the shared per-account panel
effect: If a new exit path is added the shared sticker panel stays on the Installed tab (and the composer picker inherits it)
fix: Make StartPageSub::Stickers own the panel open (a guard closed on drop/Screen::go)

title: call_window_target returns (call, ringing, ended, busy): two stage bools beside the ids
trigger: sync_call_window reads ended and busy from the tuple and recombines them with CallEnd and lingering
effect: No bug today; Active/Ringing/Ended/Busy are four stages of one thing kept as a tuple
fix: enum CallWindowTarget { None, Active{id}, Ringing{id}, Ended{id}, Busy{id}, Invite{key} }

title: baseline: CallSnap::connecting (beside CallPhase and status)
trigger: Status line is derived by call_status which returns (String,bool)
