effect: connecting spins the ring; kept next to phase/status computed together
fix: Fold into CallPhase::Active{connecting} or a CallStatus enum returned by call_status

title: CallEnd::Lingering names a linger timer whose Task is detached, and lingering is read from Instant
trigger: Call ends; sync spawns cx.spawn(timer).detach() and flips Lingering back to Ended when it fires; a second sync decides by at.elapsed()
effect: Works (guarded by call_id); the stage says a timer runs but the timer is not held in it, and tests cannot drive it with a manual clock
fix: Hold the Task in CallEnd::Lingering{task} (dropped on a new call) and take time from a clock the tests control

title: window_closed_by_user and window_open_failed are Option<i32> call-id slots that only the call bar clears
trigger: Close the call window mid-call, end the call, later call again
effect: Nothing clears them at call end; they hold a dead call id (harmless while ids differ) and are one-shot slots with no way out except show_call_window
fix: enum WindowWanted { Open, ClosedByUser(call_id), OpenFailed(call_id) } reset by the call's end

title: CallPanel::devices_menu is reset by hand inside render when the phase leaves Active
trigger: Open the device menu, call ends; render sets devices_menu = None
effect: State written from render instead of by the call's transition; another window of the same call keeps its own copy
fix: Key the menu by call id (Option<(call_id, target)>) and ignore it when the call differs

title: MicTestRun::On names a watchdog whose Task is detached; mic_test_starts counter sits beside the enum
trigger: Start the test, stop, start again within 500 ms
effect: Two watchdog loops run for one test (each exits only when not On); the stage does not own its watcher
fix: Hold the Task in MicTestRun::On and drop it with the stage; keep the token inside Opening only

title: A mic test whose device failed keeps requesting 30 fps animation ticks
trigger: Settings > Calls, Test microphone with no usable device (test.source.error() is Some)
effect: request_animation_tick(30) and last_render.set run before the error early return, so the watchdog never stops the test and the page redraws while it is visible
fix: Return the error before ticking and move a failed test to MicTestRun::Failed(reason)

title: AddPeopleBox.search Option is a created flag and initial_query is a one-shot slot, both set during render
trigger: Open Add People: call_add_people_overlay (render) creates the field, takes initial_query, subscribes and fires search_add_people
effect: Box has two stages (not built, built) as Option + a String taken once; the request is sent from render
fix: enum AddPeopleStage { Opening{initial}, Open{search} } built when the box opens (window passed in)

title: The Add People search state in the Session is cleared by hand at four sites and not by the account's Farewell
trigger: Open Add People, type a name, switch account (CallScreen Farewell closes only the chooser and privacy box) and back
effect: call_boxes.add_people is dropped with OnScreen but Session.calls.add_people_search keeps the query and results until another close path or the call ending clears it
fix: Make the box's close (or Farewell) the single place that clears the search; or own the search inside AddPeopleBox

title: A request is queued from render while the sessions list is Idle and cannot be sent
trigger: Settings > Calls with live set but the chats path inactive (maybe_fetch_active_sessions returns Err, stays Idle)
effect: Every render of the section spawns another screen task that does nothing (no notify, so no loop, but wasted work per frame)
fix: Start the fetch when the section opens (an Asker/opener), not from render

title: HISTORY_AREA keeps the last history area per thread and is never cleared
trigger: Open Settings > Appearance (preview bubbles with a gradient theme) in the window whose chat was last painted, or close the chat
effect: gradient_layer falls back to history_area_of(window) which still holds the old chat geometry, so the preview or any non-history bubble takes a wrong slice of the gradient
fix: Report the area with an explicit owner each frame and clear it when the history stops painting; pass the area to bubbles instead of a thread-local

title: PermissionAsk::Asking sticks when the asking window closes or the screen goes before the system prompt is answered; the poll task is detached
trigger: macOS: press Call or record in a chat window while the camera/microphone is undetermined, close that chat window (or switch account away and back is fine, OnScreen is replaced) before answering the prompt, then answer it
effect: the task's update is refused (ScopedApp::update returns Gone), so recording.permission is never reset to Idle; every later press that needs an undetermined device returns silently at `permission != Idle`: Call, Answer, camera toggle and voice record do nothing until the screen is replaced. The 100 ms poll task also runs until the prompt is answered
fix: Hold the poll Task inside PermissionAsk::Asking {id, call, task} (dropping the stage drops the task), and end the stage from the window-close and screen-farewell paths; or resolve the answer with a channel the stage owns

title: CallTick::{Idle, Running} is a two-variant flag beside the real tick; the loop is spawned with .detach() and Idle is set by hand twice from inside the task
trigger: A call or background ring starts the 1 s tick (ensure_call_tick)
effect: no bug today; Running names a task nobody holds, so it cannot be cancelled by dropping the owner, and Idle is written at the in-loop exit and again after the loop
fix: CallTick::{Idle, Ticking { _task: Task<()> }} like SlowModeTick; drop the second reset

title: CallEnd::Lingering names a running linger timer while the Task is .detach()ed in sync_call_window, and the timer matches by call_id only
trigger: A 1:1 call ends and its window lingers; account switch and back with the same per-account call id while the old timer is pending
effect: an old timer can turn the new account's Lingering back to Ended, so the next sync starts a second timer; harmless today because the close is decided by `at.elapsed()`
fix: Hold the timer Task in CallEnd::Lingering { call_id, at, _timer }, so replacing the stage cancels it; no match by id needed (call_panel.rs:295)

title: CallUi::raised_for is app-wide but holds a per-account call id; CallScreen exists because ids repeat across accounts
trigger: Account A's call 1 rings and raises the open call window (raised_for = Some(1)); the window stays open (a second call or linger) as account B on screen gets its own call 1 ringing
effect: B's ringing call is not raised: raised_for == ringing, so the window is not brought to the front for a call that came in on another account. open_call_window resets it only when a new window opens
fix: Move raised_for into CallScreen (OnScreen, replaced whole on a switch), or key it by (AccountKey, call id)

title: redial dismisses the end summary (and its unanswered rating and uploads) before the dial is accepted; the microphone prompt may still refuse it
trigger: Press Call again on the end card or Redial in the call window with the microphone denied (or the prompt refused)
effect: session.calls.summary is already None, the rating and upload buttons are gone, and no call starts; only a note says access is denied. The comment above says the summary goes only once the dial is accepted
fix: Dismiss the summary inside the continuation that sends the dial (send_dial), after capture access is granted

title: A rating that fails asynchronously loses the draft: submit_call_rating takes rating_detail, and only a synchronous send error puts it back
trigger: Pick stars and problems, type a comment, press Submit; TDLib answers with an error (CallRating::Failed)
effect: the card shows the error and the plain star row again; the problems and stars chosen are gone, and the comment box is cleared by the next open_rating_detail, so the user retypes everything
fix: Keep the draft in the rating stage: CallRating::Sending { request, draft } and Failed { error, draft }, so the answer returns it

title: The rating editor is a second stage in DialogUi (rating_detail: Option<RatingDetail> plus rating_comment_input) next to CallSummary::rating, cleared by hand in dismiss_call_summary and submit
trigger: Rate a call, open the editor, then another call ends and replaces the summary (or the summary is dropped by the reducer)
effect: rating_detail keeps the old call's draft; it is filtered by call_id on read, so it is invisible, but nothing clears it and the comment input keeps the old text until the next open
fix: CallRating::Editing { draft } on the summary itself; the comment input reads from and writes to it

title: sync_call_sounds resets CallBoxes::card_window by hand; four other sites also clear it (answer_call, dismiss_call_summary, dismiss_call_error) and dial_user sets it before the permission answer
trigger: An incoming call arrives while a chat window had pressed Call earlier
effect: the sound sync is where the card's window is cleared for an incoming call, so the card follows the call only because the tick or poll runs; a Call denied at the prompt leaves card_window set until the next dial or dismiss
fix: One call-owned value: ActiveCall/CallSummary carry `card_window` (or CallRoute::{MainWindow, Window(ChatId)}) set by the call's own transitions, not by sound sync

title: With Play sounds off, a mute/connect cue cuts a looping ring and plays nothing: spawn() stops the player before it checks `enabled`; the ring waits out a gap before it resumes
trigger: Play sounds off, a second call ringing during a call, press Mute (play_cue)
effect: the ring is cut for the gap (1 s) although play_cue promises it keeps ringing; player and Loop::On.phase are two fields kept in step by hand (phase set to Playing before spawn)
fix: Return before stop_player when the cue is muted and a loop is on; or make the ring and the cue two slots of one value

title: Editing the draft while Applying writes Editing over the in-flight stage and drops its waiting request ids; closing the box does the same
trigger: Press Apply, then change a swatch (or press Close) before the answers arrive; the first plan fails
effect: the failure is never shown (the ids no longer match), Apply is enabled again and a second plan can race the first on the server; only the 'update requested' note was shown
fix: Disable edits and Apply while Applying (edit_chat_appearance refuses), or keep the in-flight ids in the box until each answers and show a late failure as a note

title: The boost level has no Failed stage: a failed getChatBoostStatus leaves the entry absent, so the box says 'Checking this channel's boost level...' forever
trigger: Open Appearance while getChatBoostStatus fails (offline, error)
effect: the level line never settles and Apply answers LevelUnknown with 'Checking the boost level...' each press; nothing tells the user the check failed
fix: Fetch<(level, boosts)> per chat (Idle/Loading/Ready/Failed) and a Retry row; Apply on Failed re-asks

title: baseline: LiveInput::failed (with idle) is built from three facts each draw instead of one stage
trigger: Every draw of the stream picture
effect: no bug today; the overlay phase is decided from state: Option<PlayState>, idle: bool and failed: bool, where idle and failed both mean 'no picture expected/possible'
fix: StreamPicture::{Idle, Opening, Playing(state), Failed(detail)} computed once by stream_picture_parts

title: PipWindowStage::Opening is matched to its deferred open by `source` equality, not by an open token held in the stage
trigger: Open a PiP for a stream, close it at once, open another for the same source before the first deferred open lands
effect: the first window is attached to the second link and the second window is closed; one PiP survives but through the wrong window, and a different-source replacement relies on the same match
fix: PipWindowStage::Opening { token: OpenId }; the deferred open applies only when the link's token is its own

title: VolumePill::closes_at names a close timer whose Task is .detach()ed in story_viewer/live_view.rs; four input bools plus a deadline kept in step by hand
trigger: Hover the live story's sound toggle, leave, hover again
effect: each leave spawns a detached timer that only notifies; open() is decided by Instant so it self-corrects, but timers pile up and cannot be cancelled by release()
fix: VolumePill::{Closed, Held(inputs), Closing { task }} holding the timer Task

title: thread-local CACHE.borrow_mut() is held across super::image_budget::retire_all (another module) in the if-let body
trigger: A fourth-and-later palette evicts an entry while retire_all calls wake()
effect: no re-entry into CACHE today, but panic-safety rule 6 forbids a borrow guard across a call into another module
fix: Take the evicted value out of the borrow first (let old = cache.borrow_mut().insert(..);) then retire it

title: sync_capture_block records capture_blocked as applied even when apply_native_sharing did nothing (no window handle / no NSWindow), so a failed block is never retried
trigger: macOS or Windows: the first render of the main or a chat window cannot get its native handle while a secret chat is open
effect: frame.capture_blocked (and ChatWindowView::capture_blocked) says blocked, the window is capturable, and nothing re-applies until the wanted value changes; a secret chat can be screenshotted
fix: apply_sharing returns whether it applied; record the flag only on true (Applied/Wanted/Failed stage)

title: DropOnRow keeps hover beside the drag it belongs to
trigger: hover is set by file and forward drags; forward_takes_over clears it only when the file drag had state, forward_over_row/drag_over_row reset seen without touching it
effect: none today; a row can stay lit with no drag in seen
fix: hover inside Dragged::Files/Forward (a row per drag variant); preview as a demo-only variant

title: Freeze::Frozen with an empty order is a hidden third stage (released, timer still running)
trigger: a drag rests two seconds with the pointer still down: release_order clears the map but the Frozen value and its finished timer stay
effect: none; is_held() and order() read emptiness as 'thawed' while the value says Frozen
fix: Freeze { Thawed, Held{order,timer}, Released{timer} } or drop the timer when released

title: FileDrag fields kind, paths, position are set in step by hand and has_state() ORs three of them
trigger: drag_over_row writes kind and paths together on a fresh drag and position separately
effect: none today
fix: FileDrag as Probed{paths,kind} / Unsendable{paths} with position and rest inside the stage

title: The chat list view is two fields in two structs that must change together
trigger: every view change goes through set_chat_list_view; enter_community_chat_list_mode/exit_community_chat_list_mode and open_folder_tab pass the other half from the field
effect: none today; a direct write to either field skips ending the selection and pin drag
fix: one ChatListView { filter, folder } value owned by ChatListUi

title: my_chats_open: Option<bool> is a three-state enum (closed, groups, channels) as Option<bool>
trigger: main_menu_extras sets Some(channels) and clears it in four places; reader unwraps with unwrap_or(false)
effect: none today
fix: enum MyChats { Closed, Groups, Channels }

title: Box open flags beside the dialog stack: downloads_panel_open, archive_hint_open, pending_close_secret_chat
trigger: each is set and cleared by hand at its own sites (archive_hint.rs has four clears); the dialog registry reads them through a predicate
effect: none today; a clear missed on a new exit leaves the box coming back
fix: fold each into the DialogKind registry value that owns the box (Option<Box> or enum carrying data)

title: pending_story_open is a waiting stage whose failure is read from another struct's retry clock
trigger: tap a story that is not cached; resolve_pending_story_open decides Failed from stories.story_fetch.retry(..).is_some() on each render
effect: none today; if the retry clock is cleared elsewhere the open waits forever on Loading
fix: PendingStoryOpen { Waiting{request}, ..} matched by RequestId, resolved from the fetch answer

title: menu and archive_menu are two independent Option menus that can both be set
trigger: right-click a chat row, then right-click the Archived row
effect: two context menus may both be shown
fix: one ChatListMenu { None, Row(ChatMenuState), Archive(Point) }

title: ChatListKeys holds two sources of one selection as four Options (list, list_mouse, search, search_mouse)
trigger: keys write list/search, hover writes list_mouse/search_mouse, mouse move clears list/search by hand, Enter reads keys.or(mouse)
effect: none today
fix: Selection { None, Keys(row), Pointer(row) } per list

title: list_mouse is cleared only by an on_hover(false) of its own row
trigger: hover a chat row, scroll the virtual list so the row unmounts without a hover-out, press Enter
effect: Enter opens the row that scrolled away instead of the first row
fix: drop list_mouse when its row leaves the laid-out items, or derive it from the pointer position each frame

title: non-test RefCell borrow_mut in render (begin_search_rows, push_search_row)
trigger: search results render while a borrow of search_order or search_bounds is live (step_search_selection, reveal_search_row hold borrow() across calls)
effect: a re-entrant borrow panics
fix: try_borrow_mut with early return like the bounds recorders, or Cell/own Vec rebuilt per frame

title: non-test RefCell borrow_mut of row_fx in render
trigger: chat list renders while a row painter holds row_fx
effect: re-entrant borrow panics
fix: try_borrow_mut with early return

title: PinStage is ended by hand from render and from five other places instead of its own transitions
trigger: press a pinned row and start a drag, then switch to Contacts, Calls or open search: open_contacts_tab/open_calls_tab do not end it, sidebar_ready ends it during render; sidebar_chats ends it when the window is inactive; pin_drag_move, cancel_pin_drag and set_chat_list_view also call end_drag; pin_drag_move also writes peek=Idle by hand
effect: none visible; a render-time write that a missed path would leave as a 60 Hz redraw
fix: one ChatListUi::leave_view() / on_tab_change transition that ends pin drag, peek and items

title: Saved Messages click is dropped while any createPrivateChat is in flight (deduped by purpose, not by user)
trigger: click a bot's user button (createPrivateChat for another user), then Open Saved Messages before it answers
effect: create_private_chat_with_self returns Ok(None), the arm does nothing and no note; the open of the earlier answer decides which chat opens
fix: key the in-flight create by user id (a stage holding RequestId and user) and open the chat of the answer's own request

title: dimming is mirrored from dimming_slider by a subscription and the two must stay equal
trigger: the slider emits Change/Release and a detached subscription writes dialog.dimming
effect: none today; Apply reads dimming, the slider shows its own value
fix: read the slider value on Apply, or keep only dimming and set the slider from it

title: Wallpaper file picker answer is matched by chat id, in a detached task
trigger: open the look dialog for chat A, press From file, close the dialog and reopen it for A before the picker answers
effect: the file lands in the new dialog of the same chat
fix: hold the picker task in the dialog (or a pick stage with an id) so closing drops it

title: LookStage::Blocked keeps its reason after the choices change
trigger: Apply on a boosted chat that is below the level, then pick another wallpaper or theme
effect: the old 'level required' error stays under the grid until the next Apply
fix: every edit of theme/wallpaper/dimming returns stage to Editing

title: A failed topic load in the drop chooser has no retry
trigger: drop a file on a forum row whose topics cannot be loaded
effect: 'topics could not load' with only Cancel; the load is sent once in open_drop_topic
fix: a Retry button that resends load_forum_topics, or a DropTopic stage Loading/Failed/Ready

title: bar_unarchive dismisses the action bar even when the unarchive or notification reset failed
trigger: press Unarchive in the contact bar while the send fails
effect: the bar is dismissed and only an error note remains; the person cannot retry from the bar
fix: dismiss only after both requests were accepted

title: retry_join_requests resets the join-request fetch by hand from the UI, in the session
trigger: press Retry on the failed requests box
effect: none today; the stage is removed from outside its own transitions before ask_join_requests
fix: driver method retry_join_requests that replaces the stage with Loading in one place

title: non-test Rc<RefCell<Option<body>>> borrow_mut().take() in a dialog content closure
trigger: the dialog content closure runs a second time for the same build
effect: second run takes None and draws an empty body
fix: build the body inside the closure (or a shared scrollable_dialog_content_once helper) instead of a take-once slot

title: non-test Rc<RefCell<Option<body>>> borrow_mut().take() in a dialog content closure
trigger: the dialog content closure runs a second time for the same build
effect: second run takes None and draws an empty body
fix: build the body inside the closure (or a shared scrollable_dialog_content_once helper) instead of a take-once slot

title: non-test Rc<RefCell<Option<body>>> borrow_mut().take() in a dialog content closure
trigger: the dialog content closure runs a second time for the same build
effect: second run takes None and draws an empty body
fix: build the body inside the closure (or a shared scrollable_dialog_content_once helper) instead of a take-once slot

title: non-test Rc<RefCell<Option<body>>> borrow_mut().take() in a dialog content closure
trigger: the dialog content closure runs a second time for the same build
effect: second run takes None and draws an empty body
fix: build the body inside the closure (or a shared scrollable_dialog_content_once helper) instead of a take-once slot

title: baseline: HeaderFacts::is_saved_messages
trigger: a fact about the open chat read once per menu build
effect: none
fix: derive from the chat kind inside header_entries

title: enter_chat_ui drops a Sending edit without forgetting its request ack
trigger: Edit a message in chat A, press Save (edit goes out, stage Sending), then pick chat B before TDLib answers
effect: An awaited then settled entry stays in Session::acks for the rest of the session; docs say leaving the chat forgets the request
fix: enter_chat_ui takes old.edit_mode before replace_chat_ui reads old.edit_sending(); forget the request of the dropped edit (call leave-edit path / forget before take)

title: Esc and confirm while an edit is Sending cancels locally but the edit still lands
trigger: Save an edit, press Esc before the answer, confirm Cancel editing
effect: Edit cancelled note and the draft restored, yet the message is edited on the server; the answer is forgotten
fix: set_cancel_edit_confirm / request_cancel_edit should be a variant of EditStage (Editing, ConfirmingCancel, Sending) so Sending refuses cancel

title: EditMode::confirm_cancel bool sits beside EditStage
trigger: Open the cancel box, then Sending can begin or end while the flag stays set
effect: Two fields of one edit changed by hand (stage, confirm_cancel, replace_as_file)
fix: EditStage { Editing, ConfirmingCancel, Sending(RequestId) }

title: Scheduled-messages box is scheduled_dialog_open plus scheduled_selected kept in step by hand
trigger: Tick scheduled messages, Esc the dialog (on_close clears only the open flag), selection survives until a button or key reopen clears it; Reschedule selected relies on it surviving the hide
effect: Stale selection can be read by RescheduleSelected path if a reopen route forgets the clear (open_scheduled_dialog itself does not clear)
fix: enum ScheduledBox { Closed, Open{selected}, Rescheduling{selected} } in ChatUi

title: QuotePicker { Closed, Open } is a bool in disguise inside ReplyBar
trigger: Update Quote opens it; reply replaced or sent closes it
effect: Two-variant open flag beside the reply
fix: ReplyBar stage { Plain, PickingQuote } or fold into the reply value

title: Blocked replaces Sent, so the Done changes are forgotten
trigger: Boosted chat: Apply with two changes, one Done and one Failed, then change the pick so Apply is blocked by the level, then fix it and Apply again
effect: Already acknowledged changes are sent again (mod.rs sets d.stage = LookStage::Blocked over Sent)
fix: Blocked carries the previous sends, or Sent has a blocked reason field

title: ChatLookDialog::both is a one-shot argument of Apply stored as a flag
trigger: Click Apply for me and user; retry after a failure with the other button
effect: The flag is set before the in-flight check and read later by apply_chat_look; a retry of a Failed change uses the new button's value
fix: pass `only_for_self` as an argument of apply_chat_look and store it in the Sent stage

title: baseline: RowForum::loaded is Fetch loaded-or-failed squashed into a bool
trigger: Forum row whose getForumTopics failed
effect: Failed reads as loaded: 'No chats' with no retry, as documented (asked once)
fix: RowForum::topics: Fetch-like enum { Loading, Empty, Failed, Some }

title: baseline: ChatSwipeFacts::is_saved
trigger: Swipe on Saved Messages
effect: A fact about the chat (cannot be muted), not a stage; no bug today
fix: allow-list with reason (it is a fact of the chat) or SwipeFacts chat kind enum

title: Non-test RefCell borrow/borrow_mut on the shared WindowSlot
trigger: note_place/main_covered/covered_chat_windows/image_caches/activate borrow the slot while another path (swap_slot, render) may hold borrow_mut
effect: Panic and process exit if a borrow overlaps (cover.rs 95,115,126,153; mod.rs 273,288,296,358,379,541); open_places and slice_ids already use try_borrow
fix: use try_borrow/try_borrow_mut with an early return as open_places does

title: chat_list.row_fx.borrow_mut() in the per-row render
trigger: Row render while sidebar begin_pass or another borrow is live
effect: Short temporary borrow today; would panic on a re-entrant borrow
fix: try_borrow_mut with a settled default RowFx

title: Host::Asked is matched by kind and expired by 'no request in flight at all', not by a RequestId
trigger: A box asked from a chat window whose request never opens it while any other request is in flight
effect: The ask stays Asked(window), so a later open of that kind by a reducer shows in the stale window instead of the last press (shell.rs expiry uses requests.is_empty())
fix: Host::Asked(window, Option<RequestId>) expired by that request's answer

title: The auto-delete picker has no single closer: its reset is written at three places
trigger: Close the TTL dialog via on_close, the spec close, or leaving the chat
effect: notify.ttl_picker = None is repeated (chat_setting_dialogs.rs 70 and 113, chat_ui_state.rs 592) while mute and folder menus have close_* fns
fix: one close_ttl_picker fn used by all three

title: Index bar pointer is two Options (index_cursor hover, index_current scrub) cleared separately
trigger: Hover and hold on the contacts index bar, then release, change sort, or type in the search field
effect: No visible bug today: mouse-up clears only index_current, sort toggle clears only index_cursor, search change clears only index_current, hover-exit clears both
fix: enum IndexBar { Away, Over(cursor), Scrubbing { cursor, slot } } with one reset

title: Schedule shortcut sets picker.send_after by hand after open_schedule_picker(Composer)
trigger: Press the Schedule shortcut with text in the composer
effect: send_after (and send_effect) is a mode of the Composer target set at two sites (also send_effects/mod.rs:410) and compared to the slot at scheduled.rs:367; a path that opens the picker without setting it sends nothing
fix: ScheduleTarget::ComposerThenSend { effect } so target and mode are one value

title: Restore drops a saved window whose open was refused, and the next save forgets it
trigger: Launch with a saved chat window whose chat is unsupported or whose driver open_chat_window fails
effect: open_chat_window_at returns nothing; ready windows are consumed from Restore::Opening whatever the result, a note is posted, and windows_to_save(Done) then rewrites the file without that window, so it never comes back
fix: use try_open_chat_window_at and keep refused windows in Opening for a retry, or drop them with a deliberate Dropped step

title: Offered stage re-asks whenever no dialog is active, so a dismissal that does not call on_cancel re-opens the box every frame
trigger: Dismiss the Restore chat windows box with Escape or click-away (if the kit reports on_close, not on_cancel)
effect: The question comes back on the next frame and cannot be answered away; the stage has no explicit dismissed exit
fix: Offered holds the box identity and treats a dismissal as answer(false) or Later

title: bounds_seen is not updated by render_locked, so a window moved or resized under the lock reopens at stale bounds
trigger: Lock Quill, move a chat window, close it from its title bar, use Reopen closed window
effect: closing() reads self.bounds_seen (line 106) which stops updating while locked; the window comes back at its pre-lock place
fix: read bounds from the slot recorded by placed()/note_place, or update bounds_seen in the locked path

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut/borrow on the shared WindowSlot in swap_slot, chat_frame_starts and view.rs:304
trigger: Any path that holds a Ref on a slot while a scope swap runs
effect: borrow_mut in swap_slot (slot.rs:311) panics if the slot is already borrowed; borrow() at slot.rs:438 and view.rs:304 can panic if a mutable borrow is live. No such path found today
fix: try_borrow_mut with a skipped swap, or Cell-based fields

title: open_collectible_info drops the Err from request_collectible_info
trigger: Tap a collectible username or phone when the chats path is not active or the send fails
effect: let _ = discards ConnectSendError::InvalidRequest or a send error; the tap is silently dead (only a failed answer posts a note)
fix: match the result and post StatusNote::error like pump_collectible_info

title: A collectible lookup in Loading has no cancel and no owner, so a late answer opens the box after the user moved on, and a lookup that never answers blocks a re-tap
trigger: Tap a username, switch chat or close the profile before the answer; or lose the answer and tap the same entity again
effect: The box pops up over the new screen; request_collectible_info returns Ok(None) for a Loading lookup of the same entity, so the retry is never sent
fix: tie the lookup to the asking profile or window and clear it with the owner; let a re-tap resend after a timeout or connection loss

title: A newer community ban silently replaces a ban still waiting for its member chats
trigger: Press Ban on member A, then Ban on member B before A's getCommunityMemberChats answers
effect: ban_wait is overwritten, A's confirmed ban never happens and no note is shown
fix: a queue of PendingBan, or refuse the second press with a note while one waits

title: CreateVisibility busy is matched by request purpose (has_purpose(CreateCommunity)), not by the chat or request that asked
trigger: Press Create on a community, close the box, start another create from a different chat while the first is out
effect: The second box's Create button is loading and disabled until the first answers; the submit path uses has_purpose_for_chat so the two checks disagree
fix: use community_create_out(chat_id) (or the RequestId held in the stage) for busy

title: The photo picker answer is applied to whichever Create box is open, not the draft that asked
trigger: Open the photo picker in Create for chat A, cancel the box, open Create from chat B, then choose a file in the still-open picker
effect: draft.photo of box B is set from A's picker; the guard compares account only
fix: carry the draft (name entity id) in the task and apply only if it is still the open one

title: community_candidates status ignores owned_bots loading, so the chooser says No chats found while owned bots load
trigger: Open Add a Chat to Community on an account with no suitable chats but owned bots
effect: status stays Ready (only owned_bots.error() is read), the empty list shows No chats found, then the bots appear on the next frame
fix: fold both fetches into one status: Loading while either loads

title: A rich send's or inline pick's SentText is dropped with the ChatUi on a chat change, so a refusal loses the text and the awaited ack leaks
trigger: Send a rich message (or pick an inline result) in chat A, switch to chat B before TDLib answers, TDLib refuses (flood wait, lapsed Premium)
effect: The field and draft were cleared for the send; the refusal finds no SentText, so the typed text is gone and no note restores it. The request stays in RequestAcks.awaited/settled forever (replace_chat_ui forgets only edit_sending, not sent_text)
fix: replace_chat_ui hands SentText back (or forgets its request and restores the draft slot) as it does for EditStage::Sending

title: AiAsk is a two-variant Idle/Asked flag; the AI answer is matched by window, chat and field markup, not by the RequestId of the ask
trigger: Press Fix, then Rewrite on the same draft before the first answer lands; or an AI request fails
effect: The first answer takes the one ai_ask and applies; the second answer finds Idle and is dropped with 'the draft changed' (latest ask loses). A failed ask leaves Asked{markup} set with nothing to clear it until the next answer. Session::messages.ai_composer_text/blocks is a single shared slot, so a second answer also overwrites an unconsumed first
fix: AiAsk::Asked { request: RequestId, markup } with the answer keyed by RequestId and cleared on the error arm, a newer ask replacing and forgetting the older

title: Scheduled-messages dialog has no load stage: a pending or failed load draws the empty-list text
trigger: Open Scheduled Messages in a chat whose list is not loaded yet, or with the request failing (offline)
effect: Dialog opens at once (scheduled_dialog_open = true) and shows 'no scheduled messages' while the list loads or after the load failed; the error is only a transient note, and there is no retry
fix: A per-chat Fetch<Vec<ParsedMessage>> for scheduled sends (idle/loading/ready/failed) that the dialog draws

title: delete_scheduled_message removes the row locally as soon as the send leaves, before TDLib answers
trigger: Delete a scheduled message while the delete will fail (offline, already sent)
effect: The row vanishes from the dialog, the delete fails or is rejected, and the message reappears only on the next load; no error shows
fix: Mark the row Deleting(request) and remove it on the answer, restore on error

title: A second window sending in the same bot chat gets a false 'couldn't start a thread' note: start_bot_thread dedups by purpose+chat, not by the asking window's request
trigger: Open the same bot chat in two windows, Send in the All view in one, then in the other before the thread is created
effect: start_bot_thread returns Ok(None) for the second window; .ok().flatten() turns that into the error note while the first window's thread is being made; the second send must be repeated
fix: Per-window Asked stage keyed by RequestId; a second window waits on the in-flight request id instead of an error

title: close_mention_menu and pick_mention_index clear the session-wide messages.mention_search, shared by every window
trigger: Type @ in the composer of two chat windows alternately
effect: Closing or completing the menu in one window drops the other window's search results; its menu empties until the next keystroke
fix: Keep the mention search per window (WindowSlot/ComposerUi) keyed by its request

title: SuggestUi: the emoji-word popup stage is spread over query, word_ready, word_timer, active, selected and dismissed
trigger: Type a lone word that has an emoji, wait 300 ms, press Esc, keep typing
effect: No bug today: Idle, Waiting(timer), Ready and Shown are inferred from which Options are Some, and sync_suggest_menu, close_suggest_menu and pick_suggest_index reset subsets by hand (word_timer = None, word_ready kept or cleared by comparing to the new query)
fix: enum SuggestStage { Idle, WaitingWord{query, timer: Task}, Ready{query}, Shown{query, items, selected} } with dismissed kept beside it

title: inline_bot_alert_shown is a once-flag in ComposerUi beside the BotAlert stage in ChatUi
trigger: Confirm the secret-chat inline bot warning in the main window, then open a chat window for another secret chat and type @bot
effect: The warning asks again in each window slot although the comment says once per session; the flag is never cleared and lives with a different owner than the BotAlert stage it gates
fix: Put the acknowledgement in the account's OnScreen state (or make BotAlert carry Acknowledged) so the gate and the stage are one value

title: TraySend::Held is kept in step with the attachments' photo_render by release_idle_hold and manual resets
trigger: Press Send while a photo edit renders, then remove the rendering photo or abandon its edit
effect: No bug today: Held is only valid while some attachment renders; update, update_item, end_render and clear_attachments each reset it to Idle by hand, and a failed render silently drops the held text
fix: Derive the held send from the render stage of the tray (one TrayStage enum: Ready, Rendering{held: Option<Held>}) so it cannot outlive the render

title: A DraftClear survives a send that never acks and is taken by the ack of a later send in the same chat
trigger: Send text from chat A so a whole_composer DraftClear is stored, have the message fail with an error after TDLib accepted it, then send a sticker or GIF in A (no clear of its own) while another window shows A with a draft
effect: The sticker's ack consumes the stale clear (take_draft_clear matches by chat id across topics) and clears a draft the earlier send never owned; only an idle composer or another window triggers it
fix: Key the clear by the send's message/request id (Stage::Sent{request}) and drop it on the send's error ack

title: RefCell borrow_mut on the bar Presence in render (follow_bar)
trigger: Render a reply or edit bar while a nested render re-enters follow_bar for the same presence
effect: A re-entrant borrow_mut would panic and end the app; today the guard is dropped before request_animation_tick
fix: Use try_borrow_mut with an early return, as history_reads does, or a Cell-based presence

title: ContextMenuItems keeps four RefCell/Cell fields borrowed with borrow()/borrow_mut() in render and key paths
trigger: Open a context menu and press Up/Down while a row claims its handle in the same frame
effect: A nested borrow would panic; each borrow is short today (claim, live, step) but the rule says use try_borrow
fix: try_borrow_mut with an early return, or collect claims in a plain Vec owned by the frame state

title: MenuFocusStage { Closed, Open{previous} } mirrors context_menu_open() which is derived from six other menu fields
trigger: Open a chat-list row menu, then close it by switching account or chat in one frame
effect: The hand-off is an edge detector run only from menu_focus_upkeep; the real menu stage lives in message_ui.menu, chat_list.menu, archive_menu, row_menu, story_menu, playlist menu and tab_menu, so the two can disagree for a frame and the focus is not given back if upkeep skips the window
fix: One ContextMenu enum per window slot (None, Message(..), ChatRow(..), ...) that carries the focus to give back

title: A submenu marked open (menu.submenu) is repaired by the key handler when its parent row was not drawn
trigger: Open a chat-row submenu, change the list so the parent row is not drawn, press a key
effect: The stale submenu state is only cleared when a key arrives (submenu_key_press), not by the menu's own transitions; until then open_submenu() keeps swallowing keys
fix: Submenu open state owned by the menu value and closed when its row set changes (one ChatMenuStage)

title: screen_preparing is a hand-kept counter incremented before the spawn and decremented inside it
trigger: Start a connection (startup, retry or unlock) and quit or lose the app entity before the preparation answers
effect: The counter is the only thing that stops account deletion while the screen's folders are prepared; it is balanced only if the detached task reaches its first update, so a dropped update leaves deletions refused
fix: A Preparing(Task) stage in ConnectStage held by the owner so dropping the stage releases the claim

title: ConnectStage::Connecting is matched to its detached task by a separate connect.generation counter
trigger: Press Retry twice on the startup failure card
effect: The stage (auth_demo.stage), the counter (connect.generation) and the detached task are three values kept in step; the task cancels itself by comparing generations, not by being owned by the stage
fix: ConnectStage::Connecting { task: Task<()> } so a restart replaces and cancels it

title: ImportContactsDialog::pick token sits beside state = VcardImport::Reading while the read task is detached
trigger: Open Import, choose a .vcf, choose another before the first read ends

fix: VcardImport::Reading { pick, task } and VcardImport::Choosing(task) in the stage

title: The first page of a chat is asked from render and a failed send is dropped, so no Failed/Retry shows
trigger: Open an empty-looking chat while the client's send path rejects fetch_history (not Closed yet)
effect: maybe_auto_load_older discards the send error (.ok().flatten()), so history stays empty with no loading or failed mark and render defers the same ask every frame; the user sees an empty pane without Retry
fix: fetch_history marks the first page Failed on a send error, as fetch_contacts does with fail_dropping_data

title: RefCell borrow_mut().take() one-shot body cell in the import and add-contact dialog content closures
trigger: Open Import contacts or Add contact and let the kit call the content closure more than once
effect: The first call takes the body and a second call draws an empty div; a re-entrant borrow would panic. Same pattern at line 242
fix: Build the body inside the Fn closure or pass a clonable element, no RefCell

title: Older main-chat page that failed is re-sent on every paint of row 0 (no gate, no Retry strip)
trigger: Open a chat whose older page keeps failing server-side (non-empty window), scroll to the top
effect: Each error bumps the session, row 0 is painted again, its deferred maybe_auto_load_older sends getChatHistory again: a request loop at network round-trip rate; no 'Couldn't load' strip as thread/topic/saved have
fix: Gate fetch_history_for on OlderLoad::Failed for a non-empty window as for OlderEnd::Failed, and show the older_retry strip for the main history (OlderRetryFor::Chat) whose Retry calls clear_load_failed

title: A failed newer page stops auto-loading with no Retry and no message; TopicHistory::retry_newer has no caller
trigger: Open a chat at a message in the middle (window stops short of latest), scroll to the window end while the newer page fails
effect: Paging below stays stopped silently (NewerLoad::Failed) until the window is reset or the jump-to-latest button replaces it; the older end has a Retry strip, the newer end none
fix: Show the retry strip at the newer end (the older_retry strip with a newer side) that reopens NewerLoad; remove dead retry_newer or call it

title: reported_visible de-dup key outlives the open generation, so a reopened chat may never report its rows
trigger: Open chat A with unread rows (rows reported), go back to the list (or to a chat that reports nothing), reopen A with the same visible rows
effect: prepare_history_view restarts the ViewBook (Unreported, opened_with_unread: nothing is read) but the UI key (chat, ids) still equals the new ids, so view_messages is skipped and the visible unread rows stay unread until the view scrolls
fix: Key the report by the session view generation (store (generation, chat, ids)) or clear reported_visible when the shown chat changes or closes

title: swipe_reply_start is a one-shot slot nothing clears on release outside a row, chat change or window
trigger: Press on a message row, release outside any row, then press-drag from empty space onto the same row and release more than 24px left of the old press point
effect: The stale (chat, message, x) is taken by the later mouse-up on that row and starts a reply nobody swiped
fix: A Swipe stage owned by the gesture (Idle/Pressed{row,x}) reset on mouse-up anywhere (window-level up listener) and on chat change

title: CustomEmojiCard::Shown names a timer whose Task is detach()ed, compared by equality when it fires
trigger: Tap a custom emoji; the card shows and a detached 6 s timer runs
effect: No bug today (the timer re-checks the stage); the stage does not own its timer, so a card closed and re-tapped runs several dead timers and nothing cancels them
fix: Shown { preview, timer: Task<()> } so replacing or closing the stage drops its timer

title: CustomEmojiCard::Asked has no way out and is matched to the answer by emoji_id, not by the request
trigger: Tap a custom emoji while offline or when preview_custom_emoji fails or its pack never answers
effect: Asked stays forever (its send result is dropped by let _ =, no error arm, no timer); a late or foreign preview with the same emoji_id then pops the card long after the tap
fix: Asked { emoji_id, request: RequestId } cleared by the answer or error of that request and by a send failure; Shown only from the matching answer

title: NoticeGate::shown bool is kept in step with the observer's Option<Entity> handle (keep.take())
trigger: Start Quill hidden in the tray with a pending crash report, then activate the window
effect: No bug today: two values (shown flag, held handle) both say the notice was shown

fix: Carry the origin in the session's DeepLinkFlow (stage + origin window) so the UI holds no second stage, and show the invite from the session stage

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut in the share dialog content closure
trigger: Open the share-link chooser
effect: A re-entrant borrow would panic; today the borrow is a one-line take()

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut in the invite and info dialog content closures
trigger: Open a group invite link or a link info box
effect: A re-entrant borrow would panic; today each is a one-line take()
fix: Build the body inside the Fn closure instead of take() from a RefCell

title: DeviceLink::Linking holds no RequestId; clear_device_qr resets session device_login while the confirm request is still out

fix: DeviceLink::Linking(RequestId) matched against the answer's request id; keep the pending id across page leave (or cancel it) instead of resetting device_login by hand

effect: The stale error line stays under the fixed form until the next successful submit closes the box

title: TermsStage::Terms { age_ok, age_error } keeps an attempted-press bool beside the tick

title: Per-network editor shows no failure line: a refused or unsent Save looks like nothing happened

effect: The editor reopens with the draft but the error lives in data_storage_save / data_storage_error(), which only data_storage_body (overview) draws; the editor branch of data_storage_page draws none, so the person sees Save do nothing until Back
fix: Draw data_storage_error() in the editor branch, or carry the failure in StorageEditor::Open { error }

title: data_storage_save is one Fetch<()> slot shared by ~10 concurrent requests; a later ok clears an earlier failure
trigger: Toggle 'Use less data for calls' (3 setAutoDownloadSettings sends) or drag a storage limit slider (4 setOption sends) while one request fails and another answers ok
effect: The failure line is set by one request and cleared by the next ok (succeed(())), so a partly applied toggle or limit shows no error. Also holds the reset-statistics send failure (data_extra.rs:282) and the less-data / limits send failures
fix: One failure per request (keyed by RequestId or per purpose), as storage_clear and auto_download_presets already do

title: Reset-statistics send failure is parked in data_storage_save, another request's slot
trigger: Reset statistics > Reset while the send fails (connection closed), then retry and succeed, or save an auto-download network
effect: The 'Reset statistics failed' line stays on the page until an unrelated Save succeeds or the page is re-arrived; the answer-side failure of the same request goes to privacy_data.network instead, so one request has two failure homes
fix: Put the reset's own failure in the network Fetch (fail on send error) and drop the data_storage_save write

title: NetworkReset { Idle, Confirming } is the old confirming bool; the reset request itself has no stage
trigger: Reset statistics > Reset: the box goes back to Idle at once while resetNetworkStatistics is in flight
effect: No bug today (the Fetch<NetworkUsage> shows Loading and the answer error lands there), but a two-variant enum beside the real stage (the request, held nowhere) and a second confirm mechanism (settings.storage_confirm: Option) on the same page

title: StorageScroll::Requested is set whether or not Settings opened, and leave_data_storage never resets the stage

title: The auto-download presets fetch is three facts: Seed::InFlight, auto_download_presets Fetch, and requests.has_purpose

effect: No bug today (error returns Seed to Unseeded), but the page reads Seed::is_in_flight for 'Loading download settings' and the fetch guard reads Seed plus has_purpose, while the error line reads the Fetch: three places that must change together

title: SetupPage keeps confirm: Option<SetupConfirm> and saving: Option<RequestId> as two options of one flow
trigger: Confirm Save sets confirm and the send sets saving; End sets confirm=None itself on a successful send, Save keeps it until the answer
effect: Two options that must stay in step (confirm Some while saving for Save, None while saving for End)
fix: enum SetupStage { Editing, Confirming(SetupConfirm), Saving{kind, request} }

title: Password Submit is only `.loading`, not `.disabled`, while PasswordSending; a click empties the field
trigger: Type a new password while the first is in flight and click Submit again
effect: the field is emptied (submit_withdraw_password always clears) while the driver ignores the send
fix: disable Submit and keep the field while Sending, as the revoke and join boxes do

title: EarnUi layer stack: back, restore and fade are three fields of one 'layer open' mode, kept in step by hand with the session's info column
trigger: Open an earn page from an info panel, navigate inside the layer, switch account and back
effect: Back stack, covered info panel and fade can disagree (Farewell closes by hand through close_earn_boxes + drop_earn_layer); no single owner value
fix: enum EarnLayer { Closed, Open{back,restore}, Fading{..} } owning back/restore/fade; fold learn+diamonds into the Learn box value

title: EarnUi::learn bool with diamonds counter: box open flag plus its easter-egg counter that must reset when the box closes
trigger: Open Learn more, tap the diamond several times, close, reopen
effect: diamonds count survives the box unless every closer zeroes it
fix: learn: Option<LearnBox{diamonds}> so closing drops the counter

title: Edit Image on a photo not yet downloaded sends ensure_media_files once and tells the user to choose again; nothing remembers the wish
trigger: Edit a message with a photo that is not on disk, choose Edit Image
effect: A note says 'downloading, choose again'; the user must repeat the action, and a failed download is never reported
fix: an EditImage stage on the edit (Downloading{file_id} -> Ready/Failed) that opens the editor on arrival

title: EmojiBarUi (expanded + two scroll handles) is shared by the ':' suggestions and the word bar; unhover resets it only when suggest.active is none
trigger: Hover a lit word bar, expand it, type ':' query, or close the word bar while suggestions are open
effect: Bar opens expanded or scrolled for the next list unless every closer remembers the 'unless suggestions are using it' rule (unhover, settle_word_bar, pick_word_emoji each repeat it)
fix: one bar owner enum { Closed, Suggest{expanded}, Word{expanded} } so a new list replaces the whole value

title: with_custom_emoji asks for installed emoji sets from the item builder (hover, typing) every time sets are missing
trigger: Premium user with no installed emoji sets, hover lit words or type ':' repeatedly
effect: ensure_suggestion_emoji_sets is called on each rebuild; the driver dedups with can_ask so it is wasted work not a loop, but a Failed installed list is retried only if can_ask allows
fix: request from the owner of the list on open of the composer, not from a pure item builder

title: emoji_set_return_tab (pickers) mirrors the tab the session panel shows (stickers.emoji.tab); two fields for one tab, written by hand together
trigger: Open the box, switch to Trending, search, clear the search
effect: TabBar highlights return_tab while the list is chosen by panel.tab; open/select/clear each keep them in step; a refresh_emoji_pack_catalog that moves panel.tab leaves return_tab stale
fix: one value: EmojiPanel::tab + search overlay Option<Search{query}>, tab bar reads it

title: Search debounce is a counter (emoji_set_keystroke) beside a detached timer Task
trigger: Type in the emoji packs search, close the box, reopen
effect: Each closer and opener must remember to bump the counter (open, close, select tab, typed); a missed bump lets an old timer search into a new box. Task is .detach()ed instead of held in a stage
fix: hold the debounce Task in a SearchStage on the box (Idle|Waiting{task}) so closing drops it

title: Sheet::Failed is final: a sheet that failed to decode (transient read error) is never asked for again until the set is reinstalled
trigger: Sheet file unreadable once (disk busy, partial write), then fine
effect: That sheet's emoji stay on the system glyph for the whole session
fix: Failed{at} retried after a backoff or when the set is reinstalled; Loading holds its Task instead of a detached spawn

title: Sheet::Loading names a decode but the spawned task is .detach()ed; staleness checked by Rc::ptr_eq on the atlas instead of held in the stage
trigger: Switch emoji set while a sheet decodes
effect: Works through the ptr_eq guard; the stage does not own its work
fix: Sheet::Loading{task: Task<()>} dropped with the atlas

title: switch_emoji_set and download_emoji_set return silently when app_root() is None: no stage, no Failed, no note
trigger: No writable data folder, click a set row
effect: Row click does nothing and says nothing (install-from-file does report it)
fix: set SetStage::Failed{id, why} on that path

title: Startup enum NotStarted/Reading/Done is set to Done before the read is spawned, then overwritten with Reading; early return leaves Done
trigger: First frame with no data folder
effect: Stage is assigned by hand outside its own transitions (Done then Reading); a once-flag in disguise
fix: set Reading only when the task exists; Done from the task

title: EmojiStyleUi::open bool beside DialogKind::EmojiSetStyle, and SetStage::Switching holds only a Task with no set id; completion matches by captured id and loaded.current
trigger: Click set A then B quickly
effect: Works because replace drops the older Task; the stage cannot tell which set it is switching to (the row shows no pending state for it)
fix: Switching{id,task}; open as the dialog's own presence

title: WordBar::Asking carries range+word instead of a request id; the answer is matched by normalized word via keyword_lookups, and it leaves by text edit or give-up in sync_emoji_words/answer_asked_word
trigger: Right-click a word, Suggest Emoji, keep typing / switch chat
effect: Asking is closed from two places (sync_emoji_words compare of the text, answer_asked_word); a bar for the same word asked by a highlight lookup would satisfy it
fix: Asking{request: RequestId} matched in the answer path

title: right_clicked_link is a one-shot slot cleared by a detached next-tick task that clears whatever is there
trigger: Right-press a link twice in one frame, or press where no menu opens
effect: The clearing task of the first press can drop the second press's link; slot has no owner stage
fix: hold the clearing Task with the slot (Option<(Point,LinkTarget,Task)>) or pass the link in the menu-open call

title: Event log treats ChatEventLogFetch::Idle as Loading: a refresh or first open whose send fails leaves Idle and a spinner forever, retry only shows on Failed
trigger: Open Recent actions while the sender is closed / chats_path inactive, or Save a filter / search when send_json errors (driver resets fetch to Idle and returns Err)
effect: 'Loading recent actions' spinner never ends; the note is the only trace; closing and reopening the page is the only way out
fix: on send error set ChatEventLogFetch::Failed(msg) so the Retry button shows; render Idle as a request to send, not as Loading

title: autoload mark is set to the list length before load_more_event_log sends; a failed send or failed page keeps the mark so no further automatic load happens
trigger: Short log that needs more pages, load_more send errors once
effect: List stays at its length with 'loading older' spinner until the user scrolls to the top again (the scroll hook is the only other path)
fix: clear the mark when the send errors or the page fails (stage Asked{len}->Idle)

title: apply_event_log_search and save_event_log_filter store the new query/filter in the session before the refresh; when the refresh send fails the log still shows the old rows under the new title/filter
trigger: Type a search or Save a filter while the refresh send errors
effect: Header says 'selected actions' or shows the typed query while rows are the previous result; the stored query now equals the box so a retype of the same text is ignored (query == current)
fix: stage the query/filter with the request (Pending{query,filter}) and commit on the answer

title: event_log_ids RefCell borrow_mut held across ListState reset/splice/remeasure calls in render
trigger: Render of the list while the ListState calls back
effect: Non-test RefCell guard held across calls into GPUI (panic-safety rule 6); a re-entrant borrow would panic
fix: copy the plan out, drop the guard, then call the list; or store ids in the ListState owner without RefCell

title: event log poll tick does not check the passcode lock; it polls while the dialog is open under a locked app and window active
trigger: Open Recent actions, app auto-locks
effect: getChatEventLog polls every 5s while locked
fix: refused_while_locked in event_log_poll_tick (or close the page on lock)

title: EventLogSearch::shows (Option<ChatId>) mirrors which chat the search box text belongs to, resynced from per-frame upkeep
trigger: Open recent actions of chat A, then chat B
effect: Box text and stored query are two sources; typing sets the stored query only after the debounce, upkeep may overwrite text when shows != open chat
fix: make the box value a function of the page (EventLogPage owns the input) and drop shows

title: Folder picker answer is applied to whichever draft is open when it returns, not the draft that asked
trigger: Open Export chat for chat A, press Change (picker opens), cancel the box, open Export for chat B, then answer the first picker
effect: Chat B's draft gets the folder chosen for A's; the continuation is detached and carries no draft key
fix: hold the picker Task inside the draft (ExportPage::PickingFolder{task}) so closing the box drops it

title: Which export box shows is read from two owners: ExportBox::Options in the screen and session.settings.chat_export (+ ExportView) in the session; the dialog spec opens on either
trigger: Options draft open while a chat export or account export starts or ends elsewhere (other window, menu)
effect: Both can be set; build_chat_export_dialog prefers the draft, start_chat_export prefers the export; Cancel/on_close hide a running export's view by hand (set_chat_export_view(Hidden)) even when only the draft was closed
fix: one ExportStage enum owned by the session export: Options(draft) | Running{view} so a draft cannot coexist with a run

title: export_stop Option<Box<dyn Fn>> doubles as 'Stop and quit?' box open flag and exit continuation, kept in step with an alert dialog and the OS shutdown block reason by hand
trigger: Quit while exporting, let the export finish while the box is up, or close the window through another path
effect: Box and shutdown block reason stay up after the export ended until the user answers; a second Quit replaces the continuation and returns true; cleanup lives only in the alert's on_close
fix: QuitGate enum { Idle, Asking{exit} } cleared by the export ending as well as by the box

title: FirstRun::Welcome holds clip: Clip and outro: Option<Outro>; the Option is a 'way out started' flag that gates Clip::Writing -> Ready and the skip, settle and animating rules
trigger: Skip while the clip is still being written, or open timeout while Writing
effect: Combination (clip x outro) must be matched by hand in intro_written, awaits_intro, skip_intro, settle, animating; impossible mixes (Ready + outro past 1.0 with a playing player) are guarded by pause in settle
fix: flatten to Welcome stages: Writing | Playing{player} | Leaving{from,dark,player?} | Notice

title: start_intro spawns a detached task whose answer is matched by the shape of the stage (awaits_intro), not by an id held in Clip::Writing
trigger: Replay the onboarding from Settings twice before the first clip write finishes
effect: The first task to finish installs its player into whichever Welcome is current; the second is dropped silently; Writing does not own its Task
fix: Clip::Writing{task: Task<()>} replaced (and cancelled) by a new Replay

title: confirm_folder_new_chats takes the join dialog before the request goes out; a send error leaves only a note and the selection is lost
trigger: Tick chats in the shared-folder join box, press Join while the sender is closed
effect: Box closes, 'Failed to process new chats' note, user re-ticks everything; no stage for the join (fire and forget, the offer clears on a later update)
fix: NewChatsDialog stage Choosing | Joining{request} -> closes on answer, back to Choosing on error

title: Context menus are separate Option slots (folders.tab_menu, chat_list.menu, chat_list.archive_menu, message menu) made exclusive by hand at each opener
trigger: Right-click a folder tab while a chat row menu is open, or any new menu opener that forgets to clear one
effect: open_folder_tab_menu clears three other slots by hand; every opener must remember the others; esc layer 'context-menus' ORs them
fix: one ContextMenu enum { None, Message, Chat, Archive, FolderTab } so opening replaces the whole value

title: arm_force_reply_here takes the pending target before apply_force_reply can refuse it, so a force reply that arrives while the composer already has a reply is lost
trigger: In a chat, start replying to message X; a bot sends a standalone force-reply message in that chat
effect: The pending target is removed (line 58), apply_force_reply returns at chat_ui.has_reply() (custom_keyboard.rs:241), so the bot's prompt never arms; the chat's custom keyboard is still dismissed (lines 61-72) although nothing was armed
fix: take the target only when apply_force_reply arms it (return a bool/Armed result), leave it waiting otherwise

title: A delete's Done answer throws the user out of an edit form opened meanwhile
trigger: Share Folder: confirm Delete on one link (LinkOp::Saving), then click Edit on another link before the answer
effect: start_folder_link_form switches view to Edit but leaves op = Saving(delete request); the Save button shows busy; the delete's Done answer then sets view = list (line 406), dropping the form and the person's ticked chats
fix: make the request part of the view (Edit{..,saving} / List{deleting}) so an answer only settles the view that sent it

title: A second link delete overwrites the in-flight LinkOp::Saving, so the first request's answer (and its error) is never seen
trigger: Share Folder: confirm Delete on link A, then on link B before A answers (delete buttons are not disabled while op is Saving)
effect: op is replaced by Saving(request B); A's Failed answer stays in DialogAnswers and is never shown, the list keeps A with no error
fix: disable delete/edit while op is Saving, or keep a set of in-flight requests keyed by link

title: LinkOp is reset by hand from the form's Cancel button (and in start_folder_link_form) instead of by its own transitions
trigger: Edit a link, press Save, press Cancel while the request is out
effect: op goes to Idle with the request dropped; the answer lands nowhere, so a failed save shows no line and a successful one gives no confirmation
fix: one stage enum for the box (List / Edit / Saving{request, back_to}) whose Cancel transition owns the request

title: CopyMark::Copied names a timer by Instant while the timer task is .detach()ed
trigger: Copy a link in the Share Folder box
effect: The mark clears only if the detached task still finds the same Instant; the task is not held in the stage, so closing and reopening the box within 2 s leaves a task running against the new box (it matches nothing and does nothing)
fix: hold the timer Task inside CopyMark::Copied { link, _timer } so dropping the stage cancels it

title: open_folder_invite overwrites an existing FolderInviteDialog, dropping an in-flight Checking or Adding request
trigger: An addlist link is opened while the Add folder box is in Adding for another link
effect: The old add goes on server-side but its answer is never taken (kept only in the bounded DialogAnswers), so the person never sees whether the first folder was added
fix: refuse or queue a new link while a stage holds a request; or settle the old stage first

title: FolderEditorDialog keeps an error in two places: FolderLoad::Failed(String) and error: Option<String>
trigger: Fail validation in Ready (error set), then the folder reload fails or Retry is pressed
effect: Retry (editor_stages.rs:264) sets load Loading/Failed without clearing dialog.error, so the validation line and the load error can draw together; Merging/Saving clear error by hand at several sites
fix: fold the line into the stage: Ready{error: Option<String>} and Failed(line) share one slot

title: A send refused before the request (chats_path_active false) leaves the Fetch idle: the Share box, the Delete box and the Add to folder box say 'Loading...' with no error or Retry
trigger: Open Share Folder / Delete shared folder / Add to folder while auth is not Ready or shutdown has begun
effect: fetch_folder_share, fetch_chat_folder_chats_to_leave and fetch_chat_lists_to_add_chat return Err(InvalidRequest) before begin()/fail(); the Fetch stays Idle so the box waits forever (Delete stays disabled, line 300 of folders/mod.rs) until it is cancelled
fix: mark the Fetch Failed on every Err return, including the early guard

title: confirm_folder_delete says 'Folder deleted' when the request is sent, and the answer is never read
trigger: Delete a folder while TDLib rejects deleteChatFolder
effect: The toast claims success; a rejected delete only shows through the folder staying in the list
fix: hold the delete request in a stage and toast on its answer (DialogAnswers)

title: Topic extras toast success when the request is sent; the answer is not matched
trigger: Mark topic mentions read, reorder pinned topics or unpin all messages when TDLib answers an error
effect: The 'marked as read' / 'reordered' / 'unpinning' note shows although the request failed
fix: carry the RequestId and settle the note from the answer

title: A vanished folder tab is reset by hand in the poll, copying set_chat_list_view but missing its end_drag
trigger: Drag a pinned chat in a folder's list while another device deletes that folder
effect: poll sets folders.tab = None and clears selection, but chat_list.pin.end_drag() (done by set_chat_list_view) is skipped, so the pinned drag carries on over the main list
fix: one function that moves the view, used by the poll too (take the borrow out of `live` first)

title: The chat-list view is two fields kept in step: ChatListUi::filter and FolderUi::tab
trigger: Select Unread while on a folder tab, delete the folder, or write either field directly
effect: selected_slot derives the highlighted tab from the pair ((Unread, Some(id)) shows Unread but the list still filters to the folder); each writer must keep both right (listed.rs:73 and notifications/mod.rs:460 do it separately)
fix: enum ChatListView { Main, Folder(i32), Unread{in_folder}, Archived }

title: viewer.extra.share_at lives beside ForwardStage::Picking and is cleared by hand in three places
trigger: Share a video at a time from the viewer, then close the picker by Send, Escape in selection, or a chat switch (those paths set ForwardStage::None and never clear it), then open a picker over the same message with the selection's Forward button and use Copy link
effect: share_viewer_link_at_time still matches the stale (chat, message) and copies a link with the old timestamp
fix: carry the position in the stage (Picking { at_time: Option<i32>, .. }) so it dies with it

title: ForwardLift is a process global marker kept in step with GPUI's active drag and cleared only when the button comes up
trigger: Lift a message drag, then cancel it without a mouse-up reaching end_forward_lift (focus loss, Escape), then start a file or text drag
effect: forward_lift_live = has_global && has_active_drag reads the next unrelated drag as a lifted message drag
fix: derive from the active drag's payload type (ForwardDrag) instead of a marker global

title: The animation gate is held twice: AppGate global and FrameUi::window_active / main_active / main_covered cells, set by follow_windows by hand
trigger: Activate a chat window over the main window
effect: Clip frame requests read AppGate while the tick clock reads FrameUi::window_active; if one is updated and not the other a clip freezes or ticks behind another app
fix: one Activity enum value (Background, Main, Chat(window), ...) published once

title: baseline: DestRow::saved
trigger: n/a
effect: A per-row fact (the chat is Saved Messages), not a stage; recorded as baseline debt
fix: derive from the chat kind at draw time or move to the allow list with its reason

title: baseline: PasswordBox::sending
trigger: n/a
effect: PasswordBox is built each frame from the caller's stage; sending mirrors it as a bool
fix: pass the caller's stage (Showing) instead of a bool

title: baseline: PasswordBox::sending+error
trigger: n/a
effect: sending and error are both passed in, so a view can draw both at once
fix: one enum (Idle, Sending, Failed(error))

title: baseline: State::started
trigger: n/a
effect: Process-global profiler state with a started bool next to the path and last write time
fix: enum Profiler { Off, Armed, Running{last_write} }

title: A clip's frame request is a stage (FrameRequested with a lost_at deadline) whose sleep task is .detach()ed instead of held in it
trigger: Play an inline video with a low frame rate, close its window while the sleep is pending
effect: Nothing can cancel the sleep; the request only counts as lost by the clock, and the task's handle.update fails silently (handled by video_request_done); a second timer can stack if lost_at passes first
fix: FrameRequested::Asked { view, lost_at, _sleep: Option<Task<()>> }

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut/borrow on the thread-local VIDEO_ASKS and ANSWERED (lines 84, 183, 196, 218, 270, 281)
trigger: Re-entrant call while a borrow is held (none today)
effect: A nested borrow would panic the UI thread; borrows are short, no re-entry found
fix: try_borrow_mut with early return, per panic-safety.md rule 6

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut/borrow on the thread-locals GRIDS and PLAYING (lines 788, 799, 812)
trigger: Re-entrant call while a borrow is held (none today)
effect: A nested borrow would panic; borrows are short
fix: try_borrow_mut with early return

title: Non-test RefCell borrow/borrow_mut on FrameUi cells (animation_targets, still_ticks, layers_drawn, window_views) at about twenty sites (198-203, 214-219, 300-302, 331-346, 367, 376, 430-434, 463, 477)
trigger: A render or tick callback that re-enters request_tick while a borrow is open (none found; tick_app and the draw run after the borrows are dropped)
effect: A nested borrow would panic the UI thread
fix: try_borrow_mut with early return, or a single owner struct with &mut methods

title: non-test RefCell borrow_mut in debug trace helpers (trace_slice_render, trace_count_by, trace_caller)
trigger: QUILL_TRACE_TICKS / QUILL_TRACE_NOTIFY set and a trace call re-entered from inside the borrow (eprintln only today, no re-entry found)
effect: BorrowMutError panic in a debug-only tracing path; not reachable without the env vars
fix: try_borrow_mut like the cfg(test) arm at line 18, or a Mutex

title: GIF search debounce: keystroke counter plus a detached 400 ms timer task instead of a Task held in the stage
trigger: type in the GIF search field, then close the media panel, lock, or switch account within 400 ms
effect: the detached task still fires search_gifs_for after the panel closed or the app locked (spawn_scoped drops it only on a scope change); the counter is bumped by hand in three places (gif_search_typed, choose_gif_section)
fix: hold the debounce Task in the GIF tab stage (Typing { task }) so closing, section choice or farewell drops it

title: PickerUi::gif_wanted and gif_asked are two fields set together in request_gifs and reset by hand on a failed send
trigger: request_gifs is called; the send fails or no session exists
effect: gif_wanted is overwritten with GifWanted::shown(panel) from the failure branch while gif_asked keeps For(wanted); the two disagree by design so upkeep does not loop, but nothing but hand-kept order holds that
fix: one GifTab stage enum: Wants(GifWanted) / Asked(GifWanted) / Refused(GifWanted)

title: saved-GIF add/remove in flight is read by purpose (has_purpose AddSavedAnimation/RemoveSavedAnimation), not by the RequestId of the asking menu item
trigger: right-click GIF A, Save; while it is out right-click GIF B
effect: every tile's Save/Remove item is disabled while any save or remove runs, and save_gif_pick drops the RequestId it got back (Ok(_)); a lost answer would leave the items disabled only until the request table drops it
fix: hold SavedGifOp { file_id, request } in GifPanel and disable only that file's item

title: AuctionOpen is a two-variant Idle/Waiting flag beside the real stage AuctionFetch, reset by hand each frame, matched to no gift or request
trigger: tap an auction tile (Waiting), then clear the stack (craft result Close calls gift_market.clear()) or have another window/link make AuctionFetch::Ready for a different gift
effect: Waiting survives clear() (only after_market_pop resets it), so the auction box opens later over whatever the user is doing; Ready{gift_id} of any other ask is taken as this ask's answer because Waiting holds neither gift_id nor request id
fix: AuctionFetch::Loading/Ready carry the owner (from_send_box) and the box clears it in GiftMarketUi::clear; drop AuctionOpen

title: a refused sticker download is retried from frame upkeep every frame
trigger: open the gift market with live driver.download_file(file, 8) returning Err (file layer refuses)
effect: gift_market_frame_upkeep re-sends the same refused download each frame (the comment says it is intended) with no failure stage, backoff or cap
fix: requested_files as a per-file Fetch (Asked/Refused) so a refusal is marked and retried only on a new open or event

title: bid-flow state (recipient, hide_name, auction_open) lives beside the box stack and is reset by hand in four places
trigger: open an auction from the send-gift box, then leave by clear(), close_where or replace instead of pop
effect: recipient is cleared only in after_market_pop (when the stack empties), hide_name only in drop_orphans, auction_open only in after_market_pop and upkeep; clear()/close_where leave recipient set, and raise_active_bid writes recipient over a recipient an open box below still uses
fix: fold them into the AuctionBid/AuctionSend box variants (BidFlow { recipient, hide_name }) so they go with their box

title: bid()/bid_mut() find the topmost AuctionBid box by kind, not by gift_id, while bid_slot is keyed by gift_id
trigger: stack holds bid boxes for two auctions (raise_active_bid from the Active Auctions box, then another bar button)
effect: the slider Change subscription, save_custom_bid, set_bid_amount and submit_auction_bid(gift_id) read or write the other gift's chosen/custom amount
fix: bid(gift_id)/bid_mut(gift_id) keyed like bid_slot

title: craft forge is two stages kept in step: UI CraftStage::Forging { since: Instant } and session CraftSession::run Crafting { request }
trigger: press Craft, close the market dialog while the forge runs, then the answer is InvalidGift or an error
effect: craft_frame_upkeep ends the forge but, for InvalidGift and the error arm, never calls after_craft_pop: CraftStage ends as Chosen(gift) and session.payments.gift_market.craft stays Some with the consumed slots while no craft box is open; it leaks until the next craft starts
fix: one CraftRun-driven stage; forge animation derived from run, with after_craft_pop run on every end_forge

title: craft_again resets the session's own list stages by hand (candidates_load = PageLoad::Idle, candidates_offset.clear(), market = ResaleSearch::new) from UI code
trigger: Craft Another Gift
effect: an in-flight candidates request is dropped by request-id mismatch only because PageLoad documents it; the reset is outside PageLoad's own transitions and a refused preload sets Failed, so it holds today
fix: CraftSession::reset_lists() owning the transition

title: a failed Show more page of the on-sale list is never shown
trigger: Select Gifts with listings on screen, press Show more, the page fails (PageLoad::Failed)
effect: the error is drawn only when listings are empty (market.listings.is_empty() && error); with listings present the failure is silent and Show more reappears with no message
fix: draw load.error() with Retry whenever the stage is Failed, not only on an empty list

title: Gift Premium or Stars box draws no loading or failed state for the contacts it waits on
trigger: open the box with live driver; fetch_contacts is sent but answers Failed (or is still Loading); the top-chats fetch result is dropped with let _
effect: the box shows only the search field and Cancel, identical to 'nobody to gift'; Failed is treated as loaded and offers no Retry (reopen is the only way)
fix: draw Fetch<contacts> stage: spinner while Loading, error line with Retry (load_gift_recipients) on Failed

title: Send Gift dialog: a failed gift list shows a line but no Retry, and a failed Premium options list is not shown at all
trigger: open Send Gift while getAvailableGifts fails (GiftListFetch::Failed), or getPremiumGiftPaymentOptions fails (premium_fetch Failed)
