effect: gift list: error text only, grid empty, only close and reopen retries; Premium: error_line() reads gifts_fetch and SendStage only, so the Premium section silently vanishes
fix: one Retry button bound to the failed fetch, and error_line covering premium_fetch

title: non-test RefCell borrow_mut().take() in the dialog content closure (also gift_send_ui.rs:292)
trigger: the dialog content closure runs twice or re-entrantly
effect: first call takes the body; any later call renders an empty div (blank box), and a re-entrant call would panic on BorrowMutError
fix: build the body inside the closure, or hold it in the dialog entity instead of a take-once cell

title: a refused open_gift_resale leaves the session's ResaleSearch behind with no box
trigger: tap a sold-out tile whose first page send fails
effect: driver.open_gift_resale has already replaced market.resale (stage Failed) and cleared market.buy; opened is false so no Resale box is pushed and after_market_pop never runs to drop it; the stale search stays until the next open
fix: open_gift_resale builds the search only once the send is accepted, or the UI drops it on refusal

title: UI writes ResaleBuy::step, pay_in_grams and price_changed field by field (set_buy_step, set_buy_grams)
trigger: press Buy, switch Stars/Grams tab, Back
effect: price_changed is cleared only in set_buy_grams (not on set_buy_step or a new answer path in this file); step, pay_in_grams and price_changed must change together and nothing enforces it; the shared payments.gift_inputs.hide_name and GiftMarketUi::hide_name are two copies of the same choice for the two buy flows
fix: ResaleBuy transitions as methods (to_send, to_confirm(currency)) that own price_changed; one gift-choices value for both flows

title: non-test RefCell borrow_mut in the dialog body cell
trigger: The one-shot body cell `Rc<RefCell<Option<AnyElement>>>` is borrowed mutably in the content closure; a re-entrant call of the closure while it is borrowed would panic
effect: Panic (BorrowMutError) if the dialog content closure ever runs re-entrantly; today it only runs once per build
fix: Take the element with a Cell<Option<_>> (Cell::take) or hand it over by value, no RefCell

title: The UI writes the Password stage's error by hand into picker.stage
trigger: Submit in the password box when export_picked_gift returns Err before sending
effect: No bug today: the stage is left Password{Idle} and its `error` is set from outside the picker's own transitions (an empty ExportError::Other as a flag for 'refused before sending'); other refusals (Err on probe) go to a note instead, so one refusal has two display paths
fix: A TransferPicker method (`export_refused()`) that owns the transition; the error variant `ExportError::NotSent` instead of an empty `Other(String::new())`

title: A refused 'learn more' request is dropped silently
trigger: Click 'learn more' on the Value row while the chats path is not active (request_gift_value returns Err(InvalidRequest) before it stores a lookup)
effect: The click does nothing: no spinner, no error under the row, no note; open_box(GiftValue) is called but the box predicate needs an open lookup
fix: Match the result: on Err set the lookup to GiftValueStage::Failed(Q_GIFT_VALUE_NOT_SENT) (or a note) as the send-failure path in connect already does; do not call open_box on Err

title: non-test RefCell borrow_mut in the dialog body cell
trigger: Same one-shot `Rc<RefCell<Option<AnyElement>>>` as the transfer dialog
effect: Panic only if the content closure runs re-entrantly
fix: Cell::take or pass the element by value

title: One launch slot for all chats: a second prepaid launch overwrites another chat's Launching stage
trigger: Start a prepaid giveaway for chat A, close the form (Launching survives for_form), open the form of chat B and confirm its start before A's answer lands. launch_prepaid_giveaway only checks is_launching_for(B) and writes Launching{B}
effect: A's answer no longer matches the slot (request != pending id): A's success is not shown and A's failure never shows its reason; A's form opens as Idle and Start for A is enabled again
fix: A per-chat map `launches: HashMap<ChatId, GiveawayLaunch>` (stage per owner), not one slot with a chat_id inside

title: A failed giveaway-options send leaves the lists Idle: the form says 'not available' with no retry
trigger: Open 'Boosts via Gifts' for a new giveaway while the send of getPremiumGiveawayPaymentOptions or getStarGiveawayPaymentOptions fails (request_giveaway_options result is dropped with `let _`; the driver resets the Fetch to Idle, not Failed)
effect: The prize section shows 'Premium giveaways are not available' (or the Stars equivalent) as if the server refused; nothing offers Retry and nothing re-sends until the form is closed and opened again
fix: Set Fetch::Failed with send_failed_line on a failed send (as invite links do) and draw a Retry row that calls request_giveaway_options

title: Closing the form during a 3-D Secure wait resets Verifying, so a second giveaway can be bought
trigger: Pay a new giveaway, get the provider verification step (launch = Verifying{chat}), close the giveaway form (for_form turns Verifying into Idle), reopen the form for the same chat and press Start again
effect: Start is enabled again (is_done_for false, giveaway_paying false once the sendPaymentForm answered) and a second checkout for the same giveaway opens while the first is still unresolved at the provider
fix: Keep Verifying/Paid per chat until the verification outcome or logout; for_form must only drop Failed and Launched

title: Two sources for the note under the form: form.note and launch.failure_for
trigger: A prepaid launch fails (launch = Failed{chat}), then the user edits the form
effect: edit_giveaway clears form.note but the Failed reason stays drawn (it is read from the session slot until the next open/close), so the line the user just 'dismissed' by editing stays; conversely a form.note hides the launch failure
fix: One `Notice` enum on the form (None / Refused(text) / LaunchFailed), set from the launch answer and cleared by edit

title: Giveaway form stage is split across GiveawayForm::page (screen) and GiveawayState::launch (session)
trigger: Press Start on a prepaid giveaway: page Confirming -> Form is reset by hand in start_prepaid_giveaway after the driver set launch=Launching; open/close reset launch by hand with `std::mem::take(..).for_form()` from two call sites
effect: No bug found today, but the 'what the form shows' (Confirming, Launching, Launched, Failed, Paid, Verifying) is derived from two values in two owners that must change together
fix: One per-form stage enum `FormStage { Editing, Confirming, Launching{request}, Launched, Failed(reason), Paid, Verifying }` held by the form and driven by the answers

title: The giveaway pages share the one payments.pick_search field with the gift transfer picker
trigger: Type a query on the members page, press Done (close_giveaway_page does not clear the field), then open a different page or the form; or open the gift transfer picker (it clears it) while the giveaway form is below
effect: The query typed for one owner stays in the field of another: the countries page filters by the members query until the page opens (it clears on open, but Done leaves the text hidden), and pick_search_changed fires a server member search for any change while the page is Users
fix: A search input per owner (inside the GiveawayPage::Users/Countries variants and TransferPicker), or clear it in close_giveaway_page

title: Members page: a failed page is retried only by scrolling; the list error sits beside is_loading/can_load_more
trigger: The members search fails (AwardMembers::fail), the user scrolls
effect: giveaway_more_members branches on list.error().is_some() && !scrolled, load_due(), can_load_more(), is_loading(): four reads of one stage; a failed first page shows the error line with no Retry button (only a scroll near the end can resend, and an empty list cannot scroll)
fix: AwardMembers as Fetch-like `Stage { Idle, Loading, Ready{more}, Failed }` with a Retry row on Failed

title: Prepaid list reads chat_boost_details with no stage: a missing entry is shown as 'no prepaid giveaways'
trigger: Open the boosts page before getChatBoostStatus answered, or after apply_giveaway_ok removed chat_boost_details for the chat
effect: An absent entry (not loaded, removed after a launch, or failed) draws nothing; the user cannot tell 'none' from 'not loaded' and no Retry exists here
fix: Fetch<BoostStatus> per chat (Idle/Loading/Ready/Failed) and draw the list, a spinner or Retry from it

title: A failed or refused giveaway-info send opens an empty box
trigger: Press Learn more with no live connection or while request_giveaway_info returns Err
effect: A note is set but open_box(GiveawayInfo) is still called with info = None: the dialog predicate is false so no box shows, yet the shell keeps a box-host record for the kind (windows.open_box_in) that is only cleared when the box closes
fix: Call open_box only on Ok; or make the box part of the lookup stage so no separate 'open' request exists

title: non-test RefCell borrow_mut in the dialog body cell
trigger: Same one-shot Rc<RefCell<Option<AnyElement>>> `take` closure as the transfer and value dialogs
effect: Panic only if the content closure runs re-entrantly
fix: Cell::take or hand the element by value

title: non-test thread_local RefCell with_borrow_mut (WINDOWS)
trigger: with_sweep/forget_closed_windows borrow the map mutably; a closure that re-entered with_sweep would panic
effect: Panic if a future closure calls back into the sweep map; none does today
fix: Keep a plain per-window struct in the window's own state (WindowSlot) instead of a global RefCell map

title: IdleTrigger { Foreground, Left } is a bool in disguise beside Sweep
trigger: window_activation sets Left on deactivation; begin() takes it
effect: A two-variant enum read-and-reset by `mem::take` from begin; it is not tied to the Sweep stage, so a Left mark taken while worth_a_sweep is false is lost (the leaving-foreground sweep of a few emoji is skipped) and one set while Marked waits for the next begin
fix: Fold into Sweep (`Idle { left: Instant }`) or a `Option<LeftAt>` consumed with the sweep decision

title: Sweep::Marked waits for a frame start that a hidden window never draws
trigger: begin() marks every open window on the idle trim; a minimized or occluded window draws no frame
effect: Sweep stays Marked (no later begin runs for it: begin returns early on Marked) until the window draws again or closes; its atlas keeps the unswept glyphs and the emoji mark stays taken
fix: Marked carries the mark and a way out: drop it on window hide/deactivation or after N trims

title: The push-to-talk release timer is a detached task; the stage only names a deadline
trigger: Release the push-to-talk key with a release delay (mute_deadline): ptt_release spawns `spawn_screen(..).detach()` for each release that has a deadline
effect: PushToTalk holds the deadline, the Task is detached so it cannot be cancelled when the key goes down again, push-to-talk is switched off or the call ends; each release adds one more sleeping task that only no-ops through tick(now)
fix: Hold the Task in the PushToTalk stage (`Releasing { deadline, task }`) so key_down, reset and leaving drop it

title: group_call.ptt_capture: bool is a stage flag reset by hand from five places
trigger: Click the shortcut button (toggle), then close the settings window, lock the app, flip the push-to-talk switch or press a key
effect: The 'recording a key' stage is a bool toggled in the button and cleared by hand in capture_ptt_key, the switch handler, settings_window close and lock_gate; any new exit that forgets it leaves the next key press rebound as the push-to-talk key; it dodges the CI word list (not named capturing/pending)
fix: One `PttKey { Set, Capturing }` (or the shared KeyCapture stage) owned by the settings window slot so closing the window ends it

title: The big button has no Joining state: it keeps saying Join while the join is out
trigger: Press Join on a voice chat
effect: mute_state() maps not-joined to Join and joined-without-self-row to Connecting, so between the press and is_joined the button looks unpressed and invites more presses (the driver dedupes them via offer_waiting, so only feedback is missing)
fix: MuteState::Joining derived from the call's join stage (the offer in flight), shown as Connecting

title: None is drawn as Loading for invite links, join requests and administrators: nothing sends the first request from render
trigger: Open a page whose first fetch was refused (fetch_* returned Ok(None) for can_invite false then rights arrive later) or refresh while a stale request is in flight (refresh removes the entry, then fetch returns Ok(None) because has_purpose_for_chat is true)
effect: The section shows a spinner for an absent entry; if the in-flight answer is dropped (stale extra) the entry stays absent and the spinner never ends; Refresh sends nothing while the stale purpose entry exists
fix: Fetch<T> with Idle drawn as 'not loaded' plus a Retry, and refresh that replaces the in-flight request id instead of removing the entry

title: Boost status stage is Option + request-registry lookup
trigger: Open the channel info panel
effect: chat_boost_status (Some = loaded, None = not loaded or failed or removed by apply_giveaway_ok) plus has_purpose_for_chat(GetChatBoostStatus) as 'loading'; Failed is indistinguishable from never asked; refresh_boost_status removes the cached value before the send, so a refused send loses the old value
fix: Fetch<(level, count)> per chat; keep the old value until the new one lands

title: Invite-links page: a failed list send skips the counts request
trigger: Open Invite Links while fetch_chat_invite_links returns Err
effect: `.and_then` drops fetch_chat_invite_link_counts, and the error itself is discarded with `let _`; the page shows the Failed line from the list but the counts stay unasked after Retry (Retry calls refresh_invite_links only)
fix: Send both independently; Retry re-sends the counts too

title: The recent-actions poll timer keeps ticking while the window is inactive
trigger: Open Recent Actions, switch to another app
effect: event_log_poll_tick keeps returning true and the timer loop wakes every interval while window_active is false, doing nothing; the missed events are fetched only at the next tick after reactivation
fix: Pause the task when the window deactivates and restart on activation (the poll stage holds the Task)

title: Esc in the call window never closes the invite or share box
trigger: Open Invite Members or Share Invite Link over the voice chat window, press Esc
effect: Esc does nothing (group_call_window_escape and the esc_stack layers list privacy, Settings, rename only); the box closes only by its own button
fix: one CallWindowBox enum (Privacy/Settings/Rename/Invite/Share/StreamOverlay) with a topmost-first close

title: The one box over the call window is five fields kept apart: settings_open, title_dialog, call_box, stream.overlay, screen_share privacy
trigger: Open any two boxes (rename then Settings, Settings then invite)
effect: Several boxes can be open at once; each closer (Esc, lock, call change, window closed) lists a different subset by hand (sync_group_call_boxes, close_call_layers_for_lock, group_call_window_escape)
fix: one enum CallWindowBox owned by the window, replaced whole on close

title: open_group_call_invite ignores the unlock answer and opens the box and fetches contacts under the passcode lock
trigger: Lock the app while a call window is up, click Invite Members
effect: call_box becomes Invite and fetch_contacts is sent while locked; the box is undrawn until unlock, then appears (open_group_call_share_links returns on the same check)
fix: return when group_call_needs_unlock is true, as the share opener does

title: close_call_layers_for_lock does not close the invite or share box (call_box) or the stream key box state it hides only by not drawing
trigger: Open Share Invite Link (or a stream window's share box), lock, unlock
effect: Box comes back after unlock instead of staying closed; while locked it is undrawn but share_open() still makes stream_key_down swallow M/F/Esc keys
fix: close_call_box in the lock closer, or one window-box enum

title: Per-call resets (chat_shown, row_levels, stream overlay/clear) hang on a screen-owned boxes_call transition, so an account switch skips them
trigger: Open the in-call chat in a call on A, switch to B (A's call is closed), join a call on B
effect: GroupCallUi.chat_shown stays true and row_levels keep A's audio sources: B's call opens with A's chat panel; boxes_call is None after the OnScreen swap so before.is_some() is false
fix: reset GroupCallUi from the OnScreen swap (Farewell) or key it by the call it was made for

title: The stage volume slider keeps the dragged value when setGroupCallParticipantVolumeLevel fails
trigger: Drag the pinned participant's volume while offline or when the send errs
effect: Release sets stage Made(old); the server level is still old so serves() is true and the slider is never remade: it shows a level the server does not have, only a note says it failed
fix: stage holds the request: Dragging, Sent(RequestId, level), reverts to server level on failure

title: stage_volume is reset by hand from three places and never on a call change
trigger: Pin a participant, open stage, leave stage; or call ends while stage volume exists
effect: group_call_window_body, group_call_stage and stage_volume_slider each set it None or Some; the stream branch returns before the reset and sync_group_call_boxes does not clear it
fix: StageVolume owned by the stage layer (dropped with it) and keyed by call id

title: join_stream overwrites stream_watch, dropping a Wanted wish for another call
trigger: Ask to watch stream B (Wanted, call A tracked), then press Join on A's window
effect: stream_watch becomes Joining(A) and B's wish is lost; want_stream keeps a join under a wish but join_stream does not keep a wish under a join
fix: StreamWatch::Wanted{joining} built through want_stream/start_join only

title: A stream wish stays when its fetch fails while another call is tracked
trigger: Join call A, then click Join voice chat on chat B whose getGroupCall fails
effect: consume_stream_join_intent checks group_call_error only when no call is tracked; with A tracked and tracked_then == A the Wanted wish for B stays and joins B whenever it is tracked later
fix: clear the wish on the fetch's error answer matched by its RequestId held in Wanted

title: hide_timer Option<Task> is a 'timer running' flag kept in step with ControlsFade::hide_at by hand; the task resets its own slot
trigger: Move the mouse in full screen; call ends while the timer runs
effect: hide_timer must be Some exactly while hide_at is Some; arm_stream_hide_timer re-checks both from render and the task writes hide_timer=None from inside itself; StreamWindow::clear does not cancel it
fix: controls fade stage Hidden/Shown/Hiding{timer: Task} in one enum

title: Accepting a conference invitation has no in-flight stage: the Join and Decline buttons stay live
trigger: Double-click Join on a messageGroupCall row
effect: joinGroupCall is sent twice; Decline after Join is also sent; row only changes on TDLib's update
fix: a per-message AcceptStage { Idle, Sent(RequestId) } in the history UI

title: Rename closes the box and the in-call composer clears on a queued send; a later TDLib failure loses the typed text
trigger: Rename the video chat or send a call message that TDLib then refuses
effect: title_dialog is taken and composer set to empty when the request is queued; the failure lands only in group_call_error with the text gone
fix: keep the text in a Sending stage that holds the RequestId and clears on success

title: RefCell borrow_mut().take() in the dialog content closure: one-shot body, empty on a second call
trigger: Open the history box and let the kit re-run the content closure (resize, theme change)
effect: borrow is short so no panic, but the body is taken once and later calls draw an empty div; non-test RefCell borrow_mut per panic-safety rule 6
fix: build the body inside the closure from state instead of a taken RefCell

title: CallBox::Share{call: None} when no group call is tracked is never closed by keep_for
trigger: open_group_call_share_links from the stream settings row while the call is dropped
effect: keep_for(None) matches the None it was opened for, so the box stays open undrawn (overlay needs a call) and takes keys
fix: require a tracked call to open; call: i32 not Option

title: Invite picker: failed contacts fetch reads as 'No contacts to invite' and is only retried on reopen
trigger: Open Invite Members offline
effect: fetch_contacts result dropped with let _; users_state.contacts error is not shown, the list says nobody to invite
fix: show Fetch::Failed with a retry in the picker

title: window_is_stream bool restates the open window's layout beside CallWindow::Open
trigger: Call switches between voice chat and stream, or open fails
effect: bool is written only on a successful open and never cleared when CallWindow goes Closed; sync compares it to decide a reopen
fix: CallWindow::Open { handle, visible, layout }

title: Member list draws 'Loading members' forever when the page request could not be sent
trigger: Open Manage members (or switch tab / press Search) while the driver refuses the send (chats path inactive, sender closed): refresh_supergroup_members removes the cached page, fetch_supergroup_members removes the Loading entry and member_asks on Err, refresh_member_dialog also overwrites dialog.searched
effect: List shows 'Loading members...' with no Retry (Retry exists only on Failed); a note appeared once but the stage is lost. Same for basic groups (fetch_basic_group_members removes the entry on Err)
fix: Record the refused send as SupergroupMembersFetch::Failed(reason) instead of removing the entry, and treat None as Idle (send from the opener), not as Loading

title: Add exception / Remove user picker: refused send shows 'Loading' forever, Failed page has no Retry
trigger: open_add_special or search_add_special when fetch_supergroup_members / refresh_supergroup_members returns Err (page entry removed), or the first page fails with an error answer
effect: None maps to the Loading message; Failed prints the reason with no Retry button, so the person must close and reopen the picker
fix: Same Failed(reason) record for a refused send, plus a Retry button on the Failed arm (as the promote picker has)

title: Promote picker: a refused re-search wipes the shown page and leaves Loading forever
trigger: In Promote, press Search (same filter as the page shown, e.g. Recent with empty text, or Search with another query) while the driver refuses the send
effect: refresh_supergroup_members already removed the cached (chat, filter) page and its ask; searched is kept (asked is false) so promote_dialog_panel finds no page for the old text and draws 'Loading members' (the Failed arm and its Retry are never reached)
fix: Do not remove the page before the send succeeds (or restore it on Err); make a refused send a Failed stage

title: Permissions Save: Partial result drops the ids of the part that was sent
trigger: Save with permissions plus slow mode/boosts where the first part is sent and a later part is refused (PermissionsSent::Partial { sent, refused })
effect: submit becomes Failed(reason) at once; the in-flight first part is no longer tracked, so its later TDLib error is never shown, Save is enabled while it is out and the box can be closed as if saved
fix: Keep Submit::Sending(sent) and carry the refused part as its own stage variant (Sending then Failed), or hold the sent ids inside the Failed stage until they settle

title: track_chat_exit overwrites an in-flight Saving stage and drops its request ids
trigger: Press Save in the Edit box and, before TDLib answers, press Delete or Leave
effect: SaveStage::Saving(ids) is replaced by Exiting(request); a refusal of the earlier edit requests is no longer read, and the box closes as saved when the exit succeeds
fix: Refuse Delete/Leave while state() is Saving, or carry the ids in Exiting

title: A failed first boosts page is drawn as an empty list with no Retry
trigger: Open the boosts page (or switch All/Gifts) and getChatBoosts answers with an error
effect: stage Failed with no rows passes the 'not loading' test, so the page shows '0 boosts' and 'No boosts yet' above the error text; next_offset is empty so there is no Show more and no Retry (only re-clicking the tab resends)
fix: Match on PageStage: draw Failed with no rows as an error with a Retry button, and only draw 'No boosts yet' for Ready

title: Exceptions / Removed users opens the member dialog, which fetches twice
trigger: Open Permissions and tap Exceptions or Removed users
effect: open_member_dialog sends the All-tab page via refresh_member_dialog, then member_dialog_tab sends the Restricted/Banned page; the first request (which also clears the cached Recent page) is wasted
fix: open_member_dialog takes the starting tab so one request is sent

title: Info panel falls back to a bare supergroup/basic-group id used as a ChatId
trigger: An info panel target whose chat is not in session.chats (chat removed, left, not yet loaded)
effect: supergroup_info_panel uses ChatId(supergroup_id) and basic_group_info_panel ChatId(basic_group_id) as the chat, so the action row, link card, management section and members block act on a wrong or non-existent chat key instead of drawing nothing
fix: Return a not-found placeholder when the chat is unknown; never turn a supergroup/basic-group id into a ChatId

title: Unban and Add-special Remove report success when the request is queued, not answered
trigger: unban_member / kick_from_add_special: driver returns Ok(Some(id)) then TDLib refuses
effect: 'Member unbanned' / 'Member banned' note (and the picker closes) before the answer; a refusal only lands later in the member dialog's action error; the request id is dropped so nothing matches the answer to the note
fix: Hold Submit::Sent(id) for the action and settle through settle_moderation_submits like restrict/ban

title: Link check whose send is refused leaves the link line on 'Checking...' with nobody to answer
trigger: Type a free-looking public link while check_group_username returns Err (chats path inactive / sender closed); check_group_link drops the error with let _
effect: The driver records Checking only after a successful send, so no verdict and no Failed ever arrive: status() stays Pending ('Checking link...'), Save is refused with the same line, until the person types another character
fix: On a refused send record UsernameCheck::Failed for that text (shows CheckFailed and Save retries it)

title: Private Type box: a failed invite-links fetch (or no primary link) is drawn as 'Loading' forever
trigger: Open the Type box of a private chat while getChatInviteLinks fails or its send is refused (open_group_type_box ignores the Err); chat_primary_invite_link maps Failed, Loading and 'Loaded without a primary link' all to None
effect: The permanent-link block shows 'Loading...' with no Retry; the Copy/Share/Revoke actions never appear until the box is reopened
fix: Match InviteLinkFetch in the block: Failed shows the reason with Retry, Loaded without a primary link says so

title: Failed or unloaded invite-link counts are read as zero, so the 'apply to existing invite links' question is skipped
trigger: Change 'Approve new members' in the Type box and Save while fetch_chat_invite_link_counts failed, was refused, or has not answered
effect: chat_active_invite_link_count returns 0 for every non-Loaded state, so request_changed && links > 0 is false and the setting is saved without asking whether to apply it to existing invite links
fix: Save waits for (or retries) the counts: treat Failed/Idle as unknown, not as 0

title: LinkCheck names a debounce timer by version while the Task is detached; versions restart per box
trigger: Type in the link field (version 1, timer pending), cancel the Type box, reopen it within CHECK_DELAY_MS and type once (version 1 again)
effect: The first box's detached timer passes the version test for the new box and sends the server check early, bypassing the pause (wasted request, flicker). Idle and Typed also behave the same, so the enum is only a counter plus a Refused flag
fix: Hold the timer Task in LinkCheck::Typed { timer } (dropped on the next keystroke, box close or owner change) and drop the version counter

title: Welcome-message pack: a failed load send leaves no Failed stage, so the box shows 'No welcome messages yet' with no Retry
trigger: Open the welcome-message editor while the send of loadChatWelcomeMessages fails (driver Err, e.g. disconnected)
effect: load_welcome_messages only sets a status note; ConnectDriver::load_chat_welcome_messages returns before calling pack.begin(), so the Fetch stays absent/Idle, which the box draws as the empty list (no Retry, unlike join requests)
fix: On send Err mark the pack Failed (as ask_join_requests does) so the Retry row shows; draw Idle as loading, not as empty

title: WelcomeDialog editing: Option<i32> + save: Submit are two fields kept in step by hand; a row switch or Cancel drops an in-flight save
trigger: Edit a welcome message, press Save (Sending), then press Cancel on the row or Edit on another row
effect: editing/save are reset by hand at 4 sites (edit click, cancel, settle edit_gone, settle Done); the Sending Submit is overwritten with Editing, its request is forgotten, the note and error for the edit never show and a second save can go out for the same message
fix: enum Editing { Idle, Row { welcome_id, submit: Submit } } on WelcomeDialog; Cancel and Edit disabled (or refused) while Row.submit is Sending

title: begin_topic_editor overwrites a Sending TopicEditor with a fresh Submit::default()
trigger: Open the topic editor, press Save (Sending), then pick Edit Topic from the topic context menu / header New Topic for the same forum (open_forum_topic_editor -> begin_topic_editor)
effect: the in-flight createForumTopic/editForumTopic request is dropped from the stage; its answer (and refusal reason) is never shown and the user can submit a duplicate topic
fix: begin_topic_editor refuses (or keeps the editor) while editor.submit is Sending; or hold the Submit in an enum Editor { Closed, Open(TopicEditor) } whose transitions check Sending

title: TopicEditor::original_emoji is written and never read
trigger: Edit a topic's icon
effect: dead second copy of icon_emoji; no 'changed' comparison exists, so edit_forum_topic_with_icon always resends the icon
fix: delete the field, or compare with it to send only a changed icon

title: forum_column_layout writes ForumColumnUi from render, a derived copy of Session::forum_column plus the user's Peek
trigger: Resize the window across the forum column width threshold while peeking at the chat list
effect: history.forum_column is recomputed every frame from layout and the peek bit; Peek is also set by the Chats button and cleared here by hand when the forum is no longer open; stage is reset from render rather than from its own transitions
fix: keep only the user's peek intent (bool-free enum PeekIntent) and derive Column/Peek/Hidden in a pure function; no write in render

title: RemoveFromList closes the group Edit box on send, not on TDLib's answer
trigger: Confirm 'Delete chat' from the chat list for a chat whose Edit box is open and TDLib refuses (error answer)
effect: close_group_edit_box_for runs as soon as the request is sent, while the Delete/Leave arms wait on track_chat_exit; a refused delete leaves the chat with its Edit box gone
fix: use the request id of remove_chat_from_list with track_chat_exit like DeleteChat/LeaveChat

title: RemoveSelectedChats clears the selection even when some or all removals failed to send
trigger: Confirm bulk delete while the driver refuses one or more chats (remove_chat_from_list Err or Ok(None))
effect: chat_list.selected is cleared although fewer than total were sent; the user cannot retry the failed ones from the selection
fix: keep the ids that were not sent selected (or settle selection on the answers)

title: non-test RefCell borrow_mut().take() one-shot body cell in build_username_dialog
trigger: Dialog content closure re-entered while a borrow is live
effect: a RefCell double borrow panics; the one-shot cell also hands an empty div to any second invocation of the content closure
fix: build the body inside the Fn closure (clone the data it needs) instead of a take-once cell

title: non-test RefCell borrow_mut().take() one-shot body cell in build_group_confirm_dialog
trigger: Dialog content closure called more than once for one built dialog (re-layout)
effect: second call draws an empty body; borrow_mut can panic if re-entered
fix: build the body inside the Fn closure

title: non-test RefCell borrow_mut().take() one-shot body cell in build_forum_manage_dialog
trigger: Dialog content closure called more than once for one built dialog
effect: second call draws an empty body; borrow_mut can panic if re-entered
fix: build the body inside the Fn closure

title: non-test RefCell borrow_mut().take() one-shot body cell in build_welcome_dialog
trigger: Dialog content closure called more than once for one built dialog
effect: second call draws an empty body; borrow_mut can panic if re-entered
fix: build the body inside the Fn closure

title: Decode::Decoding names a running job but the job and its future are detached, so a replaced decode keeps running
trigger: Open an HDR picture in the viewer and step quickly through several (each step reset()s to Idle and render starts a new decode), or zoom across an EDGE_STEP bucket
effect: each superseded decode keeps running to the end on the background pool (HDR JPEG XL up to 1 GB and a full-size float copy each on Windows); only its answer is dropped by key. Concurrent big decodes pile up
fix: hold the Task in Decode::Decoding { key, showing, task } so reset() or a new key cancels the old decode

title: HeadroomPoll { Off, Running } is a two-variant flag beside Decode::Hdr, reset by the task itself
trigger: An HDR frame shows, then the viewer closes/steps
effect: the poll stage is the same fact as 'Decode has a frame'; it leaves only because the task sets poll = Off from inside itself on its next tick, and stays Running (with a finished task) if update_in errors, which blocks poll_viewer_headroom from restarting
fix: hold the poll Task inside Decode::Hdr (dropping the frame drops the poll)

title: A failed HDR decode is stored as Decode::Sdr, so it is treated as loaded and never retried
trigger: The decode of a HDR file fails once (file mid-write, out of memory, TooLarge)
effect: run() maps Err(_) to Outcome::Sdr; the key stays Sdr, no tag, no retry until path or screen capability changes; the user sees the SDR picture only
fix: Decode::Failed(key, error) distinct from Sdr; retry on next open

title: HistoryUi::reaction_fly is a one-shot slot nothing clears
trigger: Add an emoji reaction (reactions.rs:376/390 writes the slot), wait past REACTION_FLY_DURATION, switch chat or account
effect: No visible bug today (reaction_fly_for filters by chat and message id and the frame returns None after 520 ms), but the ReactionFly (chat id, message id, glyph, Instant) stays in the window's HistoryUi until the next reaction; it is not part of any stage and no reset removes it
fix: Hold the fly as a stage with the run's end (Fly::{None, Running{..}}) that the frame clock ends, or store it in MotionState with the other timed effects and drop it when the frame returns None

title: HistoryUi row-cache fields are reset one by one from five call sites
trigger: rows_key = None is written by hand in advanced_ui.rs:107, chat_window/mod.rs:773, chat_wide_ui.rs:104 and :132, conversation/row_splice.rs:187; rows, rows_key, ends, had_newer, chrome_epoch, chrome_seen, media_signature, reported_visible and anchor are kept in step by the row builder
effect: No bug found today; a new invalidation site that clears rows_key but not ends/had_newer/chrome_seen would splice against stale ends or skip a chrome pass
fix: One RowCache { Unbuilt, Built { key, ends, had_newer, chrome: {epoch, seen}, media_signature } } value replaced whole by an invalidate() method; callers never write rows_key

title: PillStage Hidden/Showing is a two-variant enum beside the real stage, which is computed from time
trigger: Scroll the history once: pill becomes Showing and stays Showing forever (it never returns to Hidden); whether the pill is hidden, fading or still is DateMotion::motion(now) derived from last_scroll + hide_after. top_label, separator_at_top and covered_row are loose siblings set from render (scroll_date_pill) and a stale covered_row stays until the next call
effect: No bug today; Hidden only means 'never scrolled'. A reader cannot tell the stage from the field, and covered_row is not cleared when the pill is not asked for (conversation not rendered)
fix: Make the stage the real one: Hidden / Fading / Still{wake} with an explicit transition when the hold ends (the wake task fires), and put covered_row inside the visible variants

title: Deferred focus-in never rechecks that the history still has focus
trigger: Screen reader on, empty chat: Tab into the history and out again within one frame. on_focus_in only defers history_a11y_focus_in; on_focus_out sets HistoryFocus::Away first, then the deferred call runs and sets Focused or ArmedForFirst(chat)
effect: HistoryFocus stays ArmedForFirst while the history is not focused, so the first messages that arrive take accessibility focus (set_history_a11y_focus scrolls and announces) until the next focus-out
fix: In history_a11y_focus_in return early unless message_ui.history_focus.is_focused(window); or derive Focused from the FocusHandle and keep only ArmedForFirst in the stage

title: Accept/Reject of a sharing request has no in-flight stage
trigger: Click Accept (or Reject) twice quickly, or Accept then Reject, before the server update removes the buttons (view.buttons stays true until then)
effect: Two answers are sent for one request; the second fails and shows 'couldn't reach Telegram, try again' although the first went through, or the second answer contradicts the first
fix: A per-message SharingAnswer { Open, Answering{request_id, approve}, Failed } in message_ui; buttons disabled while Answering, cleared by the answer or the error

title: Entry::bytes and Entry::failed_at encode loading/ready/failed as two Options kept in step by hand
trigger: load_entry sets bytes = Some(n) when the decode lands, or bytes = Some(0) plus failed_at = Some(clock) on Err; None/None means still loading; evict and the retry branch read them separately (bytes.unwrap_or(0))
effect: No bug today; the retry path and eviction each re-derive the stage, and a future writer that sets failed_at without bytes would be counted as loading forever
fix: enum EntryStage { Loading, Ready{bytes}, Failed{at} } on Entry, set in one place where the result is first seen

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut/borrow in thread-locals and SizedLoad
trigger: WHOLE, SLICES, SCOPED, SCOPE (borrow_mut at :164, :183, :202, :218, :719), CacheScope::enter (image_budget/cache_scope.rs:29,32) and SizedLoad::state (:619, :632, :639) all use borrow()/borrow_mut() not try_borrow; I found no overlapping borrow today (guards are short and nested calls borrow other cells shared)
effect: A future nested call (a slice callback that draws, a notify from the decode landing while use_by holds the guard) would panic the UI thread
fix: Use try_borrow(_mut) with a skip as the history probes do, or Cell<..> snapshots

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut on RETIRED, SEEN, WAKE and RETRY thread-locals
trigger: retire_all (:164), take_unshowable (:312), close_frame (:139,:146), see (:332), arm (:257), wake (:189), retry_later (:247,:250), start_sweeper (:223); take_unshowable holds RETIRED.borrow_mut across a retain closure that calls LatestFrames::may_show and Arc::strong_count (no re-entry found); dropping a retired image inside the closure never happens (images are moved out first)
effect: If Drop of a RenderImage or a closure ever re-enters retire_all during the retain, the UI thread panics
fix: try_borrow_mut with a retry_later, or move the images out before dropping anything

title: A failed @bot lookup latches for that username: Failed counts as resolved, so it is never re-asked
trigger: Type @somebot query while offline or while searchPublicChat fails (Failed 'Could not look up'); go back online and retype the same @somebot query
effect: The panel keeps showing the old failure line; no lookup is sent again until another bot username replaces the session slot
fix: A resolve Fetch-like stage where Failed (transient) is re-asked on the next composer event; clear the slot/copy when the trigger goes away

title: One session-wide resolve slot keyed by username, copied per window; answers matched by username/generation with a re-ask workaround
trigger: Two windows type different @bot triggers: the second replaces the shared slot, the first window's answer is dropped and progress_inline_mode_here re-asks
effect: Works by re-asking; the resolve state of a window is spread over the session slot, ChatUi::inline_bot and InlineWait::Session
fix: Per-window (ChatUi) InlineBotResolve stage holding the request's generation; session slot only carries answers

title: Inline query answers are matched by (chat, bot, first_page) plus an in-flight guard, not by the RequestId held in InlineMode
trigger: Open a query for chat+bot; a newer query waits on the guard (Ok(None)) and the slot answers by chat/bot only
effect: Safe only because the driver allows one query per chat+bot; the stage does not hold the RequestId that its answer must match
fix: InlineWait::Asked{request: RequestId, query} and apply the answer only when the id matches

title: A failed inline-query send closes the panel with no note
trigger: Type @bot query while the connection is down so driver.inline_query returns Err
effect: The panel vanishes silently; the user sees no reason
fix: Show InlineView::Status with the error (a Failed stage) instead of Closed

title: Picking a result with no live connection clears the composer and sends nothing
trigger: Press Enter or click a result while self.live is None
effect: The typed @bot query is erased and the pick is dropped (the Err arm restores it, the None arm does not)
fix: Treat None like Err: restore the typed markup and show the note

title: inline_bot_alert_shown is a one-way 'confirmed once' bool beside ChatUi::bot_alert, held per composer_ui rather than per account
trigger: Confirm the secret-chat inline-bot warning in one window or account; open a secret chat in another window or after an account switch
effect: The warning is asked again in the other window, or the latch outlives the account that confirmed it; nothing ever resets it
fix: Fold into one per-account enum (BotAlertState { Unconfirmed, Asking(..), Confirmed }) in OnScreen

title: Paging mirrors the session's MoreMembers stage; the two are bridged by take_member_more_failures from a render-deferred call
trigger: Scroll the members list so a next page fails, then render without scrolling
effect: Failure is consumed from the session (Failed -> Idle) by UI code, copied into Paging::Failed, and Paging::Idle is written by hand in inline_members_stale and reset; the same stage lives in two enums
fix: One stage (the session's MoreMembers with the offset) read by the view; no UI copy

title: inline_members_stale writes paging and admins by hand outside reset and the stage's own transitions
trigger: updateChatMember drops the cached pages while the panel shows the group
effect: Two resets of the same fields (reset and stale) must be kept in step; shown/snapshot are not reset there
fix: One InlineMembersUi::refetch() transition that the opened, stale and Retry paths all call

title: The administrators fallback is marked Asked before the send and its send failure is ignored, so the list stays on 'Loading members' with no Retry
trigger: Recent members fail (hidden from the viewer) while the connection drops exactly as fetch_supergroup_members(Administrators) is sent
effect: AdminsFallback::Asked(chat) stays set, the admin fetch never exists (stage Loading, not Failed, so the Retry button is not drawn); only closing and reopening the panel clears it
fix: Set Asked only when the send returned Ok; on Err set a Failed stage the view can retry

title: InlineMembersUi::chat is written by reset but never read outside tests
trigger: Open any group info panel
effect: A dead owner key: the real owners are AdminsFallback::Asked(ChatId) and MembersSnapshot::chat, so three fields name the group
fix: Delete the field or make it the single owner key used by admins and the snapshot

title: The members view writes a RefCell snapshot during render (replace and borrow on InlineMembersUi::snapshot)
trigger: Any re-entrant render of the info panel while the snapshot Ref is held
effect: RefCell borrow panic risk; also render mutates state (the last good page)
fix: Store the snapshot in the session fetch (keep the last Loaded page in the Loading stage) and drop the RefCell

title: A failed next-page send is not recorded, so progress_inline_mode_here re-sends it after every poll batch
trigger: Scroll the inline results near the end while driver.inline_query returns Err
effect: let _ = ignores the Err; more_failed is set only by a failed answer, so every poll batch retries the send (wasted work, no backoff)
fix: Set more_failed (or a Failed page stage) when the send fails

title: The round trip becomes Started before press_bot_start sends; a refused start leaves a Started trip waiting
trigger: Press the inline results button; the bot chat opens but press_bot_start cannot send (offline, blocked bot)
effect: Stage is Started{OwnStart} and waits for an own message that never appears; it ends only when the user leaves the bot chat
fix: Move to Started only on a successful send (press_bot_start returns the outcome)

title: InlineReturn carries its account and every entry point calls drop_foreign_inline_return by hand instead of living in OnScreen
trigger: Begin an inline return, switch account, come back
effect: Ownership is checked at four call sites; the window-slot copy (take_slot_inline_return) has no such check
fix: Move the round trip into per-account OnScreen state so the swap drops it

title: GIF playback is GifPlayback plus gif_decodes plus play intent, kept in step by hand around a detached decode task
trigger: Start a GIF, stop it, start it again before the decode sees the stop; or switch account while it decodes
effect: spawn spawn_gif_decode is .detach()ed; its cancel token lives in gif_decodes, set only by stop_animation_playback, so an account switch (OnScreen dropped) leaves the decode running to completion; 'taken back' logic reconciles the maps
fix: GifPlayback::Waiting/Playing hold the decode Task and cancel token (dropping the stage cancels it)

title: release_timer is cleared only by the timer task itself; a skipped re-entrant borrow latches it Some
trigger: State::with returns None (re-entrant borrow) in the timer task's clear step
effect: arm_release then never re-arms, so off-screen players are put to sleep only on history passes
fix: Clear the timer in the same borrow as the sweep, or hold it in Presence::OffScreen

title: RefCell borrow_mut in fire_resize, RunningResize::drop, on_resize, set_zoom and the WINDOWS thread-local
trigger: A GPUI resize handler re-registers on_resize or triggers set_zoom while one of these borrows is held
effect: BorrowMutError panic in the platform layer (a crash on zoom change)
fix: Use try_borrow_mut with the existing Refire::RunAgain fallback

title: corner_mask holds the MASKS RefCell borrow_mut across image_budget::retire_all in the if-let body
trigger: retire_all (or a drop it runs) calls corner_mask again
effect: BorrowMutError panic while drawing a video tile
fix: Bind the evicted value first, drop the borrow, then retire it

title: Open link details are held twice: GroupSettingsDialog::details_link and session invite_pages.members(chat).invite_link, set by hand in step
trigger: Open details of link A, then press details of link B while the send for B is refused: dialog.details_link becomes None but the session still holds A's members page (close_chat_invite_link_members is only called when toggling the same link)
effect: Stale members page for A stays in the session (and is fetched/paged) while the dialog shows nothing; reopening A shows old rows without a fresh fetch decision
fix: Derive open/closed from invite_pages.members only (one owner), drop details_link

title: Demo (no live driver): details toggle sets details_link but no members page exists, so the block shows Loading forever
trigger: Screenshot demo or offline session: press a link's details
effect: Permanent Loading row, no error, no way out except toggling
fix: Open state derived from the session page (Fetch<T> with Idle/Loading/Failed)

title: Revoked list: dialog.revoked_open bool flipped before the request and rolled back by hand on a refused send, beside the session fetch (revoked_invite_links: InviteLinkFetch)
trigger: Press Revoked links; send refused: revoked_open set true, then set back to false in a second lookup
effect: Open flag and fetch stage are two values kept in step by hand; a Failed fetch with revoked_open=true shows the message but never re-sends on re-open unless toggled twice
fix: One enum on the dialog section: Closed | Open(Fetch) or derive open from the fetch stage

title: LimitFocus {Requested, Done} is a two-variant one-shot flag beside CustomBox::Limit, moved from builder (draw) code
trigger: Open Custom limit box: take_invite_link_limit_focus flips Requested to Done inside build_invite_link_custom_dialog, which runs on every dialog (re)build; the focus is then held in a Cell and taken in the content closure
effect: If the dialog is rebuilt before the content closure runs the focus request is lost (already Done); stage reset from draw code instead of a transition
fix: Focus the input at open time via window.defer in open_invite_link_custom_limit, drop the enum

title: Non-test Rc<RefCell> borrow_mut in the Custom dialog content closure
trigger: Dialog content closure called twice reentrantly or while another borrow is held
effect: BorrowMutError panic
fix: Build the body inside the closure or use Cell<Option<..>>::take

title: Non-test Rc<RefCell> borrow_mut in the Jump to date dialog content closure
trigger: Content closure runs while the cell is borrowed
effect: BorrowMutError panic
fix: Cell<Option<AnyElement>>::take or build in the closure

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut of corners and corner_lift during render (two borrows held together)
trigger: Reentrant render of the history surface (e.g. the corner stack drawn in two windows or an animation tick during render)
effect: BorrowMutError panic
fix: Keep the presence state in a GPUI entity or Cell value types

title: start_invoice_checkout resets checkout, order_info, shipping_id and note by hand, duplicating Session::close_checkout (which also clears request)
trigger: Press Buy on an invoice while another checkout is on screen or after a paid one
effect: Four fields of one mode cleared from UI code; a new field added to close_checkout is missed here; request is left to the sender and stays stale if the send errors, so submit_stars_payment can later find a request with a Closed checkout
fix: Call one Session::begin_checkout() that replaces the whole checkout stage (request, form, order info, shipping, note) as one enum value

title: open_box(PaymentForm) is called before the send result is known; on a failed send the old payments.dialog is left Some while the checkout is wiped
trigger: Checkout dialog open, press Buy again (or open another invoice link) and the send is refused
effect: The previous PaymentDialog object (inputs, prefill) stays in self.payments.dialog with a Closed checkout: dialog is hidden by payment_dialog_visible but its state outlives the checkout and a later open reuses a stale open intent
fix: Open the box only on Ok; clear payments.dialog in the same transition that closes the checkout

title: Non-test borrow() of the GPUI keymap RefCell (cx.key_bindings().borrow())
trigger: apply_custom_bindings runs while another borrow_mut of the keymap is live (reentrant keymap update)
effect: BorrowError panic at account switch or rebinding
fix: Use a kit/gpui accessor that returns an owned list, or keep Quill's own binding list

title: retry_language_packs resets the Failed stage to Idle by hand (packs.clear_error()) from UI code, then relies on is_idle() in ask_language_packs
trigger: Press Retry on the failed language list
effect: Stage reset from outside its own transitions; request_language_packs already begins/fails the stage itself, so Retry could call it directly
fix: Fetch<T>::retry() transition (Failed -> Loading) owned by the stage, no UI-side clear_error

title: Opening a second giftcode/setlanguage link overwrites the open lookup (including an applying gift code) with a fresh Checking/LookingUp stage
trigger: Gift code box open, press Use Link (applyPremiumGiftCode in flight), then click another t.me/giftcode link
effect: request_gift_code_info replaces payments.gift_code with Checking(new): the in-flight apply loses its stage; its answer is no longer matched, Premium is applied with no 'now active' feedback; on a refused send the old lookup is also dropped (gift_code = None) and the box vanishes
fix: Refuse (or queue) a new lookup while the stage is Applying; keep the old stage on a refused send

title: Non-test Rc<RefCell> borrow_mut in finish_tracked dialog content closure
trigger: Dialog content closure called while the cell is borrowed
effect: BorrowMutError panic
fix: Cell<Option<AnyElement>>::take

title: MainWindowState::LeavingFullScreen names a poll loop whose Task is detach()ed; the way out runs only if the last main.update succeeds
trigger: macOS: close main window in full screen; the window handle is gone or replaced before the 3 s poll ends
effect: If the final update fails the global stays LeavingFullScreen: hide_main_window returns early forever (close button never hides), and activation treats the window as closed
fix: Hold the poll Task in the stage (LeavingFullScreen(Task)) so replacing or dropping the stage cancels it

title: Main window handle is held twice: the MainWindow global (handle + state) and QuillApp::main_window.handle
trigger: Main window replaced after a lost GPU: note_main_window resets the global, QuillApp::main_window is set elsewhere
effect: Two copies of one fact that must be changed together (raise_main_window_later reads the app copy, activation reads the global copy)
fix: One owner (the app's MainWindowSlot) with the open/closed stage inside it

title: Link pump re-wakes every 250 ms while a link waits behind another flow, also while the app is locked or hidden
trigger: A second launch hands a link while pending_deep_link is Some and its flow is stuck (locked app, sign-in screen, unanswered Join box)
effect: A polling loop with view.update every 250 ms until the first link is taken; wasted work while locked/hidden
fix: Wake the pump from the transition that frees pending_deep_link instead of polling

title: open_mask_sets sets the sticker manager's open flag before the request and leaves it set when the request is refused
trigger: Not connected (chats path inactive, so ConnectDriver::open_mask_sets returns Err) -> click 'Manage masks' in the photo editor's Stickers mode
effect: A 'could not load masks' note shows and the box does not open (MaskSets is_open reads masks.dialog_open, still false), but Session::stickers.manager.open stays true: pump_sticker_manager keeps running ensure_manager_covers (sticker set cover downloads) after every answer with nothing shown, until some manager box is opened and closed
fix: One stage owned by the box (opened only after the send succeeds, or derived from masks.dialog_open / the settings box flag instead of a second flag); on Err call set_sticker_manager_open(false)

title: Reorient::Decoding keeps a token and the decode Task is detach()ed, so a superseded turn still decodes a full-size picture (contradicts section 8 11-p1-005 'a newer press, a step or a close drops the decode, so no generation counter')
trigger: Open a large photo, press Rotate three times quickly (or Rotate, then step to the next item or close the viewer)
effect: Each press starts its own background_spawn decode (up to ~20 MB and a GPU upload each) that runs to the end; only the late result is ignored by token (finish_viewer_reorient). Wasted CPU/memory, and a token counter the docs say was removed
fix: Hold the awaiting Task (which owns the background job) inside Reorient::Decoding so begin/cancel/reset drop it; drop the token and the is_decoding(token) match

title: PeekPreview::Pressing still matches its long-press timer by (chat, Instant) and the timer is a detach()ed spawn_screen task (contradicts section 8 11-p2-015 'ChatPeek ... pressing with the timer task: a release drops the timer instead of matching (chat, Instant)'); close_chat_preview is one of the hand resets of that stage
trigger: Press a chat row, release before the long-press delay
effect: Works through the Instant token; the detached task wakes after the delay for nothing, and the stage names a timer it does not own (src/ui/message_actions/open_chat_preview.rs:17, src/ui/chat_list_state.rs PeekPreview)
fix: PeekPreview::Pressing { chat, timer: Task<()>, over } with the task held in the stage; a release/close replaces the stage and drops the timer; delete is_press(chat, started)

title: Saved toast is an Option plus a generation counter, and its hide timer is a detach()ed task matched by the counter
trigger: Save a photo from the viewer twice within 3 s
effect: Both timers run; the older one is ignored by saved_toast_gen. close_media_viewer clears the toast but not the counter. No bug today
fix: enum SavedToast { None, Shown { toast, _hide: Task<()> } }; a newer save replaces the value and drops the old timer; delete the counter

title: LoopPause {Free, HeldByWindow} is a bool beside the player's own play state, and stop_viewer_video does not clear it (contradicts section 8 11-p1-006 'the pause is cleared when the clip stops')
trigger: Looping (silent MP4) clip open, window loses focus -> loop_pause = HeldByWindow; a voice message / audio starts (audio_playback.rs:186 / inline_playback.rs:227 call stop_viewer_video, dropping the player) ; press Space to start the clip again; pause it yourself; switch away from the window and back
effect: sync_viewer_window_activity sees active && HeldByWindow and calls resume_viewer_video: the clip the user paused plays again. Only reset_viewer_item_state clears the marker
fix: Fold the window pause into the player stage (e.g. PlayState::PausedByWindow) or clear it inside stop_viewer_video / ViewerClip::stop

title: One slider drag is three fields: seek_preview Option, volume_dragging bool, speed_preview Option, ORed by dragging() and cleared by hand in clear_clip
trigger: Drag the volume thumb, release outside the window / the clip is stopped by another player mid-drag
effect: No bug today (clear_clip resets all three), but a new drag kind must remember to join dragging() and clear_clip; volume_dragging is a stage bool next to two stage Options
fix: enum SliderDrag { None, Seek(f64), Volume, Speed(f64) } (src/ui/video_player/controls/mod.rs:74-82)

title: Space-hold boost is the BoostState machine plus a separate boost_timer Option<Task>, set and cleared by hand in five places
trigger: Hold Space on a video, release; change speed during the hold; open PiP; window loses focus
effect: viewer_space_down sets boost_timer; viewer_boost_tick, viewer_key_up, cancel_viewer_boost, set_playback_speed (playback.rs:288) and clear_clip each reset it beside boost.cancel(). A missed site leaves a timer running for a hold that ended
fix: Put the Task inside BoostState::Armed { timer } so any transition out of Armed drops it

title: Swipe timeout: the deadline lives in viewer.swipe (timeout_at) while the timer is a detach()ed spawn_scoped loop armed whenever the deadline appears
trigger: Two trackpad swipes without phases (Wayland/X11) back to back
effect: A second detached loop is armed while the first is still sleeping; both run and the second finds the deadline gone. Bounded, no visible effect
fix: Hold the timer Task in the swipe stage (SwipeNav::Capturing { deadline, _timer }) so ending the swipe drops it

title: ControlsVisibility::Hidden { at } names the fade end but the redraw that ends the fade is a detached, unscoped cx.spawn timer, and the render reads Instant::elapsed to decide the controls are gone (contradicts the 'hide task in state' claim of section 8 11-p1-004 for this half)
trigger: Hide the controls (1.1 s idle), then show and hide again quickly
effect: Each hide starts a detached timer that notifies the whole app entity after the fade; not tied to the viewer or window, so it fires after the viewer closed or the account switched. Wasted redraws only
fix: Hidden { at, _settle: Task<()> } held in the stage and scoped (spawn_scoped); viewer_controls_gone reads the stage, not the clock

title: load_marketplace_gift reports 'choose a private chat' for every failure, including a refused send
trigger: Open 'Buy a collectible by name' for a chat while the connection is down, enter a name, press Load Gift
effect: The error line says to choose a private chat although one is chosen; the real cause (not connected) is never shown
fix: Match the result: None -> no chat/live note, Some(Err) -> a could-not-send note; carry the cause as an enum in the draft instead of a string

title: The search field (LocationPickerUi::search Open{input, debounce}) and the picker's own query (Session::location picker search) must be open together; one function keeps them in step by hand
trigger: location_search_open sets Search::Open then location_search_changed(Some("")); only location_search_changed(None) sets Closed
effect: No bug today (section 8 10-169 says this is tested); a second writer of either side breaks it
fix: Derive the field from the picker (create the input when picker.search_shown() flips) or keep both in one Search value

title: 'My location' starts a new lookup (Locate::Locating) without moving the picker's HereState back to Locating: two stages for one lookup
trigger: Picker open and the first lookup answered Denied or Unavailable, then press the 'my location' button
effect: The 'location denied' / 'unavailable' note stays under the venues for up to 30 s while the new lookup runs; HereState::Locating is only set in LocationPicker::open (src/location_picker/picker.rs:178)
fix: A session event locate_started() that sets here = Locating (called from locate_for_picker), or derive 'locating' from Locate in the UI

title: RUNNING RefCell borrow_mut guard is held across ObjC calls (setDelegate, stopUpdatingLocation) in locate() and cancel()
trigger: Start a lookup while an older one is running; or drop a Locating on the main thread
effect: A delegate callback that re-enters locate/cancel during those calls would panic with BorrowMutError. None reaches RUNNING today (authorization_changed/did_update do not), so low risk
fix: take() the old Running out of the cell, drop the guard, then call the native stop

title: The viewer's per-open state is reset by two hand-kept lists, close_media_viewer and reset_viewer_item_state, and fields of ViewerUi/ViewerExtra are in one list or the other
trigger: Open the viewer, close it, open another item
effect: close_media_viewer clears saved_toast, caption, reorient, hdr, over_controls, drag, pending_seek; reset_viewer_item_state clears zoom, drag, wheel, swipe, orientation, reorient, hdr, share_at, loop_pause (not the others). shared_tab, shared_seen, visibility and swipe/wheel survive a close. No leak found, but each new field must be added to the right list
fix: Replace the viewer's per-open value whole on open/close (an OpenViewer struct built by MediaViewer::open) instead of field-by-field resets

title: share_at (message + second the forward picker was opened at) lives in ViewerExtra but belongs to the forward picker, and is cleared by hand in forward.rs:88, forward.rs:174 and navigation.rs:216
trigger: Share at 1:23, close the picker; or step the viewer
effect: No bug today; the owner (forward picker) does not hold its own value, so a new picker exit must remember to clear it
fix: Put the position in the ForwardDraft / picker stage so closing the picker drops it

title: The viewer panel clones the whole session FileMap and DownloadIntents on every render
trigger: Play a video in the viewer (the chrome redraws every 100 ms)
effect: Two full map clones per redraw while the viewer is open: wasted work that grows with the number of files the session holds
fix: Borrow the maps for the render (collect the item's files first) instead of cloning

title: Rc<RefCell<Option<AnyElement>>> body taken with borrow_mut().take() inside the dialog content closure (same pattern 123 times in src/ui; also reveal.rs:53 frame.surfaces.media_panel.borrow_mut())
trigger: Open Set Status for... (or any dialog built this way) and have the kit call the content closure twice
effect: The second call gets an empty div (no panic: the borrows are short and never nested). Listed because the brief counts any non-test RefCell borrow
fix: Build the body inside the content closure (as location_picker/dialog.rs does) so no cell is needed

title: A refused getGameHighScores leaves the scores panel drawing 'Loading scores...' for ever, with no error and no Retry
trigger: Tap Scores on a game card when the request is refused (a status note shows)
effect: The panel keeps the spinner text; a second tap closes it and a third retries, which nothing tells the user. Section 8 (11-p3-004) says Failed is drawn with Retry; the panel only matches data() None as loading
fix: draw Fetch::Failed with its error and a Retry button; match on the Fetch variant, not data()

title: Game score answers are matched by (chat, message) key, not by the RequestId held in the stage (Loading { request: None } is never .sent())
trigger: Tap Scores, tap again to close, tap again to reopen before the first answer arrives
effect: The first request's answer fills (or fails) the second panel while its own request is still in flight; the second answer then overwrites it, so it self-corrects
fix: call Fetch::sent(request) after send_game_high_scores and apply with Fetch::answered/failed(request)

title: PeekPreview::Pressing names a timer, but the timer Task is detached and the stage is matched by (chat, Instant) token
trigger: Press and hold a chat row, release early, press another row
effect: No wrong result today; the press token is an Instant compared by hand, and the Task is not held in the stage (section 8 11-p2-015 says it was)
fix: Pressing { chat, over, _timer: Task<()> } so release or a new press drops the timer; drop the Instant token

title: StickerBox { Closed, Shown } is a two-variant flag beside the real stage (session sticker_set_view) and QuillApp::sticker_box, reset by hand in several places
trigger: Open View Sticker Set in one window, then in another; or a set removed by the answer
effect: The dialog's open predicate is the per-window flag, not the session view; claim_sticker_set_box, close_sticker_set_dialog, view_message_sticker_set and media_viewer/actions.rs each set or clear it and sticker_box.reset() by hand
fix: derive the box from sticker_set_view carrying its owning window and make closing it one transition

title: baseline: FooterMeta::pending sits beside receipt: OutboxReceipt for one send stage (sending, sent, read)
trigger: Send a message and watch the footer
effect: message_footer(date, pending, receipt) lets pending win over receipt by hand in three places (mark, status text, outgoing alpha); both are copies of the message's delivery stage
fix: Delivery { Sending, Sent, Read, None } carried in the footer

title: The chat-row menu is Option<ChatMenuState> cleared by hand at 28 sites (six in this file), with top_person: bool choosing which overlay draws
trigger: Open the menu on a top person, click any row
effect: Each row handler sets chat_list.menu = None itself; the message menu has MessageMenu::close(), this one has no single closer, so a new row can miss it
fix: ChatMenu { Closed, Open(ChatMenuState) } with close(), and kind: ChatMenuKind { Row, TopPerson }

title: Two one-shot right-press slots with different lifetimes: right_clicked_link is cleared at the end of the press by a detached task, right_clicked_item has no such clear
trigger: Right-press a checklist task or poll option where no message menu opens, then open a menu at the same pixel
effect: The item note stays until the next menu open (take_right_clicked_item) and could be handed to a later menu at that point; the row's right-press handler opens the menu in the same event today, so no wrong result is known
fix: one RightPress { position, link, item } slot owned by the press, cleared by its own end

title: Block user on a Replies message overwrites session replies_block without looking at an in-flight Submitting(request)
trigger: Submit the Block box in one window, open a message menu in another window and choose Block user before the answer
effect: The earlier request's answer no longer matches the box (box_is_for_it), so its 'blocked' note is never shown and the box now shows the new target
fix: refuse or queue a new target while the stage is Submitting

title: Per-window message menus share single session slots: message_audience, message_reaction_options (reset by close_message_menu) and wanted_reactor_tab
trigger: Open a message menu in the main window, then one in a chat window, then close the second
effect: Opening the second replaces the first menu's audience page (empty) and strip; closing it resets the first menu's reaction strip, which does not come back
fix: key the slots by window like WindowViews, or make the menu own them

title: RefCell borrows held across callbacks and in paint: begin_pass holds BADGES.borrow_mut() while calling keep, take_replays holds REPLAYS.borrow_mut() while calling shown, the badge canvas uses borrow_mut() in paint, pinned_message_banner uses pinned_bar.borrow_mut() (unpin_from_banner.rs:81)
trigger: A caller passes a callback that reaches the same registry
effect: Both callbacks are pure today; a re-entrant one would panic (panic-safety rule 6)
fix: copy out before calling the callback and use try_borrow_mut in paint closures

title: message_effects_pass calls load_message_effects every frame while a waiting effect of the open chat exists, up to WAIT (30 s) when its badge is scrolled off
trigger: Click a badge, scroll it off before its effect description arrives, keep the chat open
effect: No request is re-sent (the driver dedupes with backoff) but each frame rebuilds the pending set; waiting entries whose badge is not seen stay for 30 s
fix: ask once when the entry is added and keep the waiting entry only while its badge is on screen

title: Save As on a media message that is not local ignores a failed ensure_media_files and still says it is downloading
trigger: Choose Save As on a remote file while the driver refuses the download request
effect: The note says 'Downloading, choose Save As again' but nothing downloads
fix: report the refused send with an error note

title: A reply typed into Quill's own notification window is lost when the send is refused
trigger: Own notification windows are on. Open the Reply field in a toast of a channel or a chat you cannot write in, type text, press Enter.
effect: The window closes and the chat opens with an empty composer; the typed text is gone, though InlineReplyOutcome::Refused documents that it must not vanish. The platform path keeps it in delivery.unsent_replies (inline_reply.rs:172), the ViewEvent::ReplySent arm never does.
fix: One path for a typed reply: ReplySent hands the text to send_typed_notification_reply's store (or the ChatClick carries the text) so any outcome other than Sent keeps it

title: The remote-folder-deleted fallback in poll_live copies set_chat_list_view by hand and drops the pin-drag end
trigger: Drag a pinned chat row while the selected folder is deleted from another device.
effect: folders.tab and chat_list.selected are reset but chat_list.pin.end_drag() (done by set_chat_list_view, listed.rs:75) is not, so the drag stays armed on a list that changed under it.
fix: Call one reset (set_chat_list_view split so it takes the folder list, not &self.live) from both places

title: unsent_replies is a one-shot slot nothing clears except one open path
trigger: Reply from a notification while locked or to a chat that refuses it (text goes into delivery.unsent_replies), never open that chat from that click; later click Open on another notification of the same chat.
effect: The old typed text is put into the composer (compose_unsent_reply via apply_open_carry) at a later unrelated open; the text also stays in memory across lock, log-out and account removal.
fix: Carry the text inside the ChatClick/open request that made it (consumed or dropped with it), or an UnsentReply stage cleared on unlock, account removal and a newer click

title: NotifyView::actions is derived (hovered && reply.is_none() && can_reply) but stored and kept in step by hand
trigger: Hover a toast, open Reply, move the pointer out and back.
effect: No bug today: set_hovered and open_reply each recompute or clear it; a third writer would desync it. Reply state also lives in Shown::stage (Replying) in the manager, fed by ReplyOpened.
fix: Compute the Reply button from hovered/reply in render; one ReplyState owner (Stage::Replying) instead of reply.is_some() beside it

title: Stage::Unlinked and the popup's fade-out are two changes made together at five call sites
trigger: Read, close, replace, Hide all, lower the count.
effect: No bug today: shown.unlink() then shown.popup.hide(false, now) at mod.rs:353, 387, 403, 622, 753; a site that unlinks without hiding leaves a dead window up (settle_hiding skips unlinked ones, so nothing would fade it).
fix: Shown::unlink(now) does both (or Stage::Unlinked carries the fade)

title: apply_chat_ttl closes the timer picker before the send, so a refused send loses the person's pick
trigger: Open the auto-delete picker, choose a period, press Save while the send is refused (no connection).
effect: The picker is gone and only an error note shows; the sound, mute and story pickers deliberately stay open on a refusal (sounds.rs:65, mute_menu.rs:60).
fix: Clear ttl_picker only on Ok, as apply_chat_sound does

title: The type step's Save requests outlive the dialog that sent them
trigger: Save a channel's type (Saving), close the dialog, open another New Channel.
effect: session.groups.new_chats.type_saves keeps the old request ids until the next Save clears it; abandon_new_chat (connect/groups/new_chat.rs:94) is only called for Creating, not for Type{Saving(sent)}. Harmless today because lookups are by request id.
fix: drop_new_chat_dialog abandons a Saving stage's requests too

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut sites (short, no re-entry found)
trigger: None found: motion.rs:325, 351, 365; new_contact.rs:250; on_screen.rs:582 each hold the guard for a few lines with no call out.
effect: Would panic only if a caller re-entered while a guard is held; none seen.
fix: Cell<Option<Reveal>> for motion (Reveal is Copy); try_borrow_mut at the other sites

title: Transfer dialog sticks on 'Checking...' / 'Finding out who becomes the owner...' when the opening requests fail to send
trigger: Open Transfer ownership or the owner Leave box while the connection is not ready (chats_path_active false or send error); the sends are `let _ =` ignored, check is cancelled back to Idle and the owner lookup entry is removed
effect: Confirm step shows 'Checking...' forever (Idle is neither ready, blocked nor error) and the Leave box shows 'Finding out...' forever; no retry until the dialog is reopened
fix: Show Idle/failed send as Fetch::Failed with a Retry, or retry on entering Confirm

title: Pick list treats a loading or failed member list as an empty list
trigger: Open Transfer ownership on a large group: the five member fetches (sends ignored with `let _`) are still Loading, or one failed
effect: Candidate list shows the 'no candidates' empty text while loading and for good after a failure; no spinner, error or retry
fix: Draw Loading/Failed/Empty from the Fetch variants of the member lists, with Retry

title: Password field is emptied and a wrong note shown when the transfer was not sent
trigger: Press Change owner with an empty password (or a driver refusal returning Ok(None)); driver returns Ok(None) without sending
effect: Field is cleared anyway and the note says 'Ownership can't be transferred right now' though nothing was tried
fix: Clear the field only when the request was handed to TDLib; say what is missing otherwise

title: DirectStage::{Editing,Saving} mirrors the session's TargetSave stage for the same save
trigger: Press Save in the channel Direct Messages box
effect: DirectMessagesBox::stage is set by hand to Saving on send and back to Editing by per-frame upkeep reading session save.of(target); the dialog also ORs `is_saving_for` with the stage, so the stage is held twice
fix: Derive Saving/Failed from the session TargetSave only (drop DirectStage)

title: confirm_trust is a second field of the paid confirmation mode, cleared by hand in several places
trigger: Tick 'Don't ask me again', then Cancel, Pay, or open another confirmation
effect: confirm_trust must be None whenever the confirmation changes: cleared by hand in paid_send_waits, cancel_paid_confirm and confirm_paid_send, and checked against (chat, price) in paid_confirm_trusted; a held send (driver-side) has no ComposerPaidConfirm to carry it
fix: Put the tick inside one PaidConfirmStage value (composer or held) so it dies with the confirmation

title: Save price takes the draft before the request is known to go
trigger: Staged price, press Save when Premium lapsed (can_restrict false) or the send fails
effect: Draft slider is dropped (take) and nothing is saved or said when !can_restrict; on a send error the staged price is lost and must be redone
fix: Take the draft only after the request was sent; keep it on refusal

title: busy ignores the upgraded gift colors request
trigger: Name tab: pick a collectible gift and press Apply
effect: busy only checks SetAccentColor and SetProfileAccentColor, so while SetUpgradedGiftColors is in flight the box says 'Style updated' (stage Sent), then flips to the error if it fails
fix: Include every color purpose in busy, or hold the request id in the stage

title: ApplyStage::{Sent,Failed} is a second copy of the request stage, fed by a shared one-shot error slot
trigger: Apply colors; the answer arrives
effect: The stage is set by hand to Sent at send, to Failed by take_peer_color_error from users_state.peer_color_error (one slot shared by three request purposes, not matched to the request), while busy is read from requests.has_purpose; three sources for one stage
