fix: ApplyStage::Applying(RequestId) that the answer or error for that id leaves

title: Toast stage names a 2.8 s timer whose Task is detached
trigger: Any QR box toast (Copied, expiring...)
effect: open.toast holds (toast, Instant) and a detached task compares the Instant at fire time; the timer is not held in the stage, so it cannot be cancelled with the box and one task per toast lives its full time
fix: QrToastStage::Showing{toast, _timer: Task<()>}

title: PanelMotion::Closing never settles, so a closed gifts panel keeps the whole gift list in the drawn set
trigger: Open the Gifts panel, then close it
effect: motion.shown() stays Some(Gifts) at rest, so qr_drawn_gifts keeps adding every listed gift and qr_prepare_gift_art keeps preparing stills and re-requesting missing stickers on each poll while the panel is closed
fix: Closing settles to Idle once its duration passed, or shown() reports None at rest

title: OpenQr::swap is a one-shot animation slot nothing clears
trigger: Toggle an emoji in the QR box
effect: swap stays Some after SWAP_MS until the next change or close; qr_prepare_art keeps making stills for its `previous` emoji and the pattern keeps counting them
fix: Fold into PanelMotion-like PatternMotion enum that settles to Idle

title: Paged-dialog Asked memories are never reset when the dialog reopens
trigger: A second Subscriptions/Stars/Gifts/Grams page fails (or never arrives) at length N, the dialog is closed and reopened, the first page again has N items
effect: Automatic next-page look after layout is refused (Asked::allow sees the same length) so a first page that does not fill the view never loads more; only a scroll does. story_insights_ui resets its Asked on open; these four never call reset
fix: Reset each Asked when its dialog opens, or key it by the list's generation

title: Thread-local RefCell borrow_mut in measure and paint paths
trigger: Layout measure / paint of message text
effect: `CACHE.with(|c| c.borrow_mut())` is reached from layout measure and draw; nothing re-enters today (lay_out runs outside the borrow) but panic-safety rule 6 asks for try_borrow_mut with early return in paint paths
fix: try_borrow_mut with a fall-back to laying out without caching

title: Passcode box mode is open + view + error + three fields reset by hand
trigger: Open, navigate, close or Lock now from the Settings passcode box
effect: open_passcode, close_passcode and goto_passcode_view each reset a different subset of open, view, error and the old/new/confirm inputs; DialogSpec reads `open` while the view decides the title and form
fix: Option<PasscodeBox{view, error}> with the inputs reset on construction

title: system_unlock and system_unlock_key must change together, set by hand at five sites
trigger: Turn system unlock on/off, lock, unlock, Turn off passcode, lock-screen Log out
effect: system_unlock_key is Some only while system_unlock is on: set in lock_by_passcode, unlock_done and set_system_unlock, cleared in set_system_unlock, submit_remove_passcode and confirm_lock_logout_in
fix: enum SystemUnlock{Off, On{held_key: Option<MasterKey>}}

title: Lock flag is held twice: PasscodeUi::lock_state and the LockGate global
trigger: Lock or unlock
effect: set_locked writes PasscodeUi::lock_state and publishes LockGate{locked} in lock_layer; two copies kept in step by one writer (and a test-only force_locked that skips the global)
fix: Read the global only (or derive PasscodeUi's from it)

title: MenuSync uses registry_read: Option<Instant> as a 'read yet' flag beside registry and read_at
trigger: Menu sync task's first pass and each re-read
effect: registry, registry_read and read_at must change together (set_registry); None means nothing read yet and the default Registry stands in for it
fix: enum RegistryRead{Never, Read{registry, at, writes, clients}}

title: Message-media edit render lands by (chat, message) of the pending edit, not by a render id
trigger: Press Done in the photo editor of a message edit, cancel the edit and enter edit of the same message again (or press Done twice) before the first render finishes
effect: The stale render's PNG is applied as the replacement photo of the new edit session, or the second render overwrites the first; the user sees a photo they did not choose
fix: A `Rendering { id }` stage of the message edit's media (the NEXT_RENDER number), applied only when the id still matches

title: Profile crop render continuation does not check the photo target is still open before applying (other photo paths do)
trigger: Press Set Photo in the profile crop; close the Edit Profile dialog before the off-thread render ends
effect: For the own-profile target the photo is still sent after the dialog that asked closed; for other targets the answer relies on take_chosen_photo's own check
fix: Carry the target's owner key in a stage and apply only while photo_target() still equals it, as paste_photo_from_clipboard does

title: Per-track data of the active track is six fields cleared by hand (skip 08-039 reason is 'works today')
trigger: Start a voice note or song, then stop it or close the bar
effect: active, track_length, seek_slider, scrub, seek_hover, player.chat, player.meta and player.sliders must be set in begin_track_playback/note_track_started and cleared in clear_playback_state + release_player_chat; a missed writer leaves a bar with no track or a stale slider
fix: `Option<ActiveTrackState { kind, ChatMessage, length, meta, slider, scrub, hover }>` on PlaybackUi, replaced whole at start and stop

title: GifDecode::first (Option) and cancel (AtomicBool) restate the stage GifPlayback::{Waiting, Playing} holds, in a second map
trigger: Play a GIF, stop it, play it again while its decode still runs
effect: The decode registry (gif_decodes, keyed by ChatMessage) and `animation` are two sources of 'first picture is in / cancelled'; spawn_gif_decode reads one and writes the other by hand
fix: One `GifPlayback` stage per GIF carrying the decode's cancel handle and first clip

title: Search debounces are a u64 keystroke counter plus a detached timer task, not a stage holding the Task
trigger: Type in the GIF or emoji-pack search, then close the panel or switch account
effect: The timer task is detach()ed and only the counter says whether it still counts; nothing cancels it when the panel closes, it just wakes and finds the counter moved
fix: `Debounce { Idle, Waiting { query, _task: Task } }` held in PickerUi so a new keystroke or close drops the timer

title: Playlist reorder is applied by row index (PlaylistDrag::index, from/to), not by track file id
trigger: Start dragging a track of your own playlist, an update adds or moves a track (another device), drop on a row
effect: move_profile_audio_track(from, to) moves the track that now sits at the old index, not the one dragged
fix: Carry the dragged track's FileId and resolve both indexes at drop time

title: Poll box rows are parallel Vecs kept in step by hand: option_inputs, attach and quiz_correct_rows (indexes)
trigger: Add and remove option rows, mark correct answers, attach media
effect: add_poll_option_row pushes two Vecs, remove_poll_option_row removes from two and fixes the third with forget_correct_row (guarded by `index < attach.len()`); a writer that misses one shifts media or marks onto the wrong option
fix: `Vec<PollOptionRow { input, attach, correct: bool }>`

title: Poll box 'switch + value' pairs are a bool beside the value it enables, reset by hand: limit_duration/close and limit_by_country/country_codes
trigger: Turn Limit Duration or Limit by Country on, pick a value, turn it off and on
effect: limit_by_country=false clears country_codes and leaves the page by hand (line ~333); limit_duration=false keeps `close`; submit re-checks `limit_by_country && country_codes.is_empty()` to catch the invalid pair
fix: `Option<PollClose>` and `Option<Vec<String>>` (None = off)

title: AwaitSticker / AwaitEmoji on a poll option slot are not tied to the media panel that serves them; closing the panel leaves the prompt
trigger: Poll box: choose Sticker or the smiley on an option, close the media panel with Esc or a click outside
effect: The option keeps showing 'Choose a sticker in the panel' with a Cancel button, and a later panel open (poll_emoji_field / route_poll_option_sticker only check media_panel.is_open()) routes the next pick into that option
fix: One `awaiting: Option<(slot id, Await)>` owned by the panel's stage, cleared by the panel's own close

title: Poll option file read is answered by matching OptionMediaSlot::Preparing(path) text, not the slot id or a request id
trigger: Pick the same file for two options, or re-pick the file after removing it while the first read runs
effect: finish_poll_option_file takes the first slot whose Preparing(path) equals the answer's path; a second read of the same path can land in the wrong slot or be dropped
fix: `Preparing { request: RequestId }` (or the OptionAttach::id) compared when the read answers

title: Confirming Unpin clears the window's whole forward stage, even when the unpin is from the message menu and the forward is unrelated
trigger: Build a forward (messages ticked, or the forward bar above a composer), right-click a pinned message, Unpin, OK
effect: share.forward is set to ForwardStage::None: the ticked messages or the pending forward bar are lost
fix: Clear the forward only when the unpin came from that selection (selection_bar), by passing the origin to confirm_unpin

title: Premium sticker paint notes (SEEN) are process-global and keyed by bare (chat_id, message_id), unlike PLAYED which has an account
trigger: Open the same shared group in account A, switch to B within 1.5 s
effect: anchor()/premium_autoplay read A's fresh note for B's key, so B's sticker can autoplay at A's bounds once; SEEN is pruned only while a chat is viewed
fix: Key the notes by owner (AccountChat) or hold them in OnScreen

title: render(): `width - x.min(width - 1)` and the same for height underflow when the working image has width or height 0
trigger: Edit a photo whose decode yields a zero-size image (the attachment path has no zero check, the profile path does)
effect: u32 underflow: panic in debug, a huge crop size in release
fix: Return the image unchanged when width or height is 0, or use saturating_sub

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut inside a paint closure (tracker) and in premium_autoplay on thread_local cells
trigger: Any history paint with a Premium sticker
effect: panic-safety rule 6 asks for try_borrow_mut in paint closures; SEEN.borrow_mut() is nested with PLAYED.borrow() in one closure
fix: try_borrow_mut with early return

title: One-shot `Rc<RefCell<Option<_>>>` body cell uses borrow_mut().take() in dialog content closures (same pattern: polls/mod.rs:567, premium_ui/mod.rs:257 and 455, premium_ui/open_premium.rs:123, premium_ui/grams.rs:259, premium_ui/grams_withdraw.rs:241)
trigger: Open any of these dialogs; the content closure runs again while the cell is borrowed
effect: Short borrows with no call out while held, so low risk, but they are non-test borrow_mut calls the panic-safety page lists
fix: Use try_borrow_mut, or a Cell<Option<_>> taken with take()

title: Item drag is two values: PhotoEditor::selected (index) and Gesture::Item(ItemDrag), which does not name the item
trigger: Drag a sticker, then Delete or an undo changes the list while the pointer is down
effect: drag_item reads selected and the gesture separately; delete_selected clears selected but not the gesture; indexes shift when placed changes
fix: `Gesture::Item { index, drag }`

title: Rotate and Flip change six derived fields by hand (placed, orientation, preview, crop, strokes, and the gesture is left)
trigger: Rotate or Flip with a gesture or selection active
effect: rotate() and flip() must rebuild placed, orientation, preview, crop and strokes together; the pending gesture and selected index are not reset
fix: One `Edit` value with a single `turn(Quarter|Flip)` that returns the new whole

title: WithdrawOutcome::Url / TooSmall is a one-shot slot drained only by a per-window upkeep gated on the Collect dialog's host window
trigger: Press Collect from a chat window or while the dialog's host entry has moved, close that window before the answer
effect: grams.withdraw_outcome stays set (the Fragment page never opens, no toast) until some window whose dialog_may_show_in(GramsWithdraw) runs the upkeep, which can be much later
fix: Make the outcome part of the GramWithdraw stage (Done(Url|TooSmall)) so the box that asked consumes it, or drop it with the box

title: Premium limit toast is a one-shot hub slot taken only by the window of the last press
trigger: A full saved-GIF or sticker list limit hit by an action that is not a press (a paste or a background update)
effect: hub.take_limit_toast() is only reached when windows.pressed_here(); the toast stays queued in the session, also across an account switch away and back, and shows at an unrelated later press
fix: Carry the asking window in the slot, and clear it with the account's Farewell

title: Selecting a gift resets a second machine by hand: gift_manage.flow (Upgrade/Resale {id}) and hub.gift_view.selected both name the gift
trigger: Open a gift, start Upgrade, go back and select another gift
effect: select_gift() clears GiftFlow with take_if on a different id and also confirm_convert(None); another path that selects a gift without select_gift keeps the old flow and hides the buttons
fix: One gift-panel value `GiftPanel { gift, flow }`

title: Mute is volume < 0.01 with a stashed unmuted_volume; the two f32 fields change together by hand
trigger: Drag the volume to 0, then click the mute button
effect: muted is derived in player_bar.rs:542 from volume, while the unmute click restores unmuted_volume, which can be stale or equal to 0
fix: `Volume { Level(f32), Muted { restore: f32 } }`

title: Quick replies watch poll never ends when the shortcut id never resolves, and runs while locked
trigger: In Quick Replies add a new shortcut name, type a message and Add; the server refuses (or never reports the shortcut). Leave the box open, or lock the app.
effect: quick_replies_pump returns false at `let Some(shortcut_id) = resolved else { return false }`, so the 200 ms watch task loops until the box is closed, also behind the lock screen (no refused_while_locked check). Wasted wakeups; no redraw.
fix: Watch stage in the dialog (Idle/Waiting{since}) that ends on settle or refusal; or stop the poll when the save is answered with no shortcut and when locked

title: Quick reply save answer matched by the session-wide error, not by the request held in TextSave::Sending
trigger: Add a message to a shortcut while an unrelated quick-reply error (failed delete, failed shortcuts load) is showing; or the save request is dropped with the connection.
effect: settle_quick_reply_save reads `settings.quick_replies.error.is_some()` for 'refused': a save that succeeded puts its text back in the field (resubmit duplicates the message); a request that left flight with no answer counts as accepted and the text is lost. The RequestId in TextSave::Sending is only checked for 'still in flight'.
fix: Answer keyed by the RequestId in the stage (an Answered/Refused(reason) outcome per request, like SaveWatch), not a shared error slot; pane.error and session error folded into one

title: ShowStage::Saving(RequestId) never compares its request; the box settles on the privacy key's state
trigger: Tap Show My Last Seen while another save of the Last seen rule (or an older SaveFailed) is in the key state.
effect: drain_show_or_premium matches `Saving(_)` and then reads `settings.privacy[ShowStatus]` / `read_date`: an unrelated save's refusal toasts 'failed' for this request, and Ready from an older answer toasts 'shown' before this request is answered. The id held in the stage is dead data.
fix: Settle on the RequestId in the stage (answer/error for that request), as profile saves do with SaveWatch

title: DeleteStep is a two-variant Idle/Asked confirm that survives other actions; the delete itself has no stage
trigger: Open a shortcut with messages, press Delete (label turns into 'Delete with all messages'), then add or edit a message and press the same button.
effect: ShortcutPane::delete stays Asked until quick_replies_go replaces the pane, so any later press deletes the shortcut; the delete request is fire-and-forget and the dialog goes to the list whether or not TDLib refuses.
fix: One pane stage enum (Editing/ConfirmDelete/Deleting{request}) cleared by every other action

title: ProxyUi::notice is a one-shot slot that only fetch_proxy_list clears
trigger: Copy a proxy link ('copied' notice), then enable, delete or ping proxies on the same page without reopening it.
effect: The notice line stays under the list through unrelated actions and is overwritten by seven sites (mod.rs:399,441,444,468,499,600; proxy_row.rs:194); only fetch_proxy_list (opening the list) sets it None.
fix: A Toast/StatusNote with its own expiry, or a notice stage cleared on the next action

title: delete_proxy_entry flips use_system and persists prefs before the removal is sent
trigger: Delete the enabled proxy while the connection to TDLib is down (removeProxy fails to send).
effect: prefs.use_system = true and save_proxy_prefs run first; remove_proxy's Err is dropped by `let _`, so the saved preference no longer matches the proxy that is still enabled and no error shows.
fix: Set the fallback in the answer to the removal (keyed by its RequestId), or undo it when the send fails

title: The link box's stage (link_check) and the auto-switch rotation are reset by hand from UI code
trigger: Open a tg://proxy link, press Check, cancel, open another link; or change the auto-switch seconds while a rotation is running.
effect: link_check is set to Review/Warn from handle_proxy_link, close_proxy_link, reset_link_check, connect_link_proxy and check_link_proxy (UI), while the box value lives in ProxyUi::link and the answer is matched by Checking(request); set_proxy_auto_switch writes Rotation::Watching from the UI. A stage reset from outside its own transitions.
fix: Fold ProxyLinkBox and link_check into one stage owned in one place (Review/Warn/Checking{request}/Done), and let the rotation reset itself on a prefs change

title: ProxyUi::list_box bool is kept in step with pane_mode by a per-frame sync
trigger: Open Proxy settings from the sign-in screen, let the account reach Ready.
effect: list_box is a bool whose truth is `list_box && pane_mode()==Connecting`; sync_proxy_list_box clears it by hand each frame, and open_proxy_list sets it and opens the DialogKind separately.
fix: Derive the box from pane_mode (a PaneMode::Connecting overlay stage) or hold it in the sign-in screen's own state

title: dismiss_password_check ignores a failed send, resets the card by hand and leaves the suggestion
trigger: Press Dismiss or Done on the password check card while TDLib cannot take the request.
effect: hide_check_password_suggestion's Err is dropped (`let _`); the UI then writes password_check = Idle straight into the session, but check_password_suggested is only cleared on a successful send, so the card stays and nothing is said.
fix: Let the driver own the reset (set Idle only when the send went out) and show the error

title: Edit-profile errors live in a shared session slot cleared by hand at eight call sites, beside the dialog's own Submit::Failed
trigger: Fail a username change, then press Check or Save without reopening; fail a photo set, then change a name.
effect: users_state.profile_edit_error is set to None by hand in open_edit_profile_dialog, check_profile_username, submit_profile_username, move_profile_username, toggle_profile_username, remove_profile_photo, save_profile_form and send_profile_photo; the dialog shows `error.or(refused)` from two holders (profile_edit_error and dialog.save Failed). One operation's error can be shown for another.
fix: One per-operation stage (Submit per section keyed by RequestId) in the dialog; the session keeps no error slot

title: open_profile_dialog and open_birthday_privacy replace a Saving box without forgetting its request
trigger: Edit contact, press Save (box waits), then click Set / Suggest photo in the same box, or in the Birthday box click 'Choose who can see your birthday' while Saving.
effect: dialogs.profile_dialog is overwritten (open_profile_dialog:43, open_birthday_privacy:164) while ProfileDialog::Saving or ContactSave::Saving holds a request: forget_profile_saving is skipped, the saved toast and a refusal are lost, and an EditContact answer stays in dialog_answers (bounded). The body of a Saving box still has live rows. Two stage mechanisms (ProfileDialog::Saving and ContactSave::Saving) do the same job.
fix: One saving stage for every profile box, and replacing a box goes through close_profile_dialog; disable the body while Saving

title: ModalFade::Closing names a 110 ms close timer that is detach()ed and matched by target
trigger: Open a profile modal, close it, reopen the same profile within 110 ms and close it again.
effect: The close spawns a detached spawn_screen timer; the stage holds no Task, and the timer does take_if(is_closing && same target), so the first timer ends the second fade early (and a modal reopened and closing again loses its fade).
fix: Hold the timer Task in ModalFade::Closing (dropped on replace) instead of detaching it

title: PhotoSources keeps mode, camera stage, emoji editor, note and serial in step by hand; camera tasks are detached and matched by serial
trigger: Open the camera panel, lock the app; open the emoji editor, then lock.
effect: close_photo_source and close_cameras_for_lock each reset mode, camera, serial (and note/editor in one of them) by hand; CameraStage::Starting and Saving hold no task (start_camera / take_camera_photo spawn detach()ed tasks and compare photo_target + serial). The lock path leaves the emoji editor and note as they were.
fix: One PhotoSources stage enum (Closed/Emoji{..}/Camera(CameraStage)) with the task held in Starting/Saving and one close()

title: GradientEditor::hsl duplicates colors[selected] and is synced by hand
trigger: Edit a color by hex, then move a slider; select another swatch.
effect: hsl is written in editor_sync_controls and editor_slider_moved while colors/selected are written in four other places; if one path misses it the sliders and the swatch disagree.
fix: Derive hsl from colors[selected] when drawn, with the slider drag value as the only extra

title: SLIDE is a process-wide thread_local one-shot slot keyed by a bare ChatId
trigger: Pull to the next channel, then switch account or window within 480 ms.
effect: SLIDE holds (ChatId, topic, Instant) for the whole process, not per account or window: a private chat id is the user id, so the same id on another account (or the other main window) can slide in; it is cleared only when a render finds it shown or expired.
fix: A field on the history view (Option<Slide> in PullUi), owned and replaced with it

title: PullMachine's jumping stage, Route::Jumping and PullUi::window are set and cleared by hand in step
trigger: Release a ready pull, close the chat window or lock before the jump ends.
effect: pull_release begins machine.begin_jump and then sets route = Jumping (two places), pull_jump_ended and pull_sync reset machine and route separately; the window handle is never cleared, so if cx.update_window fails (window closed) the task ends without pull_jump_ended and machine.jumping() holds the indicator full.
fix: One jump stage (Pulling/Jumping{next,window,task}) whose Drop or end leaves the machine

title: start_personal_photo matches the box under the file picker by mem::discriminant, not by the box
trigger: Press Set photo in Edit contact, and while the picker is open (non-modal portal) open Edit contact of another person.
effect: `under` and `now` are discriminants of ProfileDialog: any EditContact matches any other, so the confirm opens over a different box than the one that asked.
fix: Compare the box's owner key (user_id) or a request token held in the stage

title: A user's pending gallery has no end when its fetch is dropped without an answer
trigger: Click a user's avatar when the profile photos request is lost (connection reset).
effect: pump_profile_gallery ends a pending Chat gallery on chat_photo_request_ended but a User gallery only on ProfilePhotosFetch::Failed, so a dropped request leaves pending_profile_gallery set with no note until the user navigates; a late arrival then opens the viewer over whatever is still on screen.
fix: Carry the fetch's RequestId in PendingGallery and end it when that request leaves flight

title: edit_exception / edit_exception_chat close the picker even when the edit was ignored
trigger: Add a user to an exception list while the rule is Loading or Failed (not Ready).
effect: mutate_privacy_detail returns silently without a Ready detail, but `if add { close_exception_picker() }` runs anyway, so the picker closes and nothing is saved or said.
fix: Close the picker from the save's own outcome (mutate returns whether it sent)

title: Send stops the record preview only after taking the capture, so the preview keeps playing
trigger: Pause a voice recording, press the preview Play, then press Send (also the story-reply Send, story_viewer/reply_media.rs:521)
effect: The preview audio keeps playing to its end after the message is sent; nothing ends it because the preview clock went with the capture and check_record_preview no longer sees it
fix: stop_record_preview must run before take_voice, or take_voice returns the preview so the caller stops the player

title: PermissionAsk stays Asking when the asking window closes before the prompt is answered
trigger: On macOS press record in a chat window while the camera or microphone prompt is up, close that chat window; the scoped task's update returns Gone and never sets Idle
effect: Later presses that still find the device undetermined return silently at the Asking check until restart; the answer of the ask is never read
fix: Reset PermissionAsk in the window's closing path (or hold the wait Task in the Asking variant so dropping it ends the ask)

title: PermissionAsk Idle/Asking is a two-variant stage kept beside CaptureStart for one press
trigger: Record press that needs a device prompt: PermissionAsk::Asking, then CaptureStart::Opening, then capture
effect: Two enums and a hand-run continuation (capture_access.rs) describe one start; each is reset by its own call sites
fix: One start stage enum: Idle, Asking{id,call,task}, Opening{start,..}

title: SchedulePicker::send_after and send_effect change together
trigger: Open the picker from the Schedule shortcut or the Send with Effect card
effect: send_effect is only meaningful when send_after is set, and both are written together by the caller; a picker opened any other way carries a bool and an effect that mean nothing
fix: enum OnConfirm { Keep, SendNow { effect: i64 } }

title: ChatUi::scheduled_dialog_open bool is swapped with schedule_picker by hand
trigger: Scheduled list, Reschedule (dialog flag cleared, picker opened, dialog closed), then Cancel the picker (close_schedule_picker reopens the list)
effect: Two boxes of one flow are a bool plus an Option kept in step at six call sites (lines 571, 703, 795, 806, 293-300); a missed site leaves both or neither open
fix: One enum ScheduleFlow { Closed, List, Picking(SchedulePicker) } on ChatUi

title: OpenChooser::window Option is the stage 'window being made'
trigger: Press Share Screen: Chooser::Open{window: None} until cx.defer opens the window, then Some
effect: open_screen_chooser comments 'without a window yet, it is being made'; screen_chooser_closed while None relies on the open_mut() None arm to remove the new window; the stage is an Option, not a variant
fix: Chooser::Opening{..} vs Chooser::Open{window,..}

title: demo_active and demo_active_audio are two fields written together
trigger: Demo/test accept or stop of a share (screen_chooser.rs:529, 548)
effect: The audio flag is only valid while demo_active is Some; stop clears both by hand
fix: Option<DemoShare { source, with_audio }>

title: The chat search field's text means a message query or a member filter depending on from_picker, and is cleared by hand at call sites
trigger: Open the From: picker, type a name, then change chat (session closes the chat search) or close the picker another way
effect: The field keeps the member filter text; open_chat_search_ui clears it only when 'fresh', chat_search_pick_sender and toggle_chat_search_picker clear it by hand, other closers do not
fix: Own the field's mode in the chat-search stage (Query | PickingSender) and clear text on its transitions

title: Global search debounce names a token while its timer Task is detached
trigger: Type in the global search field
effect: The debounce stage lives in the driver (Debounced{token}); the UI timer is spawn_screen(...).detach() matched by token only, so the Task is not held by the stage and cannot be cancelled by it
fix: Hold the commit Task in the debounce stage (dropped on query change, close, account switch)

title: In-chat search debounce names a token while its timer Task is detached
trigger: Type in the Search in chat field
effect: Same as the global one: ChatSearchQueryOutcome::Debounced{token} with a detached timer matched by token
fix: Hold the commit Task in the chat-search stage

title: PasteNotice::Showing names a 9 s timer whose Task is detached
trigger: Paste markdown into the composer, then close the window or switch chat before 9 s
effect: The Showing stage is matched by its own `at`, but the timer Task is .detach()ed outside the stage; if the window closes the task is dropped and Showing stays until the next field change
fix: Showing { at, field, timer: Task<()> }

title: refresh_sessions resets Fetch and sessions_op by hand from the page
trigger: Devices page, press Refresh while the list is loading or a terminate is in flight
effect: Writes Fetch::Idle straight into the session (blanking the list to 'No session data yet') and calls sessions_op.refetched(); maybe_fetch bails while a GetActiveSessions request is in flight, so the list stays blank until that answer, and a failed answer leaves it empty
fix: A driver method that marks the list Stale (keeping data) and refetches, instead of dropping the Fetch

title: wanted_reactor_tab is a one-shot slot reset by hand when a message menu opens
trigger: Open a chip's menu that asks a reactor tab, close it before the properties arrive, open another menu
effect: The slot (session.messages.wanted_reactor_tab) is cleared from open_message_menu and taken in connect/message_menu.rs; nothing else clears it (chat or account change keeps it until the next menu)
fix: Store the wanted tab in the open menu (OpenMenu) so it dies with the menu

title: Quote picker (ChatUi reply bar) and reply chooser (ShareStage::ReplyChooser) are mutually exclusive by hand
trigger: Reply options: Update Quote then Reply in Another Chat, or the reverse
effect: open_reply_elsewhere closes the quote picker, apply_reply_option(UpdateQuote) closes the chooser, close_reply_panels closes both; two owners (ChatUi and share) coordinated at call sites
fix: One ReplyPanel enum on the reply bar: None | QuotePicker | Chooser

title: RequestShare kind and stage are two values with invalid pairs
trigger: Location request opened while the agent guard refuses the lookup (locate_for_request returns early), or a Phone request
effect: Phone lives in Picking forever; Location in Picking shows 'Locating' with the confirm disabled and no retry; Locating/Located only make sense for Location and Picking/Confirm only for Users/Chat
fix: Fold into one enum per kind: Phone, Location(LocateStage), Users(Pick), Chat(Pick)

title: Round video seek ends only through a mouse-up handler registered while the overlay paints
trigger: Drag the seek ring of a paused round video, scroll it out of view or change chat before releasing the button
effect: Audio::Seeking{was_playing} stays set and the player stays paused; the end_seek handler exists only for frames that paint this overlay
fix: End a seek from a window-level mouse-up owned by the stage, or drop Seeking when the overlay unmounts

title: assert! in the ready-search-in-chat demo seeder
trigger: Demo capture of search in chat when the demo session has no open chat
effect: apply_ready_search_in_chat panics on assert!(session.open_chat_search()) in non-test code
fix: Return early when open_chat_search is false

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut of RecordingUi::round_preview in render
trigger: Render of the round record overlay while end_capture_flags or another borrower holds the cell
effect: borrow_mut can panic if the cell is held; end_capture_flags uses try_borrow_mut and silently skips end() so the old image would leak into the next recording
fix: Make RoundPreview a plain field with &mut access, owned by the Capture

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut on RichPreview::parsed with a nested borrow_mut of RichDraftUi::parsed
trigger: Render of the rich editor preview
effect: parsed.borrow_mut() is held while editor.borrow_mut().parse() runs; a re-entrant call would panic
fix: Hold the parse state as plain fields on RichDraftUi, updated by &mut self

title: Delete-confirmation stage is reset by hand from inside the list dialog's render builder
trigger: Delete a passkey; the confirm dialog's predicate turns false when the passkey leaves the list, and only building the Passkeys list dialog calls dismiss_confirm()
effect: Stage change happens during render; if the list dialog is not the one built (About over list, ceremony) the screen stays ConfirmDelete(id) for a gone passkey
fix: Reset in the answer path (finish_remove drain) so screen leaves ConfirmDelete when the passkey is removed; render stays pure

title: CeremonyRun::Live::focus_pin is a one-shot bool kept in step with sheet == Pin by ask_pin/show
trigger: PIN sheet opens; ask_pin sets sheet and focus_pin together; take_focus_pin clears it on the next tick
effect: None today; two fields change together
fix: Fold into CeremonySheet::Pin { invalid, focus: Ask/Done } or a Pin stage that owns the focus ask

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut in the one-shot content cell (same pattern in websites_dialog.rs:148, send_box_options.rs:517, settings_ui.rs:239)
trigger: Dialog content closure runs
effect: borrow_mut is short and guarded by take(); a re-entrant call would panic only if content ran inside itself; second call renders an empty div
fix: Pass the body through an FnOnce-capable kit API or Cell<Option<_>>::take

title: refresh_websites writes Fetch::Idle and clears the stale mark over an in-flight connected-websites fetch
trigger: Open Connected Websites, press Refresh while the first fetch is loading (or right after a disconnect that marked the list stale)
effect: Dialog flips to 'No website data yet' while the old request is still out; refetched() drops the stale mark so an answer that predates the disconnect is shown as current; if the send then fails the list is gone and no error
fix: Do not overwrite a Loading fetch; ask Fetch::refresh() that keeps the data and only re-marks stale when the send is refused

title: Two-step recovery actions send with `let _` and close their confirmation first, so a refused send says nothing
trigger: Forgot password: Send code / Reset / Cancel reset / Abort recovery email / resend login email code when the driver refuses (offline, no chats path)
effect: Confirmation closes and nothing happens; no note or notice, button looks dead (also lines 292, 357, 384, 602)
fix: Return the send result and set the local notice on Err as the submit_* functions do

title: WindowSelected.message, .emoji and .start are only ever set, never cleared when the selection clears or its text stops painting
trigger: Select text in message A, then select text in a SelectableRichText with no message key (or scroll A away) and press Cmd+C
effect: selected_message_text returns A's message key, so refuse_protected_copy and the quote nth use the wrong chat/message; stale emoji fallbacks of unmounted paragraphs stay until the window closes
fix: Clear the record when TextSelection has no selection; key it with the selection run, not the last painted message

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut in paint: SELECTED and OWNERS thread-locals (also selection_bar.rs:25, selection_mode.rs:51 and 83 in render, selection_drag.rs:398, send_fly.rs CELLS/SOURCE/FLY)
trigger: Any paint/render that re-enters the same cell
effect: Each borrow is short and closure-local, so no panic today; panic-safety rule 6 asks try_borrow_mut in paint
fix: try_borrow_mut with early return in paint closures

title: tray_photo_size holds photo_sizes.borrow_mut() across a file-header read on the render thread
trigger: A photo joins the tray; the options row renders and reads image_dimensions from disk inside or_insert_with
effect: Disk IO on the UI thread per new photo (slow or network path stalls a frame); long-held borrow across a call into another module
fix: Read the size in the media-check worker (check_photo already opens it) and store it in MediaCheck

title: baseline: DragSelect::pending is a bool snapshot of the pressed row's send stage
trigger: Press a row that is still being sent, release without drag in selection mode
effect: None today: read once on release (toggle_forward_select); a message that finished sending meanwhile is judged by the press-time flag
fix: Re-read the message stage at release (drop the field) or carry a MessageStage copy

title: Save Selected has no one-picker-at-a-time guard and its picker task is detached
trigger: Click Save in the selection bar twice before the folder dialog answers, or switch account while the copy runs
effect: Two folder pickers can open and the media is copied twice (HTML save has HtmlSave::Picking for this); the 'Saved N files' note lands on whichever account is on screen
fix: SaveSelection { Idle, Picking(Task), Copying(Task) } in ChatUi like HtmlSave

title: chat_ui.pending_delete is a parameter handed to confirm_delete through state, set then taken in the same call
trigger: Confirm the single-message delete box
effect: None today; an Option slot written and immediately take()n at composer/copy_inline_text.rs:455; a failed early return would leave it set
fix: Pass the DeleteConfirm as an argument to confirm_delete

title: delete_selection clears the selection even when delete_messages reports the send was refused
trigger: Select messages, Delete, confirm while the driver refuses the request
effect: Error note shows but the selection is gone, so the user must reselect to retry
fix: Clear the selection only when delete_messages returned true

title: The video sound-track read has no give-up timer, unlike the thumbnail and media reads
trigger: Attach a video whose ffprobe hangs or whose worker dies
effect: tray_videos_checking stays true, Send answers 'Checking the video, send again' forever until the file is removed
fix: Add the GIVE_UP_AFTER settle (as send_box_thumbnails.rs) so Reading { job } always has a way out

title: Read stages hold only a job number while their timer and worker tasks are detach()ed (also send_box_thumbnails.rs:53-80, send_box_options.rs:134)
trigger: Attach a file, then remove it or let the timer fire first
effect: Late worker results are dropped by the job check, but a written scratch JPEG/thumbnail is never removed; nothing cancels the work
fix: Reading { job, worker: Task, timer: Task } so dropping the stage cancels both

title: Preview::playing is a Cell<Option<Instant>> used as a 'restarted' flag set during paint; hiding is an Option beside shown
trigger: Choose an effect: the card paints, sets playing once and restarts the sticker player
effect: None today; started flag written in render, and hiding/leaving are two Options kept in step by choose_send_effect/hide_effect_preview
fix: Preview { Showing{since, played}, Hiding{since} } with one transition fn

title: Sticker flight stage is process-wide thread-locals (FLY, SOURCE, TARGET, ORIGIN) with a bare chat id, not owned by an account or window slot
trigger: Send a sticker, then switch account or lock within 2 s
effect: FLY, SOURCE and TARGET are not dropped by the account farewell or lock; Fly.started is an Option stage; SOURCE stays set if the send is refused and a later send of the same file takes it
fix: Per-window FlightStage { None, Armed{..}, Flying{..} } in the WindowSlot/OnScreen with a Farewell that clears it

title: System accent read is SystemAccent{Unread,Read} plus a separate system_accent_poll Option<Task>: the 'reading' stage is two fields
trigger: Open Appearance on Linux while the accent read is pending
effect: None today; Unread + poll Some means Reading, Unread + None means not asked or failed, kept in step in appearance_power.rs:121-137
fix: SystemAccent { Unread, Reading(Task), Read(Option<u32>) }

title: update_banner_dismissed is a bool beside update_state, reset by hand in updates.rs:36 and set in updates.rs:602
trigger: Dismiss the update banner, then a new update state arrives
effect: Stays dismissed until the one place that resets it runs; not tied to the UpdateState it dismissed
fix: Carry dismissal in the UpdateState variant (Ready{dismissed}) or key it by the version it dismissed

title: Settings navigation is three fields kept in step by hand: open, page, sub
trigger: open Settings, go to Advanced > Experimental, close Settings or press back on a narrow window
effect: no bug today: close_settings, settings_back, show_settings_sub and open_settings each write open/page/sub together (sub must equal a child of page; page None means Account on wide and the list on narrow); advanced_ui.rs:315 demo writes page and sub by hand; {open:false, page:Some, sub:Some} and {sub:Some(x), page:other} are representable
fix: one SettingsView { Closed, List, Page(Page), Sub(SubPage) } with transitions on it; leave/arrive hooks run from the transition

title: Arrival::Seeking waits for its row with no way out except leaving the page
trigger: search for a setting whose row is absent now (a conditional row such as the phone suggestion, or an entry whose stand-in is not drawn), then stay on the page until the row appears later
effect: the arrival stays Seeking for as long as the page stays; when the row finally shows up the page scrolls to centre it and washes it, a jump the user did not ask for
fix: Stage::Seeking carries the time it started (Instant) and settle_arrival drops the arrival after TOTAL, as Washing does

title: Notifications page render re-asks for the exceptions list after a failed send
trigger: open Notifications while the client's sender is closed or failing (connection closing): maybe_fetch_notification_exceptions begins the Fetch, the send fails, and the code removes the map entry instead of marking Failed
effect: every render of the page builds and tries a new getChatNotificationSettingsExceptions request per scope, and the list flickers Loading/absent; only a send failure causes it (a refused answer ends Failed and asks nothing). The same shape is in fetch_installed_backgrounds (cancel to Idle) called from the Appearance page render in pages.rs:99
fix: a failed send ends the Fetch as Failed (with the not-sent line) so render asks only from Idle and Retry is the way out

title: Activity chat filter stays on a chat whose entries are gone while its button reads the default
trigger: filter Activity by chat C, leave the page and come back (filter is not reset by leave_agent_page), or let the log rotate C's entries out
effect: the chat button shows the default label (it is looked up among the log's distinct chats) but the filter still applies, so the list says no activity matches until the user picks All
fix: reset_activity from leave_agent_page and drop a filter value the log no longer holds when the filters are built

title: The share box's ticked chats and typed text live beside the forward stage and are cleared by hand at each exit
trigger: open the share box (ForwardStage::Picking), tick chats and type a comment, then let dismiss_forward_for_view (chat switch) or delete_selection set the stage to None
effect: no bug today: selection, comment_input and search_input keep the old box's ticks and text until open_forward_picker clears them; submit_share, share_continue_in_chat, close_forward_picker, end_selection, show_forward_bar and routing.rs each clear a different subset by hand
fix: ForwardStage::Picking carries the ShareSelection and the box clears the two inputs when its stage is made, so leaving the stage drops them

title: The forward result banner is a one-shot slot with no owner key and no exit but Dismiss or Esc
trigger: forward messages from chat A (the banner shows above A's composer), then switch the window to chat B
effect: B's composer shows 'Forwarded ...' until the user dismisses it; present_forward_result also sets a note, so the banner is a second copy that outlives the chat it was about
fix: hold the result with the chat it is for (ForwardNotice { chat, result }) and show it only there, or drop it in sync_chat_ui

title: PhoneLookups { Idle, Asked } is the old asked flag beside the real stages (countries Fetch, guessed_country_iso)
trigger: Open the phone screen; getCountryCode fails or returns nothing. sync_signin runs every frame and resets the enum to Idle by hand whenever auth is not WaitPhoneNumber.
effect: No visible bug today, but the enum is the only thing stopping a per-frame resend: fetch_countries already dedupes through Fetch (connect/auth.rs:105) while fetch_country_code has no failure memory (guessed_country_iso is a bare Option), so the failed IP default is never retried until the screen is left and the Asked flag is reset from render.
fix: Make the IP guess a Fetch<String> next to countries (idle/loading/ready/failed) and delete PhoneLookups and the per-frame reset

title: PhoneStep::Sending is resolved by purpose (has_auth_submit, any last_auth_error) not by the RequestId of submit_phone
trigger: On the code step press Wrong number?, send a new number (auth_ui.rs:109 drops the RequestId with Ok(_)). While it is in flight another auth submit settles or fails (resend code, QR, email reset all count in is_auth_submit), or the request is lost with no answer.
effect: A foreign auth error counts as the rejection of the phone (back to the old number), a foreign auth request keeps the stage waiting, and a request dropped without an error is promoted to CodeSentTo(phone) although TDLib never accepted the number.
fix: Sending { request: RequestId, phone, back } resolved only by the answer to that id (accepted, rejected, or lost -> back)

title: Host::Asked ends by 'no request in flight at all', not by the request that asked
trigger: A window asks for a session-wide box (open_box_in inserts Host::Asked(window), dialog_hosts.rs:205) before the answer that sets its flag; that request fails or is cancelled while any unrelated request (download, poll, other ask) is still pending, or the session is a demo.
effect: The ask is only expired in sync_host_dialogs when live.driver.session.requests.is_empty() and the flag is clear (never in a demo, never while locked), so until then an open that names no window shows in the stale asking window instead of the window of the last press, and a chat window that closed cannot clear it by its own close.
fix: Host::Asked { window, request: RequestId } expired by that request settling (answer, error, cancel, owner going away)

title: Three records of which kit dialog a window shows, reconciled by hand in sync_host_dialogs
trigger: Any action that closes a box (close_kit_dialog_if_done) while the shell, the mailbox and the host map each hold their own copy.
effect: QuillShell::open_dialog (Option<DialogKind>), MainWindow::dialogs_closed (set of window ids the shell must forget) and DialogHosts::hosts (Asked/Shown) must change together; the section 8 skip (13-052) says a single value needs the kit to name its dialogs, a dependency not independence. No bug today.
fix: One per-window KitDialog { None, Shown(kind), ClosedByAction } in the window's slot, with the kit reporting which dialog is up

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut on MainWindow::dialogs_closed (also line 618)
trigger: The mailbox is borrowed mutably in sync_host_dialogs (449) and close_kit_dialog_if_done (618) while chat_window/mod.rs:663 already uses try_borrow_mut for the same cell; a re-entrant close from inside a borrow would panic.
effect: Panic (process abort) if the cell is ever borrowed re-entrantly; today each borrow is one short expression.
fix: try_borrow_mut with an early return like chat_window/mod.rs:663, or fold the mailbox into the per-window KitDialog value

title: bindings.borrow() on GPUI's key-binding RefCell during render
trigger: Open Settings > Keyboard Shortcuts while the keymap is being rebound (bind_keys holding the cell mutably).
effect: Panic in render if the keymap cell is mutably borrowed; the guard is dropped explicitly before the layout is built, so the window is short.
fix: try_borrow with an empty-list fallback

title: baseline: MediaMenuFacts::downloading
trigger: Built per row on every render from downloads.is_downloading and requests.has_download.
effect: A baseline stage-word bool still in the register; it is a derived fact (not stored), so no bug, but the check list still carries it.
fix: Pass the file's DownloadStage (Idle, Downloading, OnDisk) to media_menu_items instead of a bool

title: Similar strip re-asks from render after a failed send
trigger: A joined channel's strip draws while fetch_similar_chats returns Err (sender closed): fetch_profile_chats removes the Loading entry on a send error (connect/profile_panels.rs:68), so contains_key is false again.
effect: Only an answered Failed is terminal; a failed send leaves no mark, so every render of the joined-notice row defers another request (no redraw loop, since notify runs only on Ok(Some)).
fix: Record the send failure as ProfileChatsFetch::Failed (or ask only from the notice's open/expand action)

title: Peek::Leaving { since } names the grace timer while the Task is detach()ed outside the stage
trigger: Move the pointer off the peeking sidebar, then back over it (or press Escape) within the grace period.
effect: The detached cx.spawn timer (plain spawn, not screen-scoped) still fires after the stage left Leaving and redraws once; harmless today, but the stage and its timer are two things and an account switch does not drop it.
fix: Peek::Leaving { since, wake: Task<()> } so returning, dismissing or the screen going drops the timer

title: chat_list.menu and chat_list.peek are exclusive overlays kept in step by hand
trigger: Cmd/Ctrl+backslash sets menu and resets peek to Idle (665-669); open_chat_preview clears menu (open_chat_preview.rs:42); a pin drag resets peek (chat_list/mod.rs:676); about 25 other sites clear menu on their own.
effect: PeekPreview became an enum but the menu sits beside it as an Option; a site that opens one and forgets the other leaves a menu over a preview. No bug found today.
fix: ChatListOverlay { None, Menu(ChatMenuState), Peek(PeekPreview) } so opening one replaces the other

title: forward_shared_media_selection writes share.forward raw over whatever stage is there
trigger: Forward selected in the gallery while share.forward is None or Picking (guard is is_some && !picker_open) or ReplyChooser over nothing.
effect: The Selecting(draft) assignment drops a Picking draft, or a ReplyChooser wrapper, instead of a ForwardStage transition; unreachable under the modal box today.
fix: A ForwardStage::begin_selection(draft) transition that refuses or wraps every stage

title: ChatUi::selection_anchor is written beside focus and never cleared
trigger: Select with Ctrl+Space / Shift+arrows, clear the selection, later start a new range.
effect: selection_anchor (shortcut_pack, history_a11y, selection_drag, selection_mode) only ever gets Some; it outlives the selection that set it and is filtered only by whether the id is still loaded.
fix: Carry the anchor inside the selection stage (Selecting { anchor, focus }) so ending selection drops it

title: Engine install re-seeds underlines.text and schedules a check even with spell check off; turning it on later never checks the draft
trigger: Spell check is off, a draft sits in a composer, the background engine build finishes (install_spell_engine sets spelling.underlines.text = draft and calls schedule_spellcheck, whose answer is dropped because spellcheck_enabled is false); the user switches Check spelling on: sync_spellcheck_everywhere -> sync_spellcheck sees text == underlines.text && non-empty and returns early without scheduling
effect: No underlines appear for the existing draft until the next edit; also a wasted background check while the setting is off
fix: install_spell_engine (and recheck_spelling) go through the same disabled gate as sync_spellcheck, or sync_spellcheck decides 'already checked' from Check/Underlines state (an Underlines { text, status: Unchecked|Checked } value) instead of text equality

title: drain_statistics_theme re-sends from the poll loop after a refused send
trigger: Statistics panel open with a Loaded result for the other theme, then the account is not Ready or its shutdown phase is not Running: refresh_chat_statistics returns Err(InvalidRequest) at chats_path_active() before it touches the fetch, so the fetch stays Loaded{is_dark != now}; every poll drain returns true again, calls refresh_statistics, sets an error note and cx.notify
effect: Poll loop reports progress forever and the 'failed statistics' note is re-set every poll; no Failed stage ever ends it
fix: mark the refetch attempt in the stage (Loaded -> Failed, or a Loaded{refresh: Refetch<RequestId>} value) when the send is refused, so drain only fires once per theme change

title: QUIT_ASKED is a bool stage set by hand in four places and cleared only by the refusal wrapper
trigger: A quit is asked (noting_quit, Platform::quit, restart) and the answer is Later or never arrives; the flag stays true, so a main window the renderer gave up on afterwards is classified as part of the quit (main_lost false) and the GPU-loss reopen is skipped
effect: Main window not reopened after a renderer loss that follows a quit request that did not complete
fix: one Quit { Running, Asked, Refused } value owned by ZoomPlatform, changed only by its answer to the quit request

title: A picked still sticker whose download cannot be sent waits in PickWait::Downloading with no way out
trigger: Adapt from a Sticker: pick a not-yet-downloaded WebP sticker while the connection path is down (download_file returns Err and unsticks its record)
effect: No editor opens and no note is shown; the pick is dropped silently only when the box is closed. The WebM path (video_pick.rs:77) handles the same Err with a note; the still path ignores it with `let _ =`, and sticker_box_window_upkeep leaves the wait only on ended_without_file, which needs a download record that an unsent request does not have
fix: Check the send result before entering Downloading (as pick_video_for_set does), or share one helper for both paths

title: An async graph whose getStatisticalGraph send fails is asked again at every render
trigger: Open channel statistics while the send fails (driver Err: graph_unsent removes the Loading mark, nothing records a Failed)
effect: The graph stays hidden and a send is attempted at each redraw until one goes out; no Retry is offered (the poll-votes path made the same case Failed so render does not re-ask, fetch_stats_poll_votes)
fix: Mark the key GraphFetch::Failed when the send is refused, like PollStatsFetch::Failed, so only Retry asks again

title: A recent post's getMessage whose send fails is asked again at every render of the list
trigger: Statistics overview with recent posts not in loaded history while sends fail (fetch_stats_post returns Err and records nothing)
effect: Each render of recent_posts_section / message_stats_page re-sends getMessage for every Unknown post; the row stays out until one goes out
fix: Record a Missing/Failed entry (or a Fetch) when the send is refused

title: Export of a poll post's statistics ignores a poll-votes chart that is loading or never asked
trigger: Open a poll post's statistics and press Export to File before the votes chart arrived
effect: The workbook is written without the poll votes sheet and without the 'still loading' toast; resolve() sets unsettled for async graphs, but the PollStatsFetch::Loading / missing arm yields None without setting it
fix: Treat PollStatsFetch::Loading and a missing entry of a poll post as unsettled

title: The set box's Farewell resets the UI half only; the session's viewed set (and its change stage) stays in the old account's session
trigger: Open a set in account A, press Add, switch to B before TDLib answers, switch back to A
effect: sticker_set_box_tick finds SetChangeStage::Done/Failed on the old view with no box shown and shows a stale 'Sticker set added' / error toast (and runs close_sticker_set_dialog); the view also stays Ready in the background session
fix: Clear sticker_set_view in the farewell (call close_sticker_set_dialog) or hold the view in StickerSetBoxUi

title: The refetch mark after a set edit is consumed even when the installed-list request that satisfies it is already in flight
trigger: Edit a set (rename, add, delete) while a getInstalledStickerSets or emoji-sets request sent before the edit finished is still out
effect: take_sticker_set_refetch clears creator_refetch_sets, has_purpose skips the send, and the in-flight answer may hold the pre-edit list, so the 'Add to ... Set' menus and panel badge stay stale until the next refresh
fix: Keep the mark until a request sent after the edit is out (Fetch::Outdated style)

title: SetFiles::{NotAsked, Asked} is marked Asked before the downloads are sent and the send result is dropped
trigger: Open a sticker set box while ensure_media_files fails (path inactive)
effect: Previews of the set are never requested again until the set is re-fetched; cells stay grey placeholders. Called from sticker_set_box/mod.rs:387 as `let _ =`
fix: Mark Asked only after the send went out, or derive from the file map

title: sync_sticker_set_view re-sends getStickerSet from every poll tick after a refused send
trigger: After a set edit, with the send refused (offline path)
effect: sticker_set_box_tick calls it each poll; refresh_needed stays true until a send goes out, so each poll rebuilds a request and returns Err. Wasted work only, no redraw loop
fix: Fail the refresh (a stage the box draws) or wait for the path to become active

title: Upkeep slots use RefCell borrow()/replace() on the render path instead of try_borrow
trigger: ensure_sticker_closer / ensure_sticker_pump run from render and frame start; closer.replace runs inside a task update
effect: A re-entrant call while a guard is held panics the UI thread (panic-safety rule 6); sites: app.rs:332, 345, 375 and the thread-local DISPLAYS borrow in display.rs:34,43,69
fix: try_borrow / try_borrow_mut with early return, as the stores at app.rs:364 and 417 do

title: Dialog body slots use Rc<RefCell<Option<_>>>::borrow_mut().take() inside content closures
trigger: The kit calls the content closure again while it is being run (re-entrant build)
effect: Panics the UI thread; sites: sticker_set_box/mod.rs:546, dialogs.rs:354 and 502, stickers_manager/mod.rs:533 and 558
fix: Use Cell<Option<_>> with take(), or try_borrow_mut

title: Closing the story composer while a post or save is in flight drops the request that would report it
trigger: Press Post (stage Posting{request}) or Save (Saving{request}), then press Esc, Close or click the backdrop before the answer lands
effect: close() resets the whole composer to default, so the Posting/Saving request is no longer tracked: a failed post or edit is never shown and a success never says so; reopening via the + tile also wipes session post outcomes
fix: Keep the stage in a value owned by StoryUi that survives close (or disable close while ComposerStage::busy), and report its outcome as a note

title: cover_request and privacy_request are dropped by reopening the editor and by stepping to another story, although section 8 says they outlive their panel
trigger: Press Set in the cover picker (or Save in the privacy editor), switch to another panel, reopen the picker (toggle_story_cover_edit sets cover_request = None; toggle_story_privacy_edit sets privacy_request = None), or step to the next story (leave_item rebuilds StoryViewerUi with defaults)
effect: The in-flight editStoryCover/setStoryPrivacySettings answer is no longer matched: a failure is never shown (frame_upkeep reads the field), and the new editor shows Set/Save as idle while the old call is out (only manage.pending_for blocks a second send)
fix: Hold the two requests in a StoryUi-level map keyed by (chat, story) that open/leave never overwrite, or one ManageCall enum per story settled by its RequestId

title: Album picker asks for thumbnails only before a page arrives, so the thumbnails of later pages are never requested
trigger: Open the album picker on a chat with more than 50 archived stories and scroll to the end
effect: picker_load_near_end sends the next page and calls request_picker_thumbs in the same call, when the new ids are not candidates yet; nothing re-asks after the page lands (the grid only has on_scroll, not watch_scroll), so the new tiles and the last page stay blank
fix: Request missing thumbnails from the render/after-layout look (as watch_scroll does) or when the page answer is applied, not at send time

title: A statistics send that fails leaves the panel on Loading statistics with no retry
trigger: Open the story Statistics panel when the send fails (fetch_story_insights returns Err after clear_story_insights, e.g. the chats path is not active)
effect: Only a transient status note shows the error; story_stats_panel finds no insights for the story and draws 'Loading statistics' forever without the Retry button (Retry exists only for StoryStatsFetch::Failed); the user must close and reopen the panel
fix: On a failed send put the insights in StoryStatsFetch::Failed (keeping the story key) so the panel shows its error and Retry

title: The first public-forwards page send is dropped with let _ =, leaving ForwardsPage::NotAsked drawn as 'No public shares yet'
trigger: Open the story Statistics panel; getStoryStatistics goes out but the first getStoryPublicForwards send fails
effect: forwards_page stays NotAsked with an empty next offset: the panel shows 'No public shares yet', and story_forwards_more never asks (it needs a non-empty offset), so the list is never loaded or retried
fix: Mark ForwardsPage::Failed when the first page cannot be sent so the panel shows the error and a scroll retries

title: The story media file dialog answer is applied to whichever composer is open when it returns
trigger: Click the composer preview (file dialog opens), close the composer and open another one (edit or repost), then choose a file
effect: spawn_screen carries only the screen epoch, so take_story_media sets the media on the new composer, which the user never asked to change
fix: Carry a composer token (open counter or the stage owner key) in the continuation and apply the pick only when it still matches

title: CoverStage::Probing names a probe whose task is detached, matched by a serial instead of held in the stage
trigger: Open the cover picker on a downloaded video story
effect: No bug today (every continuation re-checks CoverPicker::serial); the probe and frame-cutting loop and the preview cut (preview_job: Option<i64>) are detached tasks the stage cannot cancel, and the loop's progress lives only in frames: Vec<Option<_>>
fix: Hold the probe/strip task in CoverStage::Probing{task} and the preview cut in an enum Preview{Idle, Cutting{at, task}} so dropping the picker cancels them

title: MediaSave::Saving names a copy whose continuation is detached and has no way out if it is dropped
trigger: Press Save media on a story
effect: No bug today; Saving leaves only when the detached spawn_scoped continuation runs (story_more.rs save_story_media), drop_viewer_ui keeps Saving across a close, and a dropped continuation would block saving that story until the account switches
fix: Hold the Task in MediaSave::Saving(Task<()>) so dropping the entry cancels it and Saving always has an owner

title: baseline: RowState::pending
trigger: Open the stickers manager and press Add on a trending or archived set
effect: The bool is a per-render copy of manager_set_pending (a lookup of the request table by purpose), not stored, but it stays a stage-named flag in the baseline
fix: Pass a RowAction enum (Idle, Adding) built from the request table, or ask manager_set_pending inside manager_action

title: StoryComposer::open is a bool beside stage and mode, and the Esc layer reads it separately
trigger: Open and close the story composer
effect: No bug today: close() resets the whole value so open and stage agree, but the box-open stage is a bool that every opener (open, open_edit, open_repost) must set together with the stage
fix: StoryUi::composer as Option<StoryComposer> (None is closed) so open is the variant, not a flag

title: A partly sent picker save (add sent, remove fails) leaves no PageWait and the retry resends the add
trigger: On an opened album tick stories to add and untick others, press Save; add_story_album_stories goes out and remove_story_album_stories fails to send
effect: story_page_mutate returns None, so page.wait stays Idle: the picker stays with its ticks while the add call is in flight and, once it settles, Save sends the same adds again
fix: Return the ids already sent on a partial failure and enter PageWait::SavingPicker with them, or send add and remove as one tracked step

title: LiveJoin::Joining never ends when the getGroupCall step fails or the stream is refused after the send
trigger: Open a live story while getGroupCall fails (offline, flood wait) or the stream is refused in a member chat (maybe_join_live_story drops pending_live_story_join with no tracker and no UI signal)
effect: The viewer shows the opening spinner for ever: join_live_story returned Ok so LiveJoin::Joining(target) is set, no story_stream exists so join_failed() is false (no Retry overlay), check_live_story_ended does nothing without a call, and sync_live_story only starts a join from Idle. Only closing the viewer or stepping away clears it.
fix: LiveJoin::Joining { target, request: RequestId }: when that request is gone with no tracker (or the join is refused) move to Refused so the Join live button shows

title: A page wait's answer acts on what the page shows now, not on what asked
trigger: Press Delete twice on album A (PageWait::Deleting), then Back and open album B before the server answers (open_story_album and back_to_story_albums do not look at wait); or start Create, then open another picker
effect: On success the view jumps to the album list although B is open (Deleting(request) carries no album id), or the new picker is closed and the name input cleared (Creating/SavingPicker success sets picker None regardless of its target)
fix: PageWait::Deleting { request, album } and picker target in the wait variants; apply the follow-up only when the page still shows that album or picker

title: AlbumDelete::{Idle, Armed} is the delete stage split across two values
trigger: Arm the album delete, then open the picker or press Back; or send the delete
effect: No bug today: the stages Idle, Armed and Deleting live in AlbumView::Album.delete and in PageWait::Deleting(RequestId) and are kept in step by hand: disarm() is called from story_albums/picker.rs:44 and story_albums/mod.rs:315 instead of from the stage's own transitions. Section 8 skipped it as 'already AlbumView / AlbumDelete' (13-134), which is not 'one value' or 'independent'.
fix: AlbumDelete { Idle, Armed, Deleting(RequestId) } inside the album view, so leaving the view drops the stage and its request together

title: The stealth box and its once-a-second redraw tick outlive the lock
trigger: Open Stealth Mode (viewer menu or tile menu), then lock Quill with the passcode
effect: close_for_lock calls release_story_viewer, whose drop_viewer_ui does not touch stories.stealth_box, so the box stays open and its _tick task keeps notifying the app every second behind the lock screen (and while the window is hidden); the box is still there after unlock, possibly with no viewer under it
fix: close the stealth box in close_for_lock (drop the StealthBox value, which ends the tick) or have the tick skip while refused_while_locked

title: open_story swallows a failed getStory send; the pending open then waits forever
trigger: Press a story link, reply header or repost label while the chats path is inactive or the send fails. get_story_now clears the story's retry clock first (connect/stories/mod.rs:212-221) and returns Err; open_story drops it with `let _ =`.
effect: The story stays Loading with no request out and no retry clock, so `failed` is never true and resolve_pending_story_open never leaves Loading. Nothing resends. The press does nothing, and for a repost press (if_gone set) story_playback_paused holds the open viewer paused until the user steps or closes.
fix: On Err from get_story/get_story_now, drop the pending open and post the story-load-failed note (or hold the RequestId in the Waiting stage and resolve it on the error answer)

title: Story open stage is an Option in ChatListUi beside the viewer, cleared by hand in six places
trigger: open_story writes chat_list.pending_story_open; resolve_pending_story_open clears it in four arms, story_changed (nav.rs:120) and release_story_viewer (mod.rs:724) clear it too.
effect: No bug today. The stage Closed / Waiting(open) / Open(viewer) is two fields (ChatListUi::pending_story_open and StoryUi::viewer) kept in step by hand, and the pending open lives in the chat list instead of StoryUi.
fix: A StoryOpen enum in StoryUi: Closed, Waiting(PendingStoryOpen), Open(StoryViewer); a close, step or replace is one transition

title: Who hosts the shared media panel is a bool in StoryViewerUi beside the panel's own mode
trigger: toggle_story_reply_panel sets viewer_ui.reply_panel(true) and opens pickers.media_panel; story_reply_panel_active ANDs reply_open, reply_panel, panel is_open, no reaction and no status. Any other closer of the panel (close_media_panel from a non-story path) leaves reply_panel true.
effect: No bug confirmed: the story overlay covers the composer. A stale reply_panel plus an open panel from another host would route picks to the story reply (picks_go_to_story). The host is two fields that must change together.
fix: A PanelMode::StoryReply host variant in the media panel's own mode, so closing the panel ends the host

title: SuggestedPostsUi is two stage fields (base, over) whose valid pairs are kept by convention
trigger: TimeTarget::PriceBox names the base price box; set_price, set_accept and set_decline write base without touching over; submit_suggest_time silently drops its answer when price_mut() is None.
effect: No bug today (kit dialogs are modal). Over::Time(PriceBox) with base not Price is representable, and the time answer is then lost.
fix: One enum of the legal flows: Price, Price+Time, Price+GramsNeeded, Accept, Accept+GramsNeeded, Decline, OfferTime; PriceBox as time target is the Price+Time variant

title: set_grams_needed overwrites an open time box
trigger: Open the time box (Over::Time) from the price box; a BALANCE_TOO_LOW answer from an earlier approve or offer is drained (drain_suggested_post_notes -> ask_after_balance_error -> ask_for_balance), which calls set_grams_needed.
effect: The time box, its picker and its error are dropped without a close; the Grams Needed box takes its place, and the user loses the date they were picking. set_time likewise overwrites GramsNeeded.
fix: The legal-flows enum refuses or queues a second over box while one is open

title: Thread asker is a separate field in ChatWindows, set and reset by hand, not part of the thread's stage
trigger: open_thread_view sets windows.thread_asker after open_thread (also on Ok(None) dedupe); advance_thread resets it to Nobody only on the needs_start path; a Failed thread, a close_thread or a retry_thread never touches it.
effect: No wrong target found today: every open goes through open_thread_view. The asker is two fields that must change together (session ThreadStatus and ChatWindows::thread_asker), and a retry from the failed pane keeps whichever asker the first open left.
fix: Carry the asker in the thread's opening stage (SwitchingChat/Starting hold the asking window) so it ends with the stage

title: Jump-to-root goal outlives a failed older page
trigger: In a long thread press the root bar; an older page fails (OlderEnd::Failed). scroll_goal_now returns Waiting for any older end other than Complete, and fetch_thread_history returns Ok(None) while older is Failed. Dismiss the failure strip and scroll elsewhere.
effect: ScrollGoal::ThreadRoot stays set until the thread closes; when older pages later complete (a manual retry or scroll) the list jumps to the root unasked.
fix: Drop the goal when the older end becomes Failed (ScrollAim::Goal carries the thread's request, ended by its error)

title: baseline: Drawn::leaving
trigger: Drawn::leaving mirrors Glide::target() <= 0 (state_is_none) beside value and shown; it is listed in scripts/implicit-state-baseline.txt (twice).
effect: No bug: it is computed in the same expression as shown, never stored. The register still shows the baseline line.
fix: A Phase enum (Entering, Shown, Leaving) in Drawn derived from the glide target

title: Synthetic photo stage ImageLoading is ended by a detached 900 ms timer
trigger: SyntheticChat::new spawns a detached timer that calls finish_image, which flips the first SyntheticKind::ImageLoading row to ImageLoaded.
effect: No bug: the pre-login placeholder is built once and a dropped entity makes the update fail. The stage names a timer whose Task is detached instead of held in the stage.
fix: Hold the Task in the SyntheticChat (or an ImageStage::Loading(Task) variant) so dropping the chat cancels it

title: A second pinned-chat drop while the first SetPinnedChats is in flight leaves Order::Reordering for good
trigger: Drag a pinned chat to a new slot, then drag another one before the server answers the first. touch_bar_reorder gets Ok(None) from set_pinned_chat_order (a SetPinnedChats is pending, so nothing is sent or applied) and never calls reorder_refused.
effect: The panel keeps the second order on screen while the model holds the first (reorder_echo stays Waiting: same pins, different order). It looks saved but is not, until the pinned list changes.
fix: Make the drop's outcome one value: touch_bar_reorder maps Ok(None)/Err to reorder_refused, or Reordering carries the RequestId and is left when it settles

title: A Failed message translation counts as done, so the pump never asks for it again
trigger: Open a translated chat while offline or during a client restart (abandon_translation records Failed("send"), fail_orphaned_translations records Failed("lost")), or let TDLib refuse once.
effect: needs_translation is message_translation(..).is_none(), so the message keeps its original text in a translated chat for the rest of the session, although ConnectDriver::translate_message does retry Failed.
fix: needs_translation is true for Failed (with a retry bound or a Failed-with-retry variant), as translate_message already allows

title: ToastQueue::pointer: Pointer {Away, Over} is the old hover flag beside Timer::Paused
trigger: Hover the toast, dismiss it, let the next one start.
effect: No bug today; pointer is a two-variant enum reset by hand in dismiss, pointer_gone and set_hovered beside Showing::timer (section 8 row 13-116 renamed the bool).
fix: Fold the hover into the stage that outlives a toast (e.g. a Slot { Empty { hovered }, Showing { timer } }) so Over cannot be set with nothing showing

title: ToastQueue::wake names the scheduled wake-up while status_toast_visible detaches its Task
trigger: Any toast: rewake returns a deadline and the caller spawn_screen(..).detach()es the timer.
effect: The stage is an Instant and woke() matches it by value; the task is not held, so a replaced or dropped queue cannot cancel it, it only fires and is ignored.
fix: Hold the timer Task in the queue's wake stage (Wake { None, Armed { deadline, task } })

title: TranslateScreen::toast with toast_seq names a timer whose Task is detached
trigger: Hide a translate bar or skip a language: show_translate_toast starts a 4 s spawn_screen timer and detaches it; the timer clears the toast only if its id matches.
effect: No bug today (the id guards a stale timer), but the stage names the timer by a counter instead of holding it.
fix: TranslateToast owns its timer Task, so replacing or clearing the toast cancels it and toast_seq goes

title: TranslateDialog keeps view, source, ask, note and original_expanded as parallel fields
trigger: Open Translate from a message, the chooser or the Do Not Translate list.
effect: view=Box needs source Some (an empty body otherwise), SkipList and a source-less ChooseTo need None, note is only read in the lists, original_expanded only in the box, ask only with a source. The pairs are kept in step by hand in choose_translate_language and translate_back_footer.
fix: enum TranslateDialog { Box { source, ask, expanded }, Choosing { over: Option<Box>, to }, SkipList { note } }

title: new_translate_dialog writes over an open dialog and drops its selection job
trigger: With a Translate selection box open in one window (job in flight), open Translate in another window; the session-wide dialog value is replaced.
effect: The old TranslateAsk::Job is never passed to drop_text_translation, so the job and its result stay in the session and count in the pump's in-flight cap.
fix: Close the old dialog (close_translate_dialog) inside new_translate_dialog, or own the job in a value whose drop releases it

title: SyncState::followed_composer names an observation that follow_composer detaches
trigger: Switch account: a new composer entity is observed.
effect: The Option<EntityId> records which entity is observed while cx.observe(..).detach() holds no handle, so one observation per composer ever followed stays until its entity drops.
fix: Hold the Subscription in the stage (Followed { entity, subscription })

title: Non-test RefCell borrow() and replace() on SyncState::sync
trigger: Re-entry while the stage is borrowed: schedule runs inside sync's own task (replace) or inside a drop of the old Scheduled task.
effect: A BorrowError or BorrowMutError panic would end the process; today no borrow is held across a call.
fix: try_borrow / try_borrow_mut with an early return, as the rest of the file does

title: translate_offer uses RefCell borrow() and borrow_mut() on the offer cache during render
trigger: Render in two windows; each calls translate_offer(&self).
effect: The guards are short and nothing re-enters, so no panic today; a future call inside the history walk would panic.
fix: try_borrow with a fall-through to recompute

title: One-shot Rc<RefCell<Option<body>>> taken with borrow_mut inside the dialog's Fn content closure (same in translate_ui/mod.rs:542)
trigger: The kit calls the content closure twice for one built dialog.
